units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Wedding|log|37|0
units.english: Learned of an upcoming wedding between some of the scions of Houses Chydiyi and Myurej.
units.italian: Hai saputo di un imminente matrimonio tra alcuni eredi delle Casate Chydiyi e Myurej.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Wedding|	The crowds of Successors in this spaceport are unusually active today, many animatedly chatting to each other while others sit splayed around displays, watching a news broadcast. It's not long after you step off your ship that one particularly excited-looking Successor approaches you, their skin aburst with splashes of pink and green. "Hast thou heard the recent news, Captain?"|39|0
units.english: The crowds of Successors in this spaceport are unusually active today, many animatedly chatting to each other while others sit splayed around displays, watching a news broadcast. It's not long after you step off your ship that one particularly excited-looking Successor approaches you, their skin aburst with splashes of pink and green. "Hast thou heard the recent news, Captain?"
units.italian: La folla di Successori in questo spazioporto è insolitamente vivace oggi: molti chiacchierano animatamente tra loro, altri se ne stanno sparsi attorno ai display, a guardare un notiziario. Non passa molto da quando scendi dalla nave che un Successore dall'aria particolarmente eccitata ti si avvicina, la pelle che esplode di chiazze rosa e verdi. "Hai tu udito le notizie recenti, capitano?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Wedding|	"No."|41|0
units.english: "No."
units.italian: "No."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Wedding|	"I try to avoid it when I can."|42|0
units.english: "I try to avoid it when I can."
units.italian: "Cerco di evitare le notizie, quando posso."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Wedding|	The Successor wriggles. "A scion of Chydiyi plans to marry one of Myurej! T'was announced t'day, early in the morn! Chydiyi and Myurej have been close for so long, and this shall only make the two closer..." As they trail off, they see someone in the crowd and hastily say goodbye to you before slithering away. As you go about your business, you are interrupted a few more times to see if you've "heard the news." While many Successors appear excited about this, some take on a more suspicious tone. A shift in power like this would surely not be good for everyone.|45|0
units.english: The Successor wriggles. "A scion of Chydiyi plans to marry one of Myurej! T'was announced t'day, early in the morn! Chydiyi and Myurej have been close for so long, and this shall only make the two closer..." As they trail off, they see someone in the crowd and hastily say goodbye to you before slithering away. As you go about your business, you are interrupted a few more times to see if you've "heard the news." While many Successors appear excited about this, some take on a more suspicious tone. A shift in power like this would surely not be good for everyone.
units.italian: Il Successore si contorce. "Un erede di Chydiyi intende sposare uno di Myurej! L'hanno annunciato oggi, di buon mattino! Chydiyi e Myurej sono vicine da tanto tempo, e questo non farà che stringerle..." Mentre la voce si perde, vede qualcuno tra la folla e si congeda in fretta da te prima di strisciare via. Mentre badi ai tuoi affari, vieni interrotto ancora qualche volta per sapere se hai "udito le notizie". Se molti Successori sembrano eccitati, alcuni assumono un tono più sospettoso. Un simile spostamento di potere non sarebbe certo un bene per tutti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Wedding|	The Successor wriggles, a little uncomfortably. "A scion of Chydiyi announced their plan to marry one of Myurej's. T'was announced today, along with a message of their sympathy for Kaatrij. A little convenient, methinks. Chydiyi and Myurej t'were already each other's darlings, and now they'll be closer still..." As they trail off, they spot someone in the crowd and excuse themselves before slithering away. As you go about your business, you are interrupted a few more times to see if you've "heard the news." While quite a few of the Successors here are relatively excited about the upcoming noble wedding, many take on a more suspicious tone. A shift in power like this would put the already-wounded New Houses at a further disadvantage against their soon-to-be more closely connected rivals.|49|0
units.english: The Successor wriggles, a little uncomfortably. "A scion of Chydiyi announced their plan to marry one of Myurej's. T'was announced today, along with a message of their sympathy for Kaatrij. A little convenient, methinks. Chydiyi and Myurej t'were already each other's darlings, and now they'll be closer still..." As they trail off, they spot someone in the crowd and excuse themselves before slithering away. As you go about your business, you are interrupted a few more times to see if you've "heard the news." While quite a few of the Successors here are relatively excited about the upcoming noble wedding, many take on a more suspicious tone. A shift in power like this would put the already-wounded New Houses at a further disadvantage against their soon-to-be more closely connected rivals.
units.italian: Il Successore si contorce, un po' a disagio. "Un erede di Chydiyi ha annunciato l'intenzione di sposare uno di Myurej. L'annuncio è di oggi, insieme a un messaggio di solidarietà per Kaatrij. Un po' comodo, a parer mio. Chydiyi e Myurej erano già le predilette l'una dell'altra, e ora saranno ancora più vicine..." Mentre la voce si perde, nota qualcuno tra la folla e si scusa prima di strisciare via. Mentre badi ai tuoi affari, vieni interrotto ancora qualche volta per sapere se hai "udito le notizie". Se parecchi Successori qui sono relativamente eccitati per le imminenti nozze nobiliari, molti assumono un tono più sospettoso. Un simile spostamento di potere metterebbe le Casate Nuove, già ferite, in ulteriore svantaggio contro rivali destinate a diventare più strettamente legate.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Incident|log|64|0
units.english: Learned of an incident on a moon controlled by House Kaatrij that revealed portions of a hidden base.
units.italian: Hai saputo di un incidente su una luna controllata da Casa Kaatrij, che ha rivelato parti di una base nascosta.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Incident|The usual orderly structure of the spaceport's activity lies in pieces. Throngs of merchants, travelers, and military officers alike crowd around displays in the port, their shops and vessels left behind. It is uncomfortably quiet - the only voice you hear above a whisper is that of a news announcer, writhing in your ears as the translation device rearranges the sound, word by word.|66|0
units.english: The usual orderly structure of the spaceport's activity lies in pieces. Throngs of merchants, travelers, and military officers alike crowd around displays in the port, their shops and vessels left behind. It is uncomfortably quiet - the only voice you hear above a whisper is that of a news announcer, writhing in your ears as the translation device rearranges the sound, word by word.
units.italian: La solita struttura ordinata dell'attività dello spazioporto giace in pezzi. Frotte di mercanti, viaggiatori e ufficiali militari affollano i display del porto, con le loro botteghe e le loro navi abbandonate. Il silenzio è scomodo: l'unica voce che senti sopra un sussurro è quella di un annunciatore, che ti si torce nelle orecchie mentre il dispositivo di traduzione riordina il suono, parola per parola.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Incident|	"... incident has laid bare aught what noble House Kaatrij hath labor'd t'leave concealed. The moon, long thought lifeless, barren, raw, now show'th the spilt guts of some long-conceal'd base. View, fellows! See it seethe beneath the light!"|67|0
units.english: "... incident has laid bare aught what noble House Kaatrij hath labor'd t'leave concealed. The moon, long thought lifeless, barren, raw, now show'th the spilt guts of some long-conceal'd base. View, fellows! See it seethe beneath the light!"
units.italian: "... l'incidente ha messo a nudo ciò che la nobile Casa Kaatrij s'era affaticata a tener celato. La luna, a lungo creduta senza vita, arida, grezza, mostra ora le viscere sparse di qualche base a lungo nascosta. Guardate, compagni! Guardatela ribollire sotto la luce!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Incident|	The display changes to show an overhead view of a sandy moon. Tucked in a valley between rust-colored dunes is a bloom of distorted metal and intermittent light, the shape of a long arc stretching for maybe a kilometer across the surface. Near the ends, the image shimmers and warps before the whole thing is obscured by a Kaatrij warship flying into view - it's not clear whether the distortion is actually present or just a fault of the transmission.|68|0
units.english: The display changes to show an overhead view of a sandy moon. Tucked in a valley between rust-colored dunes is a bloom of distorted metal and intermittent light, the shape of a long arc stretching for maybe a kilometer across the surface. Near the ends, the image shimmers and warps before the whole thing is obscured by a Kaatrij warship flying into view - it's not clear whether the distortion is actually present or just a fault of the transmission.
units.italian: Il display cambia per mostrare una veduta dall'alto di una luna sabbiosa. Incuneato in una valle tra dune color ruggine c'è uno sbocciare di metallo distorto e luce intermittente, la forma di un lungo arco che si estende per forse un chilometro sulla superficie. Vicino alle estremità l'immagine ondeggia e si deforma, prima che il tutto sia oscurato da una nave da guerra Kaatrij che entra nell'inquadratura: non è chiaro se la distorsione ci sia davvero o sia solo un difetto della trasmissione.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Incident|	Whatever the cause, it's clear that House Kaatrij has been caught out.|72|0
units.english: Whatever the cause, it's clear that House Kaatrij has been caught out.
units.italian: Qualunque sia la causa, è chiaro che Casa Kaatrij è stata colta in fallo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Incident|label|74|0
units.english: seen this before
units.italian: seen this before

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Incident|	The similarities to the immediate aftermath of the bombing of Geminus and Martini are striking. Though it's unclear what - or who - caused this incident, this could easily incite even greater conflict between the Houses.|75|0
units.english: The similarities to the immediate aftermath of the bombing of Geminus and Martini are striking. Though it's unclear what - or who - caused this incident, this could easily incite even greater conflict between the Houses.
units.italian: Le somiglianze con le conseguenze immediate del bombardamento di Geminus e Martini sono impressionanti. Anche se non è chiaro cosa - o chi - abbia causato l'incidente, questo potrebbe facilmente incendiare un conflitto ancora più grande tra le Casate.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|Immediately after you enter the moon's atmosphere, your communication system springs to life.|90|0
units.english: Immediately after you enter the moon's atmosphere, your communication system springs to life.
units.italian: Non appena entri nell'atmosfera della luna, il tuo sistema di comunicazione si accende.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	"Unauthorized vessel! Cease thine approach and return to orbit! This world is under crisis jurisdiction of House Kaatrij and no civilian craft are permitted.|91|0
units.english: "Unauthorized vessel! Cease thine approach and return to orbit! This world is under crisis jurisdiction of House Kaatrij and no civilian craft are permitted.
units.italian: "Nave non autorizzata! Cessa il tuo avvicinamento e torna in orbita! Questo mondo è sotto la giurisdizione di crisi di Casa Kaatrij e nessun mezzo civile è ammesso.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	(Do as they say.)|93|0
units.english: (Do as they say.)
units.italian: (Fai come dicono.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	"I'm an ally of House Kaatrij!"|95|0
units.english: "I'm an ally of House Kaatrij!"
units.italian: "Sono un alleato di Casa Kaatrij!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	"I'm not interested in your base, I just want to land elsewhere."|99|0
units.english: "I'm not interested in your base, I just want to land elsewhere."
units.italian: "Non m'interessa la vostra base, voglio solo atterrare altrove."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	(Continue anyway.)|101|0
units.english: (Continue anyway.)
units.italian: (Prosegui comunque.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	You cut the communication channel and proceed anyway. For a moment, all seems well, but soon your sensors detect weapons fire from emplacements on the surface and the underbelly of your ship is lanced by a barrage of hypervelocity spikes.|104|0
units.english: You cut the communication channel and proceed anyway. For a moment, all seems well, but soon your sensors detect weapons fire from emplacements on the surface and the underbelly of your ship is lanced by a barrage of hypervelocity spikes.
units.italian: Chiudi il canale di comunicazione e prosegui comunque. Per un momento sembra tutto a posto, ma presto i sensori rilevano fuoco d'arma dalle postazioni a terra e la pancia della nave viene trapassata da una scarica di punte iperveloci.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	The shots ram against your ship's shields with punishing ferocity, but the <ship> holds fast under the onslaught. However, the heavy fire greatly disturbs your flight path and it becomes increasingly clear that you won't be able to land regardless of your vessel's durability.|109|0
units.english: The shots ram against your ship's shields with punishing ferocity, but the <ship> holds fast under the onslaught. However, the heavy fire greatly disturbs your flight path and it becomes increasingly clear that you won't be able to land regardless of your vessel's durability.
units.italian: I colpi si abbattono sugli scudi della nave con ferocia punitiva, ma la <ship> tiene duro sotto l'assalto. Il fuoco pesante sconvolge però la traiettoria, e diventa sempre più chiaro che non riuscirai ad atterrare, qualunque sia la robustezza del tuo vascello.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	The shots ram against your ship's shields, rapidly wearing them down and disturbing your flight pattern enough that you have no choice but to return to orbit. The batteries stop firing once you clear the atmosphere, fortunately.|112|0
units.english: The shots ram against your ship's shields, rapidly wearing them down and disturbing your flight pattern enough that you have no choice but to return to orbit. The batteries stop firing once you clear the atmosphere, fortunately.
units.italian: I colpi si abbattono sugli scudi della nave, consumandoli in fretta e sconvolgendo abbastanza la traiettoria da non lasciarti altra scelta che tornare in orbita. Per fortuna le batterie smettono di sparare appena esci dall'atmosfera.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	Your ship's shields go down after the first few shots and it doesn't even take the full volley to destroy your vessel entirely.|115|0
units.english: Your ship's shields go down after the first few shots and it doesn't even take the full volley to destroy your vessel entirely.
units.italian: Gli scudi della nave cedono dopo i primi colpi e non serve nemmeno la scarica completa per distruggere del tutto il tuo vascello.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	"Thou art denied, for thou'rt without a writ of authorization. Converse with thy superior if this is in error, and return only when thou canst present it. Now return to orbit, on pain of death, ally or no."|119|0
units.english: "Thou art denied, for thou'rt without a writ of authorization. Converse with thy superior if this is in error, and return only when thou canst present it. Now return to orbit, on pain of death, ally or no."
units.italian: "Sei respinto, perché sei senza un atto di autorizzazione. Parlane con il tuo superiore se vi è errore, e torna solo quando potrai esibirlo. Ora torna in orbita, a pena di morte, alleato o no."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|log|122|0
units.english: Attempted to land on Qasa-Sija-Iri but was denied for lack of authorization. Instructed to converse with a superior to acquire authorization to land.
units.italian: Hai tentato di atterrare su Qasa-Sija-Iri, ma ti è stato negato per mancanza di autorizzazione. Ti è stato detto di parlare con un superiore per ottenere il permesso di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	(Return to orbit.)|124|0
units.english: (Return to orbit.)
units.italian: (Torna in orbita.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	(Continue anyway.)|126|0
units.english: (Continue anyway.)
units.italian: (Prosegui comunque.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	"Irrelevant. No civilian vessels are permitted here. Return to orbit, on pain of death."|130|0
units.english: "Irrelevant. No civilian vessels are permitted here. Return to orbit, on pain of death."
units.italian: "Irrilevante. Nessun mezzo civile è ammesso qui. Torna in orbita, a pena di morte."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	(Return to orbit.)|132|0
units.english: (Return to orbit.)
units.italian: (Torna in orbita.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 1|	(Continue anyway.)|134|0
units.english: (Continue anyway.)
units.italian: (Prosegui comunque.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|Though the Kaatrij spaceport is usually quiet, its patrons speaking in hushed whispers, today it is utterly soundless. The very few Successors who go about their business inside do so without a word and stick to only the most thinly-hydrated pathways such that they leave only the smallest of splashes in their wake.|146|0
units.english: Though the Kaatrij spaceport is usually quiet, its patrons speaking in hushed whispers, today it is utterly soundless. The very few Successors who go about their business inside do so without a word and stick to only the most thinly-hydrated pathways such that they leave only the smallest of splashes in their wake.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di Kaatrij è di solito silenzioso, con i suoi frequentatori che parlano a voce bassa; oggi è del tutto muto. I pochissimi Successori che vi si aggirano lo fanno senza una parola e si tengono solo sui percorsi meno idratati, così da lasciare soltanto le più piccole schizze al loro passaggio.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	Near the center of the landing wing is a concierge of sorts: a tall, burnt orange Successor splayed atop a seat of sculpted rocks before a collection of panels.|147|0
units.english: Near the center of the landing wing is a concierge of sorts: a tall, burnt orange Successor splayed atop a seat of sculpted rocks before a collection of panels.
units.italian: Vicino al centro dell'ala d'atterraggio c'è una specie di portiere: un Successore alto, di un arancio bruciato, disteso su un sedile di rocce scolpite davanti a una serie di pannelli.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	(Go to them.)|149|0
units.english: (Go to them.)
units.italian: (Va' da loro.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	(Go about your business as usual.)|150|0
units.english: (Go about your business as usual.)
units.italian: (Bada ai tuoi affari come al solito.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	As you approach, they push themself off the rocks and into the surrounding puddle. "Hello, noble traveler," they say, "But ask me naught 'bout this House's recent business, for I have naught to give on it."|152|0
units.english: As you approach, they push themself off the rocks and into the surrounding puddle. "Hello, noble traveler," they say, "But ask me naught 'bout this House's recent business, for I have naught to give on it."
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini, si spinge via dalle rocce e scivola nella pozza circostante. "Salve, nobile viaggiatore," dice, "ma nulla mi domandare degli affari recenti di questa Casa, ché nulla ho da dire in merito."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"Can you help me get authorization to approach the moon?"|154|0
units.english: "Can you help me get authorization to approach the moon?"
units.italian: "Puoi aiutarmi a ottenere l'autorizzazione ad avvicinarmi alla luna?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"That's okay. Can you help me find Saajret?"|155|0
units.english: "That's okay. Can you help me find Saajret?"
units.italian: "Va bene. Puoi aiutarmi a trovare Saajret?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	The concierge gently rubs a spot on one of the panels, as if trying to remove a stain. "'But ask me naught!' I say, and already my words are as ash and fall unheard. To put it plain, then: no, and never. Make still thy lust for knowledge."|157|0
units.english: The concierge gently rubs a spot on one of the panels, as if trying to remove a stain. "'But ask me naught!' I say, and already my words are as ash and fall unheard. To put it plain, then: no, and never. Make still thy lust for knowledge."
units.italian: Il portiere strofina piano un punto su uno dei pannelli, come se cercasse di togliere una macchia. "'Ma nulla mi domandare!', dico, e già le mie parole sono come cenere e cadono non udite. Per dirla chiara, dunque: no, e mai. Tieni ancora a freno la tua brama di sapere."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"Could you help me find Saajret, then?"|159|0
units.english: "Could you help me find Saajret, then?"
units.italian: "Potresti aiutarmi a trovare Saajret, allora?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"I tried to land there and they told me to seek authorization."|161|0
units.english: "I tried to land there and they told me to seek authorization."
units.italian: "Ho provato ad atterrare lì e mi hanno detto di cercare un'autorizzazione."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	(Leave and go about your business.)|165|0
units.english: (Leave and go about your business.)
units.italian: (Vattene e bada ai tuoi affari.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"That I cannot give," they say, "nor would I do so if empowered."|169|0
units.english: "That I cannot give," they say, "nor would I do so if empowered."
units.italian: "Questo non posso darti," dice, "né lo farei se ne avessi il potere."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"Could you help me find Saajret, then?"|171|0
units.english: "Could you help me find Saajret, then?"
units.italian: "Potresti aiutarmi a trovare Saajret, allora?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	(Leave and go about your business.)|173|0
units.english: (Leave and go about your business.)
units.italian: (Vattene e bada ai tuoi affari.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	The concierge makes a noise like humming, but lower and more musical. "Perhaps. A friend, or companion of yours? But I require more than their third name, traveler."|177|0
units.english: The concierge makes a noise like humming, but lower and more musical. "Perhaps. A friend, or companion of yours? But I require more than their third name, traveler."
units.italian: Il portiere emette un suono come un canticchiare, ma più basso e più musicale. "Forse. Un amico, o un compagno tuo? Ma mi serve più del loro terzo nome, viaggiatore."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"Saajret, of Somber Sejra."|179|0
units.english: "Saajret, of Somber Sejra."
units.italian: "Saajret, di Somber Sejra."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"I don't know them by any other names."|181|0
units.english: "I don't know them by any other names."
units.italian: "Non li conosco con altri nomi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"A rose! A rose," they say, "by any other name would smell as sweet. Not so close a friend, I suppose. But I suppose too much, methinks."|182|0
units.english: "A rose! A rose," they say, "by any other name would smell as sweet. Not so close a friend, I suppose. But I suppose too much, methinks."
units.italian: "Una rosa! Una rosa," dice, "con qualsiasi altro nome avrebbe lo stesso profumo. Non un'amica così stretta, suppongo. Ma suppongo troppo, a parer mio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"Wait! What about 'Saajret, of Somber Sejra?'"|184|0
units.english: "Wait! What about 'Saajret, of Somber Sejra?'"
units.italian: "Aspetta! E 'Saajret, di Somber Sejra'?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	(Leave and go about your business.)|186|0
units.english: (Leave and go about your business.)
units.italian: (Vattene e bada ai tuoi affari.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|label|189|0
units.english: saajret of somber sejra
units.italian: saajret of somber sejra

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"Ah." Their skin shifts to a deep pink, but only for a moment. They pull a long column of metal from the panel in front of them, examining it closely for a time before returning their attention to you. "If thou know'st them well enough to speak of, then 'tis sure thou canst appreciate the stresses on their time. But," they say, glittering, "I shall notify them of thy desire to meet, and I shall give them thy name and this," they say producing a data-sphere of the sort you've seen the Successors use before. "And if they wish to engage thee, then they may."|190|0
units.english: "Ah." Their skin shifts to a deep pink, but only for a moment. They pull a long column of metal from the panel in front of them, examining it closely for a time before returning their attention to you. "If thou know'st them well enough to speak of, then 'tis sure thou canst appreciate the stresses on their time. But," they say, glittering, "I shall notify them of thy desire to meet, and I shall give them thy name and this," they say producing a data-sphere of the sort you've seen the Successors use before. "And if they wish to engage thee, then they may."
units.italian: "Ah." La pelle vira a un rosa cupo, ma solo per un momento. Estrae una lunga colonna di metallo dal pannello davanti a sé, la esamina a lungo prima di riportare l'attenzione su di te. "Se tu li conosci abbastanza da parlare di loro, allora certo comprendi quanto siano gravati i loro impegni. Ma," dice, scintillando, "io li avviserò del tuo desiderio d'incontrarli, e darò loro il tuo nome e questo," dice producendo una sfera di dati del tipo che hai già visto usare ai Successori. "E se vorranno intrattenerti, potranno farlo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"My name is <first> <last>."|192|0
units.english: "My name is <first> <last>."
units.italian: "Il mio nome è <first> <last>."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"Thank you."|194|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"That's not good enough. I need to speak with them now."|195|0
units.english: "That's not good enough. I need to speak with them now."
units.italian: "Non basta. Devo parlare con loro adesso."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|label|197|0
units.english: who are you
units.italian: who are you

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"Indeed. And what is thy name?"|198|0
units.english: "Indeed. And what is thy name?"
units.italian: "Infatti. E qual è il tuo nome?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"<first> <last>."|200|0
units.english: "<first> <last>."
units.italian: "<first> <last>."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|log|203|0
units.english: Attempted to get in contact with Saajret, of Somber Sejra. Received a data-sphere from a House Kaatrij spaceport concierge and was informed that Saajret will make contact on their own time, if at all.
units.italian: Hai tentato di metterti in contatto con Saajret, di Somber Sejra. Hai ricevuto una sfera di dati da un portiere dello spazioporto di Casa Kaatrij e ti è stato detto che Saajret si farà vivo quando vorrà, se mai lo farà.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	The concierge rolls the sphere around at the tip of two of their arms for a little while, then offers it to you. As you take it, you can feel gentle ripples on the surface of the metal, almost like fingerprints. The concierge then slowly returns to their prior position atop the stone seat, their body slithering over the wet rocks along the way.|205|0
units.english: The concierge rolls the sphere around at the tip of two of their arms for a little while, then offers it to you. As you take it, you can feel gentle ripples on the surface of the metal, almost like fingerprints. The concierge then slowly returns to their prior position atop the stone seat, their body slithering over the wet rocks along the way.
units.italian: Il portiere fa rotolare la sfera sulla punta di due delle sue braccia per un po', poi te la offre. Mentre la prendi, senti delle increspature delicate sulla superficie del metallo, quasi come impronte digitali. Poi il portiere torna lentamente alla posizione di prima sul sedile di pietra, il corpo che striscia sulle rocce bagnate lungo la strada.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"Mayhaps, mayhaps. But is thy need echoed by their want, or is it but an arrow pointing to a void?"|209|0
units.english: "Mayhaps, mayhaps. But is thy need echoed by their want, or is it but an arrow pointing to a void?"
units.italian: "Forse, forse. Ma il tuo bisogno è fatto eco dal loro desiderio, o è solo una freccia puntata verso il vuoto?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"Okay, I'm sorry, please just give them my name."|211|0
units.english: "Okay, I'm sorry, please just give them my name."
units.italian: "Va bene, mi scuso, ti prego, dà loro solo il mio nome."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	"Do you ever speak in anything other than riddles?"|213|0
units.english: "Do you ever speak in anything other than riddles?"
units.italian: "Parli mai in qualcosa che non siano enigmi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 2|	The concierge examines another metallic cylinder projecting from their station. "Today? No." They push the cylinder back and return to their prior position atop the stone seat.|214|0
units.english: The concierge examines another metallic cylinder projecting from their station. "Today? No." They push the cylinder back and return to their prior position atop the stone seat.
units.italian: Il portiere esamina un altro cilindro metallico che sporge dalla sua postazione. "Oggi? No." Spinge indietro il cilindro e torna alla posizione di prima sul sedile di pietra.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 3|Shortly after you land on <origin>, the Successor data-sphere you received from the House Kaatrij concierge springs to life. It displays a short message, text-only:|226|0
units.english: Shortly after you land on <origin>, the Successor data-sphere you received from the House Kaatrij concierge springs to life. It displays a short message, text-only:
units.italian: Poco dopo che sei atterrato su <origin>, la sfera di dati Successore che hai ricevuto dal portiere di Casa Kaatrij si accende. Mostra un breve messaggio, solo testo:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 3|	'Tis good of thee, captain, that thou soughtest me out upon learning of this recent incident. Thine instincts do thee justice. Nonetheless, I've naught to give thee. The matter underway is of Kaatrij and does not pertain to thee nor the other Houses. If well thou regardest this House, keep clear of this. Enjoy our fruitful world, assist our grateful citizens, be regaled by what gifts we yet may give. Do not pry. This I beseech you, for our sake and for thine: do not be tempted by our secrets' jaws.|227|0
units.english: 'Tis good of thee, captain, that thou soughtest me out upon learning of this recent incident. Thine instincts do thee justice. Nonetheless, I've naught to give thee. The matter underway is of Kaatrij and does not pertain to thee nor the other Houses. If well thou regardest this House, keep clear of this. Enjoy our fruitful world, assist our grateful citizens, be regaled by what gifts we yet may give. Do not pry. This I beseech you, for our sake and for thine: do not be tempted by our secrets' jaws.
units.italian: 'È cosa buona da parte tua, capitano, che tu m'abbia cercato dopo aver saputo di questo recente incidente. I tuoi istinti ti fanno onore. Nondimeno, nulla ho da darti. La faccenda in corso riguarda Kaatrij e non tocca te né le altre Casate. Se bene hai in stima questa Casa, tieniti lontano da ciò. Goditi il nostro fertile mondo, assisti i nostri grati cittadini, lasciati rallegrare dai doni che ancora possiamo darti. Non frugare. Questo ti supplico, per il nostro bene e per il tuo: non farti tentare dalle fauci dei nostri segreti.'

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 3|	This I myself attest as K- I- Saajret, of Somber Sejra.|228|0
units.english: This I myself attest as K- I- Saajret, of Somber Sejra.
units.italian: Questo io stesso attesto come K- I- Saajret, di Somber Sejra.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 1|name|235|0
units.english: Assist House Seineq
units.italian: Assisti Casa Seineq

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 1|description|241|0
units.english: House Seineq would like to meet you at <destination>.
units.italian: Casa Seineq vorrebbe incontrarti su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 1|Soon after you exit your ship on this planet, you are discreetly pulled aside by a trio of Successor military officers. Their leader splays their arms gently in greeting. "Honored captain," they say, "We've come to inform thee that the noble House Seineq requests thy presence for the purposes of lending aid to their ally, the wounded House Kaatrij."|250|0
units.english: Soon after you exit your ship on this planet, you are discreetly pulled aside by a trio of Successor military officers. Their leader splays their arms gently in greeting. "Honored captain," they say, "We've come to inform thee that the noble House Seineq requests thy presence for the purposes of lending aid to their ally, the wounded House Kaatrij."
units.italian: Poco dopo essere sceso dalla nave su questo pianeta, vieni discretamente tirato da parte da tre ufficiali militari Successori. Il loro capo apre le braccia con delicatezza in segno di saluto. "Onorato capitano," dice, "siamo venuti a informarti che la nobile Casa Seineq richiede la tua presenza per portare aiuto alla loro alleata, la ferita Casa Kaatrij."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 1|Soon after you exit your ship, you are pulled aside by a trio of Successor military officers; unlike most here, they are not wearing House Kaatrij's colors. Their leader splays their arms gently in greeting. "Honored captain," they say, "and friend to Kaatrij. The noble House Seineq would request thy presence at a nearby offworld staging post to aid our assistance efforts to our mutual ally."|254|0
units.english: Soon after you exit your ship, you are pulled aside by a trio of Successor military officers; unlike most here, they are not wearing House Kaatrij's colors. Their leader splays their arms gently in greeting. "Honored captain," they say, "and friend to Kaatrij. The noble House Seineq would request thy presence at a nearby offworld staging post to aid our assistance efforts to our mutual ally."
units.italian: Poco dopo essere sceso dalla nave, vieni tirato da parte da tre ufficiali militari Successori; a differenza dei più, non indossano i colori di Casa Kaatrij. Il loro capo apre le braccia con delicatezza in segno di saluto. "Onorato capitano," dice, "e amico di Kaatrij. La nobile Casa Seineq richiederebbe la tua presenza in un vicino avamposto fuori mondo, per dare aiuto ai nostri sforzi a sostegno della nostra alleata comune."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 1|	"Wouldn't it be easier if you coordinated your efforts from here?"|258|0
units.english: "Wouldn't it be easier if you coordinated your efforts from here?"
units.italian: "Non sarebbe più facile se coordinaste gli sforzi da qui?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 1|	"Where do I need to go?"|262|0
units.english: "Where do I need to go?"
units.italian: "Dove devo andare?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 1|	"What sort of aid?"|264|0
units.english: "What sort of aid?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di aiuto?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 1|	"What's in it for me?"|266|0
units.english: "What's in it for me?"
units.italian: "Che ci guadagno?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 1|	"Naturally," says the lead officer, their skin bristling a little, "thou canst expect payment for thy services. The details shall be discussed with thee upon arrival." They hand over a data-sphere which highlights the <system> system and leave you to your business with a curt goodbye.|267|0
units.english: "Naturally," says the lead officer, their skin bristling a little, "thou canst expect payment for thy services. The details shall be discussed with thee upon arrival." They hand over a data-sphere which highlights the <system> system and leave you to your business with a curt goodbye.
units.italian: "Naturalmente," dice l'ufficiale capo, con la pelle che si irrigidisce un poco, "puoi aspettarti un pagamento per i tuoi servizi. I dettagli ti saranno discussi all'arrivo." Consegna una sfera di dati che evidenzia il sistema <system> e ti lascia ai tuoi affari con un congedo secco.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 1|	"Indeed," says the lead officer, "but Kaatrij is presently understandably reluctant to permit the other Houses even temporary constructions on their homeworld. Details shall be provided upon thine arrival." They hand over a data-sphere which highlights the <system> system and leave you to your business with a curt but expectant goodbye.|270|0
units.english: "Indeed," says the lead officer, "but Kaatrij is presently understandably reluctant to permit the other Houses even temporary constructions on their homeworld. Details shall be provided upon thine arrival." They hand over a data-sphere which highlights the <system> system and leave you to your business with a curt but expectant goodbye.
units.italian: "Infatti," dice l'ufficiale capo, "ma Kaatrij è comprensibilmente restia a permettere alle altre Casate anche solo costruzioni temporanee sul loro mondo natale. I dettagli ti saranno forniti all'arrivo." Consegna una sfera di dati che evidenzia il sistema <system> e ti lascia ai tuoi affari con un congedo secco ma pieno di aspettative.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 1|	"'Tisn't for us to say," says the lead officer. "The details of thy task shall be revealed to thee upon thy visit." They hand you a data-sphere from a pocket in their uniform; it splashes to highlight the <system> system and the officers bid you a curt goodbye.|273|0
units.english: "'Tisn't for us to say," says the lead officer. "The details of thy task shall be revealed to thee upon thy visit." They hand you a data-sphere from a pocket in their uniform; it splashes to highlight the <system> system and the officers bid you a curt goodbye.
units.italian: "Non sta a noi dirlo," dice l'ufficiale capo. "I dettagli del tuo compito ti saranno rivelati alla tua visita." Ti consegna una sfera di dati da una tasca dell'uniforme; si apre a schizzo per evidenziare il sistema <system> e gli ufficiali ti dicono un congedo secco.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 1|	The lead officer hands you a Successor data-sphere from a pocket in their uniform; it splashes open as soon as you touch it to highlight the <system> system. "More details shall be provided t'thee upon thine arrival," the officer says, before splaying their arms in a polite goodbye.|276|0
units.english: The lead officer hands you a Successor data-sphere from a pocket in their uniform; it splashes open as soon as you touch it to highlight the <system> system. "More details shall be provided t'thee upon thine arrival," the officer says, before splaying their arms in a polite goodbye.
units.italian: L'ufficiale capo ti consegna una sfera di dati Successore da una tasca dell'uniforme; si apre a schizzo appena la tocchi per evidenziare il sistema <system>. "Altri dettagli ti saranno forniti all'arrivo," dice l'ufficiale, prima di aprire le braccia in un saluto cortese.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|name|281|0
units.english: Deploy sensor drones
units.italian: Schiera i droni sensore

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|description|288|0
units.english: House Seineq is concerned that the incident at Qasa-Sija-Iri may be the doing of parties from the other side of the wormhole, and have asked you to deploy a net of sensors in <waypoints> before returning to <destination>.
units.italian: Casa Seineq teme che l'incidente di Qasa-Sija-Iri sia opera di forze dall'altra parte del cunicolo, e ti ha chiesto di schierare una rete di sensori in <waypoints> prima di tornare su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|The normally quiet industrial spaceport here has been overrun by another facility on its outskirts, a sea of temporary buildings made of white metallic fabric that ripples in the wet breeze. Repulsor-driven transports are setting up a variety of familiar and unfamiliar machinery throughout the new addition, and you watch as one unloads a shipment of what looks like planetary shield generators.|294|0
units.english: The normally quiet industrial spaceport here has been overrun by another facility on its outskirts, a sea of temporary buildings made of white metallic fabric that ripples in the wet breeze. Repulsor-driven transports are setting up a variety of familiar and unfamiliar machinery throughout the new addition, and you watch as one unloads a shipment of what looks like planetary shield generators.
units.italian: L'abitualmente quieto spazioporto industriale qui è stato sommerso da un'altra struttura ai suoi margini: un mare di edifici temporanei di tessuto metallico bianco che ondeggia nella brezza umida. Trasporti a repulsione stanno montando macchinari familiari e non familiari in tutta la nuova aggiunta, e vedi uno scaricare un carico di quelli che sembrano generatori di scudi planetari.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	You are met in the spaceport soon after by a distinctly stressed-looking Successor who instructs you to follow them to one of the tents in the new area. It turns out to be surprisingly comfortable and well-featured inside, and as you wait, you have to try your best to avoid the overhead mist generators. Eventually, another pair of Successors enter from the same door you did and introduce themselves to you.|295|0
units.english: You are met in the spaceport soon after by a distinctly stressed-looking Successor who instructs you to follow them to one of the tents in the new area. It turns out to be surprisingly comfortable and well-featured inside, and as you wait, you have to try your best to avoid the overhead mist generators. Eventually, another pair of Successors enter from the same door you did and introduce themselves to you.
units.italian: Poco dopo, allo spazioporto, ti incontra un Successore dall'aria decisamente tesa, che ti dice di seguirlo a una delle tende della nuova area. Dentro si rivela sorprendentemente comoda e ben attrezzata, e mentre aspetti devi fare del tuo meglio per evitare i generatori di nebbia sul soffitto. Alla fine, un'altra coppia di Successori entra dalla stessa porta da cui sei entrato tu e si presenta.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"Captain, captain, we lament thy wait. I am Sijra and this," they say, gesturing to the other, "is Rijatet." Rijatet offers a short splay of the arms on hearing their name. "We represent House Seineq here."|296|0
units.english: "Captain, captain, we lament thy wait. I am Sijra and this," they say, gesturing to the other, "is Rijatet." Rijatet offers a short splay of the arms on hearing their name. "We represent House Seineq here."
units.italian: "Capitano, capitano, ci duole la tua attesa. Io sono Sijra e questo," dice, indicando l'altro, "è Rijatet." Rijatet offre una breve apertura delle braccia sentendo il proprio nome. "Rappresentiamo Casa Seineq, qui."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"What do you want from me?"|298|0
units.english: "What do you want from me?"
units.italian: "Che cosa volete da me?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"Did Seineq establish all this?"|300|0
units.english: "Did Seineq establish all this?"
units.italian: "È stata Seineq a mettere in piedi tutto questo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"What is this place?"|301|0
units.english: "What is this place?"
units.italian: "Che posto è questo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	Sijra nods as colors swim over their body. "A temporary post, approv'd by the New's combined navy. In times as these, 'tis a boon to watch over these oft-forgotten systems."|302|0
units.english: Sijra nods as colors swim over their body. "A temporary post, approv'd by the New's combined navy. In times as these, 'tis a boon to watch over these oft-forgotten systems."
units.italian: Sijra annuisce mentre i colori nuotano sul loro corpo. "Un avamposto temporaneo, approvato dalla marina congiunta delle Nuove. In tempi come questi è un bene vegliare su questi sistemi spesso dimenticati."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	Rijatet interjects. "'Tisn't why thou'rt here, though." Sijra hums gently at this, and they slither under one of the mist generators, writhing a little as if to get comfortable.|303|0
units.english: Rijatet interjects. "'Tisn't why thou'rt here, though." Sijra hums gently at this, and they slither under one of the mist generators, writhing a little as if to get comfortable.
units.italian: Rijatet interviene. "Non è per questo che sei qui, però." Sijra canticchia piano a queste parole, e scivolano sotto uno dei generatori di nebbia, contorcendosi un po' come per mettersi comodi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"Our ally, Kaatrij," says Sijra, "has ceased their internal messages to us, and the rest of the New. But even if they do not wish to share, we can derive our own answers well enough."|305|0
units.english: "Our ally, Kaatrij," says Sijra, "has ceased their internal messages to us, and the rest of the New. But even if they do not wish to share, we can derive our own answers well enough."
units.italian: "La nostra alleata, Kaatrij," dice Sijra, "ha interrotto i suoi messaggi interni a noi e al resto delle Nuove. Ma anche se non vogliono condividere, possiamo ricavare le nostre risposte abbastanza bene."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"This was an attack," says Rijatet. Their voice is low and rumbly, like rocks rolling down a hill. "Kaatrij would not close up otherwise. They do not trust the other Houses. They never have. They think another House has wounded them."|306|0
units.english: "This was an attack," says Rijatet. Their voice is low and rumbly, like rocks rolling down a hill. "Kaatrij would not close up otherwise. They do not trust the other Houses. They never have. They think another House has wounded them."
units.italian: "Questo è stato un attacco," dice Rijatet. La loro voce è bassa e cupa, come sassi che rotolano giù per una collina. "Kaatrij non si chiuderebbe altrimenti. Non si fidano delle altre Casate. Mai si sono fidati. Pensano che un'altra Casa li abbia feriti."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"And thou, captain, thou'rt a... free element. Thy place in this can't be eas'ly divined. We can handle one alien, and their host, but canst not be sure thyself is all we have to reckon with." Waves of color run over Sijra's body, and one of their legs twitches gently against the floor.|307|0
units.english: "And thou, captain, thou'rt a... free element. Thy place in this can't be eas'ly divined. We can handle one alien, and their host, but canst not be sure thyself is all we have to reckon with." Waves of color run over Sijra's body, and one of their legs twitches gently against the floor.
units.italian: "E tu, capitano, sei un... elemento libero. Il tuo posto in questo non si può facilmente divinare. Possiamo gestire un alieno, e il suo ospite, ma non possiamo essere certi che tu sia tutto ciò con cui dobbiamo fare i conti." Onde di colore corrono sul corpo di Sijra, e una delle loro zampe si scuote piano contro il pavimento.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"Are you saying you think this is some prelude to alien invasion?"|309|0
units.english: "Are you saying you think this is some prelude to alien invasion?"
units.italian: "Stai dicendo che pensi sia un preludio a un'invasione aliena?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"Are you saying you think that another House attacked Kaatrij?"|310|0
units.english: "Are you saying you think that another House attacked Kaatrij?"
units.italian: "Stai dicendo che pensi che un'altra Casata abbia attaccato Kaatrij?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	Sijra wriggles. "No. Not necessarily. Just that we are in need of information and wish to ensure that thou canst be relied upon to provide it. So," says Sijra, "we have for thee a task. We will load sensors onto thy craft that can be deployed'n the other side of the wormhole, 'round the disconnected stars where our ships can't travel. If this is the work of some meddling alien force thinking cloaks and a jump drive make them gods, then we will know it, and we will show them their folly.|311|0
units.english: Sijra wriggles. "No. Not necessarily. Just that we are in need of information and wish to ensure that thou canst be relied upon to provide it. So," says Sijra, "we have for thee a task. We will load sensors onto thy craft that can be deployed'n the other side of the wormhole, 'round the disconnected stars where our ships can't travel. If this is the work of some meddling alien force thinking cloaks and a jump drive make them gods, then we will know it, and we will show them their folly.
units.italian: Sijra si contorce. "No. Non necessariamente. Solo che abbiamo bisogno di informazioni e vogliamo assicurarci che si possa contare su di te per fornirle. Così," dice Sijra, "abbiamo un compito per te. Caricheremo sulla tua nave dei sensori che potranno essere schierati dall'altra parte del cunicolo, intorno alle stelle isolate dove le nostre navi non possono viaggiare. Se questa è opera di qualche forza aliena impicciona che crede che mantelli e un motore di salto la rendano divina, allora lo sapremo, e mostreremo loro la loro follia.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"And what if it isn't?"|313|0
units.english: "And what if it isn't?"
units.italian: "E se non lo fosse?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"So you can penetrate cloaks?"|315|0
units.english: "So you can penetrate cloaks?"
units.italian: "Quindi sapete penetrare i mantelli?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"And what if I refuse?"|317|0
units.english: "And what if I refuse?"
units.italian: "E se rifiutassi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|label|320|0
units.english: isn't
units.italian: isn't

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"Then," Sijra says, "we shall have to determine which of our Houses is threatening war." Rijatet hums at that, bunching up two of their arms and regarding you with piercing eyes.|321|0
units.english: "Then," Sijra says, "we shall have to determine which of our Houses is threatening war." Rijatet hums at that, bunching up two of their arms and regarding you with piercing eyes.
units.italian: "Allora," dice Sijra, "dovremo determinare quale delle nostre Casate minaccia la guerra." Rijatet canticchia a quelle parole, stringendo due delle loro braccia e guardandoti con occhi penetranti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"Very well, I'll deploy your sensors."|323|0
units.english: "Very well, I'll deploy your sensors."
units.italian: "Va bene, schiererò i vostri sensori."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"I'm not interested in being a part of this."|325|0
units.english: "I'm not interested in being a part of this."
units.italian: "Non m'interessa far parte di questo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	Pink spots break out over Rijatet's body. "We would not tell thee either way. But never in thirty thousand years have we or our Predecessors met a race with drives like yours that could camouflage their imprint on the weave of space. Listen well enough, and when they jump, it will always be there."|331|0
units.english: Pink spots break out over Rijatet's body. "We would not tell thee either way. But never in thirty thousand years have we or our Predecessors met a race with drives like yours that could camouflage their imprint on the weave of space. Listen well enough, and when they jump, it will always be there."
units.italian: Macchie rosa esplodono sul corpo di Rijatet. "In un caso o nell'altro non te lo diremmo. Ma in trentamila anni né noi né i nostri Predecessori abbiamo mai incontrato una razza con motori come i tuoi, capaci di mimetizzare la loro impronta nella trama dello spazio. Ascolta bene, e quando salteranno, ci sarà sempre."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"And what if the threat is more close to home?"|333|0
units.english: "And what if the threat is more close to home?"
units.italian: "E se la minaccia fosse più vicina a casa?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"Very well, then, I'll deploy your sensors."|335|0
units.english: "Very well, then, I'll deploy your sensors."
units.italian: "Va bene, allora, schiererò i vostri sensori."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"I'm not interested in being a part of this."|337|0
units.english: "I'm not interested in being a part of this."
units.italian: "Non m'interessa far parte di questo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"We won't cage thee, Captain," says Sijra. "Thou art not our vassal, nor our responsibility. But each day of this disruption, thy liability to thy patron - to the Houses all - grows. An alien swims into our pool and soon after, a House is bombed? Thou art an article of suspicion and concern. An opportunity like this will not come again for thee, methinks."|341|0
units.english: "We won't cage thee, Captain," says Sijra. "Thou art not our vassal, nor our responsibility. But each day of this disruption, thy liability to thy patron - to the Houses all - grows. An alien swims into our pool and soon after, a House is bombed? Thou art an article of suspicion and concern. An opportunity like this will not come again for thee, methinks."
units.italian: "Non ti metteremo in gabbia, capitano," dice Sijra. "Non sei nostro vassallo, né nostra responsabilità. Ma ogni giorno di questa crisi cresce il tuo peso verso il tuo patrono - verso tutte le Casate. Un alieno nuota nella nostra pozza e poco dopo una Casa viene bombardata? Sei un oggetto di sospetto e preoccupazione. Un'opportunità come questa non ti capiterà di nuovo, a parer mio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"Very well, then, I'll deploy your sensors."|343|0
units.english: "Very well, then, I'll deploy your sensors."
units.italian: "Va bene, allora, schiererò i vostri sensori."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"Then why contact me if you're so suspicious?"|345|0
units.english: "Then why contact me if you're so suspicious?"
units.italian: "Allora perché mi avete contattato, se siete così sospettosi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"I'm still not interested in being part of this."|347|0
units.english: "I'm still not interested in being part of this."
units.italian: "Continuo a non avere interesse a far parte di questo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	Sijra and Rijatet each turn a slightly different shade of blue. "Very well," says Sijra. "Farewell."|348|0
units.english: Sijra and Rijatet each turn a slightly different shade of blue. "Very well," says Sijra. "Farewell."
units.italian: Sijra e Rijatet virano ciascuno a una tonalità di blu leggermente diversa. "Va bene," dice Sijra. "Addio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	Rijatet makes a noise sort of like chuckling. "Peril and opportunity oft travel arm-in-arm," they say. "Canst thou blame us for keeping our objects of suspicion close, that they might one day become our allies?"|352|0
units.english: Rijatet makes a noise sort of like chuckling. "Peril and opportunity oft travel arm-in-arm," they say. "Canst thou blame us for keeping our objects of suspicion close, that they might one day become our allies?"
units.italian: Rijatet emette un suono che assomiglia a una risata soffocata. "Pericolo e opportunità spesso viaggiano a braccetto," dice. "Puoi biasimarci se teniamo vicini i nostri oggetti di sospetto, perché un giorno diventino nostri alleati?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"All right, I'll do it."|354|0
units.english: "All right, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"You'll have to find a different ally for this."|356|0
units.english: "You'll have to find a different ally for this."
units.italian: "Dovrete trovare un altro alleato per questo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	Sijra and Rijatet each turn a slightly different shade of blue. "Very well," says Sijra. "Farewell."|357|0
units.english: Sijra and Rijatet each turn a slightly different shade of blue. "Very well," says Sijra. "Farewell."
units.italian: Sijra e Rijatet virano ciascuno a una tonalità di blu leggermente diversa. "Va bene," dice Sijra. "Addio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	Both of the two seem to relax a bit when you say this, their arms showing a little more slack. Sijra notes down something on a metallic pad that they take out of their outfit, before informing you that they've ordered the sensor drones to be transferred to the <ship>. "Once thy task is done, Captain, return here and we shall have thy next opportunity for usefulness."|361|0
units.english: Both of the two seem to relax a bit when you say this, their arms showing a little more slack. Sijra notes down something on a metallic pad that they take out of their outfit, before informing you that they've ordered the sensor drones to be transferred to the <ship>. "Once thy task is done, Captain, return here and we shall have thy next opportunity for usefulness."
units.italian: Sembrano entrambi rilassarsi un poco quando dici questo, le braccia un po' più distese. Sijra annota qualcosa su una tavoletta metallica che tira fuori dal suo abito, prima di informarti che ha ordinato il trasferimento dei droni sensore sulla <ship>. "Quando il tuo compito sarà compiuto, capitano, torna qui e avremo per te la prossima occasione di essere utile."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"And of course Seineq means to make this worth your while," says Rijatet. "Thou shalt be compensated with a fee of <payment> upon completion. We are not at liberty to negotiate this."|362|0
units.english: "And of course Seineq means to make this worth your while," says Rijatet. "Thou shalt be compensated with a fee of <payment> upon completion. We are not at liberty to negotiate this."
units.italian: "E naturalmente Seineq intende renderlo degno del tuo tempo," dice Rijatet. "Sarai compensato con una somma di <payment> al completamento. Non siamo in facoltà di negoziarla."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|dialog|366|0
units.english: You release one of House Seineq's scanners, which orients itself with small thrusters before nestling into low planetary orbit.
units.italian: Rilasci uno degli scanner di Casa Seineq, che si orienta con piccoli propulsori prima di annidarsi in orbita planetaria bassa.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|dialog|368|0
units.english: You eject one of the scanners into space here at the northernmost reach of the Predecessors' region.
units.italian: Espelli uno degli scanner nello spazio qui, all'estremità settentrionale della regione dei Predecessori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|dialog|370|0
units.english: You release one of the scanners from your cargo hold, letting it disappear in the glare of this system's enormous star.
units.italian: Rilasci uno degli scanner dalla stiva, lasciandolo sparire nel bagliore della stella enorme di questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|dialog|372|0
units.english: You eject one of the scanners, which proceeds into a close solar orbit. Perhaps the gravity well helps shield it from the destructive spatial phenomena here.
units.italian: Espelli uno degli scanner, che procede verso un'orbita solare ravvicinata. Forse il pozzo gravitazionale aiuta a schermarlo dai fenomeni spaziali distruttivi di qui.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|Docking control at the <planet> spaceport directs the <ship> to a protected, fabric-shrouded hangar on the western side of the new facility. A pair of Successor ground crews supervise the automated refueling and maintenance processes, and one of them waves you down from the cockpit, where they hand you a data-sphere. A few seconds after it touches your skin, it plays a message from Rijatet:|379|0
units.english: Docking control at the <planet> spaceport directs the <ship> to a protected, fabric-shrouded hangar on the western side of the new facility. A pair of Successor ground crews supervise the automated refueling and maintenance processes, and one of them waves you down from the cockpit, where they hand you a data-sphere. A few seconds after it touches your skin, it plays a message from Rijatet:
units.italian: Il controllo di attracco dello spazioporto di <planet> indirizza la <ship> a un hangar protetto e avvolto di tessuto sul lato occidentale della nuova struttura. Una coppia di squadre di terra Successori sovrintende al rifornimento e alla manutenzione automatici, e uno di loro ti fa cenno dalla cabina di pilotaggio, porgendoti una sfera di dati. Pochi secondi dopo che tocca la tua pelle, trasmette un messaggio di Rijatet:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	"Our thanks to thee for setting the sensors, Captain. We saw their first reports only shortly after thy own craft jumped away, and nothing since. We shall remain as watchful as we ought to be. For thine efforts, Seineq's credited thee the agreed payment of <payment>. If thou wishest for further, join us at the port here tonight for another task."|380|0
units.english: "Our thanks to thee for setting the sensors, Captain. We saw their first reports only shortly after thy own craft jumped away, and nothing since. We shall remain as watchful as we ought to be. For thine efforts, Seineq's credited thee the agreed payment of <payment>. If thou wishest for further, join us at the port here tonight for another task."
units.italian: "La nostra gratitudine per aver schierato i sensori, capitano. Abbiamo visto i loro primi rapporti poco dopo che la tua nave è saltata via, e nulla da allora. Resteremo vigili come dobbiamo. Per i tuoi sforzi, Seineq ti ha accreditato il pagamento concordato di <payment>. Se ne desideri altri, unisciti a noi al porto qui stasera per un altro incarico."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|	I attest this, A- T- Rijatet.|381|0
units.english: I attest this, A- T- Rijatet.
units.italian: Questo io attesto, A- T- Rijatet.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 2|log|383|0
units.english: Deployed Successor sensor drones throughout Predecessor space to scan for ships using jump drives, cloaked or not.
units.italian: Hai schierato droni sensore Successori in tutto lo spazio dei Predecessori per scansionare navi che usano motori di salto, con o senza mantello.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 3a Sioeora|name|389|0
units.english: Inform House Sioeora
units.italian: Informa Casa Sioeora

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 3a Sioeora|description|390|0
units.english: Contact House Sioeora about Seineq asking you to investigate.
units.italian: Contatta Casa Sioeora riguardo alla richiesta di Seineq di indagare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 3a Sioeora|Once you have landed, your ship's communications system chirps with a new message delivered from House Sioeora:|403|0
units.english: Once you have landed, your ship's communications system chirps with a new message delivered from House Sioeora:
units.italian: Una volta atterrato, il sistema di comunicazioni della nave cinguetta con un nuovo messaggio consegnato da Casa Sioeora:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 3a Sioeora|	Honored captain <first> <last>, Sioeora once again calls thee 'ally' with pride and confidence in thy discretion and fair judgment. Thou mayst proceed as thou pleasest with Seineq's scheme - it concerns us little what they plan to do in sealed-off space, so long as they recognize that Sioeora and the rest shall keep our eyes upon their actions. Should Seineq, in foolishness, resolve to some act of aggression, they shall find we and our allies eager to correct their errant course.|404|0
units.english: Honored captain <first> <last>, Sioeora once again calls thee 'ally' with pride and confidence in thy discretion and fair judgment. Thou mayst proceed as thou pleasest with Seineq's scheme - it concerns us little what they plan to do in sealed-off space, so long as they recognize that Sioeora and the rest shall keep our eyes upon their actions. Should Seineq, in foolishness, resolve to some act of aggression, they shall find we and our allies eager to correct their errant course.
units.italian: Onorato capitano <first> <last>, Sioeora ti chiama ancora 'alleato' con orgoglio e fiducia nella tua discrezione e nel tuo giusto giudizio. Puoi procedere come preferisci con il piano di Seineq: ci importa poco di cosa intendano fare nello spazio sigillato, purché riconoscano che Sioeora e le altre terranno gli occhi sulle loro azioni. Se Seineq, per stoltezza, decidesse qualche atto di aggressione, troverà noi e i nostri alleati pronti a correggere il loro corso errante.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 3a Sioeora|	In confirmation of this message, I do myself attest: I- C- N-, on behalf of honored scion Riijaaora E- Sioeora of their noble House.|405|0
units.english: In confirmation of this message, I do myself attest: I- C- N-, on behalf of honored scion Riijaaora E- Sioeora of their noble House.
units.italian: A conferma di questo messaggio, io stesso attesto: I- C- N-, per conto dell'onorato erede Riijaaora E- Sioeora della loro nobile Casa.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 3b Kaatrij|name|411|0
units.english: Inform House Kaatrij
units.italian: Informa Casa Kaatrij

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 3b Kaatrij|description|412|0
units.english: Contact House Kaatrij about Seineq asking you to investigate.
units.italian: Contatta Casa Kaatrij riguardo alla richiesta di Seineq di indagare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 3b Kaatrij|Once you have landed, your ship's communications system chirps with a new message delivered from House Kaatrij:|425|0
units.english: Once you have landed, your ship's communications system chirps with a new message delivered from House Kaatrij:
units.italian: Una volta atterrato, il sistema di comunicazioni della nave cinguetta con un nuovo messaggio consegnato da Casa Kaatrij:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 3b Kaatrij|	<first> <last>, our thanks for thy contact. It has been received amicably. Because of a recent accident on a territorial possession of House Kaatrij, many missives we receive currently go unanswered. Shouldst thou not receive further contact on this matter, we implore thee to stay thy disappointment.|426|0
units.english: <first> <last>, our thanks for thy contact. It has been received amicably. Because of a recent accident on a territorial possession of House Kaatrij, many missives we receive currently go unanswered. Shouldst thou not receive further contact on this matter, we implore thee to stay thy disappointment.
units.italian: <first> <last>, la nostra gratitudine per il tuo contatto. È stato ricevuto in amicizia. A causa di un recente incidente su un possesso territoriale di Casa Kaatrij, molte missive che riceviamo restano al momento senza risposta. Se non dovessi ricevere altri contatti in merito, ti preghiamo di trattenere la delusione.

units.id: conversation:successor house contact|After you were asked to deploy sensor drones by House Seineq, it might be prudent to contact your patron House to update them about this development.|430|0
units.english: After you were asked to deploy sensor drones by House Seineq, it might be prudent to contact your patron House to update them about this development.
units.italian: Dopo che Casa Seineq ti ha chiesto di schierare i droni sensore, potrebbe essere prudente contattare la tua Casa patrona per aggiornarla su questo sviluppo.

units.id: conversation:successor house contact|	(Yes.)|432|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: conversation:successor house contact|	(No.)|433|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: conversation:successor house contact|	You find your way to the local spaceport's communication hub, where you check out one of the Successors' data-spheres to encode your message for delivery to your patron House. When you're done, you submerge the data-sphere into a liquid-metal bath that pushes it around for a few moments before spitting it back at you, quietly chirping "missive sent."|437|0
units.english: You find your way to the local spaceport's communication hub, where you check out one of the Successors' data-spheres to encode your message for delivery to your patron House. When you're done, you submerge the data-sphere into a liquid-metal bath that pushes it around for a few moments before spitting it back at you, quietly chirping "missive sent."
units.italian: Trovi la strada fino all'hub delle comunicazioni dello spazioporto locale, dove prelevi una delle sfere di dati dei Successori per cifrare il tuo messaggio da consegnare alla tua Casa patrona. Quando hai finito, immergi la sfera in un bagno di metallo liquido che la spinge in giro per qualche momento prima di risputartela, cinguettando piano "missiva inviata".

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|description|444|0
units.english: Investigators from House Seineq want you to report back your dealings with the other High Houses.
units.italian: Investigatori di Casa Seineq vogliono che tu riferisca dei tuoi rapporti con le altre Casate Alte.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|Soon after you re-enter the spaceport, a Successor there directs you to the same room in which you met with Sijra and Rijatet before, and just as before, the two of them enter a few minutes later.|450|0
units.english: Soon after you re-enter the spaceport, a Successor there directs you to the same room in which you met with Sijra and Rijatet before, and just as before, the two of them enter a few minutes later.
units.italian: Poco dopo che rientri nello spazioporto, un Successore ti indirizza alla stessa stanza in cui hai incontrato Sijra e Rijatet, e come prima i due entrano qualche minuto dopo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|	"A pleasure t'see thee again after thy fruitful voyage, Captain," says Sijra. They wriggle under one of the mist generators. "We've a second task for thee. Thou art, as we explained before, a more neutral being here. If another House were to contact thee and ask for help as we have-"|451|0
units.english: "A pleasure t'see thee again after thy fruitful voyage, Captain," says Sijra. They wriggle under one of the mist generators. "We've a second task for thee. Thou art, as we explained before, a more neutral being here. If another House were to contact thee and ask for help as we have-"
units.italian: "Un piacere rivederti dopo il tuo fruttuoso viaggio, capitano," dice Sijra. Si dimena sotto uno dei generatori di nebbia. "Abbiamo un secondo compito per te. Sei, come ti abbiamo spiegato, un essere più neutrale qui. Se un'altra Casata ti contattasse e chiedesse aiuto come abbiamo fatto noi-"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|	"Perhaps they already have," notes Rijatet.|452|0
units.english: "Perhaps they already have," notes Rijatet.
units.italian: "Forse l'hanno già fatto," osserva Rijatet.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|	"Then in providing it, thou mayst see things our forces might not be privy to."|453|0
units.english: "Then in providing it, thou mayst see things our forces might not be privy to."
units.italian: "Allora, fornendolo, potresti vedere cose a cui le nostre forze non hanno accesso."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|	"Are you asking me to spy for you?"|455|0
units.english: "Are you asking me to spy for you?"
units.italian: "Mi stai chiedendo di spiare per voi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|	"Get to the point, please."|457|0
units.english: "Get to the point, please."
units.italian: "Vieni al punto, per favore."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|	Sirja moves their head a little closer to you. "If and when another House contracts thee for some purpose that thou suspectest in any way, make note of it. Tell us and we shall pay thee a fair sum for thy time and effort."|458|0
units.english: Sirja moves their head a little closer to you. "If and when another House contracts thee for some purpose that thou suspectest in any way, make note of it. Tell us and we shall pay thee a fair sum for thy time and effort."
units.italian: Sijra avvicina un po' la testa a te. "Se e quando un'altra Casata ti ingaggia per qualcosa che in qualche modo ti insospettisce, prendine nota. Dillo a noi e ti pagheremo una somma equa per il tuo tempo e il tuo impegno."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|	A faint pink color forms at the tips of Sirja's arms, though what exactly this connotes you cannot tell. "No, Captain. That is not thy art, methinks. We only ask thee to be attentive in thy duties, and to tell us of anything untoward."|462|0
units.english: A faint pink color forms at the tips of Sirja's arms, though what exactly this connotes you cannot tell. "No, Captain. That is not thy art, methinks. We only ask thee to be attentive in thy duties, and to tell us of anything untoward."
units.italian: Un rosa tenue si forma sulle punte delle braccia di Sijra, anche se non sai dire cosa significhi esattamente. "No, capitano. Quella non è la tua arte, a parer mio. Ti chiediamo solo di essere attento nei tuoi doveri, e di dirci qualsiasi cosa fuori posto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|	"Very well."|465|0
units.english: "Very well."
units.italian: "Va bene."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|	"I've had enough of this. No."|467|0
units.english: "I've had enough of this. No."
units.italian: "Ne ho abbastanza di questa storia. No."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|	The two Successors eye you, a shade of blue slowly creeping over their skin. "Disappointing, Captain. But it is thy own decision."|468|0
units.english: The two Successors eye you, a shade of blue slowly creeping over their skin. "Disappointing, Captain. But it is thy own decision."
units.italian: I due Successori ti guardano, e una tonalità di blu striscia lentamente sulla loro pelle. "Deludente, capitano. Ma è una tua decisione."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|log|473|0
units.english: Accepted an offer by House Seineq to report back my dealings with the other Houses, and whether I observe anything incriminating.
units.italian: Hai accettato l'offerta di Casa Seineq di riferire dei tuoi rapporti con le altre Casate, e di qualsiasi cosa incriminante che osservi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 4|	"Excellent!" says Rijtatet. "In that case, Sijra and I have nothing further for thee. We shall call thee back when we are ready for thy report."|474|0
units.english: "Excellent!" says Rijtatet. "In that case, Sijra and I have nothing further for thee. We shall call thee back when we are ready for thy report."
units.italian: "Eccellente!" dice Rijtatet. "In tal caso, Sijra e io non abbiamo altro per te. Ti richiameremo quando saremo pronti per il tuo rapporto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Mark Houses|name|482|0
units.english: Investigate the other High Houses
units.italian: Indaga sulle altre Casate Alte

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Mark Houses|description|483|0
units.english: House Seineq is interested in what tasks the other Houses might offer a free agent. Their homeworlds would be a good place to investigate their activities.
units.italian: Casa Seineq è interessata a quali incarichi le altre Casate potrebbero offrire a un agente libero. I loro mondi natali sarebbero un buon posto per indagare sulle loro attività.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Seineq Attacked|As you disembark into this planet's spaceport, you can feel a new and heightened tension in the air. In an unsettling mirror of the immediate aftermath of the attack on Kaatrij's base, the Successors here all stand crowded around the spaceport's screens, watching as news comes in of a second attack. This time, however, the image shown on the displays is one you recognize: it's the base on Shassa-Wyra-Orrou from which you worked with House Seineq.|510|0
units.english: As you disembark into this planet's spaceport, you can feel a new and heightened tension in the air. In an unsettling mirror of the immediate aftermath of the attack on Kaatrij's base, the Successors here all stand crowded around the spaceport's screens, watching as news comes in of a second attack. This time, however, the image shown on the displays is one you recognize: it's the base on Shassa-Wyra-Orrou from which you worked with House Seineq.
units.italian: Mentre sbarchi nello spazioporto di questo pianeta, senti nell'aria una tensione nuova e più acuta. In uno specchio inquietante delle conseguenze immediate dell'attacco alla base di Kaatrij, i Successori qui sono tutti ammassati intorno agli schermi dello spazioporto, a guardare le notizie di un secondo attacco. Questa volta, però, l'immagine sui display è una che riconosci: è la base su Shassa-Wyra-Orrou, quella da cui hai lavorato con Casa Seineq.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Seineq Attacked|	"...reports, yet confirmed, that several ships were seen, soonafter retreating under veil of cloak," the reporter on the displays says. "Much suspicion now falls to noble House Kaatrij for using such technol'gies in the past, ones they once had sworn they left behind."|511|0
units.english: "...reports, yet confirmed, that several ships were seen, soonafter retreating under veil of cloak," the reporter on the displays says. "Much suspicion now falls to noble House Kaatrij for using such technol'gies in the past, ones they once had sworn they left behind."
units.italian: "... rapporti, non ancora confermati, secondo cui diverse navi sono state viste, poco dopo ritirarsi sotto un velo di mantello," dice il cronista sui display. "Molti sospetti ora ricadono sulla nobile Casa Kaatrij, per aver usato in passato simili tecnologie, che un tempo avevano giurato di aver lasciato dietro di sé."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Seineq Attacked|	The Successors around the screen murmur and slither around each other. As the broadcast goes on and the crowd grows and the first casualty numbers begin to come in, the overlapping translated speech in your ears starts to smear together; you find yourself stumbling against a wall in the spaceport, only able to get up once you've momentarily plucked the translation device from your jacket.|512|0
units.english: The Successors around the screen murmur and slither around each other.
