As the broadcast goes on and the crowd grows and the first casualty numbers begin to come in, the overlapping translated speech in your ears starts to smear together; you find yourself stumbling against a wall in the spaceport, only able to get up once you've momentarily plucked the translation device from your jacket.
units.italian: I Successori intorno allo schermo mormorano e strisciano gli uni sugli altri. Mentre la trasmissione continua e la folla cresce e cominciano ad arrivare i primi numeri delle vittime, il parlato tradotto che ti si sovrappone nelle orecchie comincia a impastarsi; ti ritrovi a inciampare contro un muro dello spazioporto, capace di rialzarti solo dopo aver momentaneamente strappato il dispositivo di traduzione dalla giacca.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Seineq Memorial|While exploring House Seineq's spaceport here on <origin>, you take notice of a series of obelisks erected in the middle of one of the concourses; they weren't here the last time you visited. As you draw nearer, you can make out an inscription on a plaque that stands before them:|524|0
units.english: While exploring House Seineq's spaceport here on <origin>, you take notice of a series of obelisks erected in the middle of one of the concourses; they weren't here the last time you visited. As you draw nearer, you can make out an inscription on a plaque that stands before them:
units.italian: Mentre esplori lo spazioporto di Casa Seineq qui su <origin>, noti una serie di obelischi eretti in mezzo a uno dei corridoi; non c'erano l'ultima volta che sei passato. Avvicinandoti, riesci a leggere un'iscrizione su una targa che sta davanti a loro:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Seineq Memorial|	"In remembrance and grief we stand,|525|0
units.english: "In remembrance and grief we stand,
units.italian: "In ricordo e nel dolore ci ergiamo,

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Seineq Memorial|	reminders of the deaths of the|526|0
units.english: reminders of the deaths of the
units.italian: monito della morte dei

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Seineq Memorial|	eighteen killed in service of|527|0
units.english: eighteen killed in service of
units.italian: diciotto caduti al servizio della

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Seineq Memorial|	our noble House off'ring succor|528|0
units.english: our noble House off'ring succor
units.italian: nostra nobile Casa, che aiuto

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Seineq Memorial|	to its ally House Kaatrij."|529|0
units.english: to its ally House Kaatrij."
units.italian: portò alla sua alleata Casa Kaatrij."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Seineq Memorial|	(Pay your respects.)|531|0
units.english: (Pay your respects.)
units.italian: (Porgi i tuoi rispetti.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Seineq Memorial|	(Walk on.)|532|0
units.english: (Walk on.)
units.italian: (Prosegui.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Seineq Memorial|	You offer the memorial a few moments of quiet contemplation. On each of the pillars a name is engraved; though most you do not recognize, one is labeled "Asirij T- Rijatet."|534|0
units.english: You offer the memorial a few moments of quiet contemplation. On each of the pillars a name is engraved; though most you do not recognize, one is labeled "Asirij T- Rijatet."
units.italian: Offri al memoriale qualche momento di quieta contemplazione. Su ciascun pilastro è inciso un nome; la maggior parte non li riconosci, ma uno porta la scritta "Asirij T- Rijatet."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|name|544|0
units.english: Transport equipment for Kaatrij
units.italian: Trasporta attrezzatura per Kaatrij

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|description|545|0
units.english: Some scientific equipment belonging to House Kaatrij needs to return to <destination> by <date> as the House consolidates itself after its recent crises.
units.italian: Un'attrezzatura scientifica di Casa Kaatrij deve tornare su <destination> entro <date>, mentre la Casa si consolida dopo le sue recenti crisi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|Waiting in the spaceport here as you arrive is a trio of Successors comprising two guards and one other individual who wears a black, cocoon-like outfit with lots of pockets. Both of the guards bear the insignia of House Kaatrij.|562|0
units.english: Waiting in the spaceport here as you arrive is a trio of Successors comprising two guards and one other individual who wears a black, cocoon-like outfit with lots of pockets. Both of the guards bear the insignia of House Kaatrij.
units.italian: Ad aspettarti allo spazioporto, al tuo arrivo, ci sono tre Successori: due guardie e un altro individuo che indossa un abito nero, simile a un bozzolo, pieno di tasche. Entrambe le guardie portano l'insegna di Casa Kaatrij.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	The black-draped individual bows gently to you as green sparkles dot their skin. "Captain <first> <last>?" they say. When you indicate affirmatively, they continue. "I am Saajret, of Somber Sejra, an envoy of the noble scions of House Kaatrij. Kaatrij hopes that thou mightst do us a boon."|563|0
units.english: The black-draped individual bows gently to you as green sparkles dot their skin. "Captain <first> <last>?" they say. When you indicate affirmatively, they continue. "I am Saajret, of Somber Sejra, an envoy of the noble scions of House Kaatrij. Kaatrij hopes that thou mightst do us a boon."
units.italian: L'individuo in nero ti fa un inchino leggero mentre scintille verdi punteggiano la sua pelle. "Capitano <first> <last>?" dice. Quando annuisci, continua. "Sono Saajret, di Somber Sejra, inviato dei nobili eredi di Casa Kaatrij. Kaatrij spera che tu possa farci un favore."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|Waiting in the spaceport here as you arrive are a trio of Successors, two guards and one other individual who you recognize as Saajret, of Somber Sejra. Kaatrij's archivist looks different from the last time you saw them; their outfit is wrapped up more tightly and the colors of their face seem muted and subdued.|567|0
units.english: Waiting in the spaceport here as you arrive are a trio of Successors, two guards and one other individual who you recognize as Saajret, of Somber Sejra. Kaatrij's archivist looks different from the last time you saw them; their outfit is wrapped up more tightly and the colors of their face seem muted and subdued.
units.italian: Ad aspettarti allo spazioporto, al tuo arrivo, ci sono tre Successori: due guardie e un altro individuo che riconosci come Saajret, di Somber Sejra. L'archivista di Kaatrij ha un aspetto diverso dall'ultima volta che l'hai visto; l'abito è avvolto più stretto e i colori del viso sembrano spenti e sommessi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	Saajret bows to you gently, green and reddish tones swirling on their skin. "Captain <first> <last>," they say, "whose patience I have tested thoroughly, it would seem. Kaatrij sends me to ask of thee a boon to us."|568|0
units.english: Saajret bows to you gently, green and reddish tones swirling on their skin. "Captain <first> <last>," they say, "whose patience I have tested thoroughly, it would seem. Kaatrij sends me to ask of thee a boon to us."
units.italian: Saajret ti fa un inchino leggero, toni verdi e rossastri che turbinano sulla pelle. "Capitano <first> <last>," dice, "la cui pazienza a quanto pare ho messo a dura prova. Kaatrij mi manda a chiederti un favore."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	"Why haven't I heard from you since the incident?"|572|0
units.english: "Why haven't I heard from you since the incident?"
units.italian: "Perché non ho più saputo nulla da te dopo l'incidente?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	"What sort of 'boon?'"|576|0
units.english: "What sort of 'boon?'"
units.italian: "Che tipo di 'favore'?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	"Why me?"|578|0
units.english: "Why me?"
units.italian: "Perché io?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	"Thou'rt earning thyself a reputation for efficiency and discretion," Saajret says. "And Kaatrij has need of both. Some scientific equipment here must return to the homeworld, ideally with haste. Canst thy craft serve?"|581|0
units.english: "Thou'rt earning thyself a reputation for efficiency and discretion," Saajret says. "And Kaatrij has need of both. Some scientific equipment here must return to the homeworld, ideally with haste. Canst thy craft serve?"
units.italian: "Ti stai guadagnando una reputazione di efficienza e discrezione," dice Saajret. "E Kaatrij ha bisogno di entrambe. Un'attrezzatura scientifica qui deve tornare sul mondo natale, possibilmente in fretta. La tua nave può servire?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	"Thy reputation for professionalism seems well-earned, Captain," they say. "Some scientific equipment stored here must return to the homeworld with haste. Canst thy craft serve?"|585|0
units.english: "Thy reputation for professionalism seems well-earned, Captain," they say. "Some scientific equipment stored here must return to the homeworld with haste. Canst thy craft serve?"
units.italian: "La tua reputazione di professionalità sembra ben meritata, capitano," dice. "Un'attrezzatura scientifica immagazzinata qui deve tornare sul mondo natale in fretta. La tua nave può servire?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	Saajret hums, colors continuing to swim over their body. Eventually, they speak. "In the wake of Kaatrij's wound, our suspicion of others was great and wide. And thou wert included in this, for these incidents came only soon after thy arrival. Some believe thou play'd some part in this, some do not." They pause for a moment, running their eyes over you. "'Tis the latter faction that offers thee this opportunity: some equipment here must return to the homeworld. A chance to demonstrate thy benevolence, mayhaps?"|589|0
units.english: Saajret hums, colors continuing to swim over their body. Eventually, they speak. "In the wake of Kaatrij's wound, our suspicion of others was great and wide. And thou wert included in this, for these incidents came only soon after thy arrival. Some believe thou play'd some part in this, some do not." They pause for a moment, running their eyes over you. "'Tis the latter faction that offers thee this opportunity: some equipment here must return to the homeworld. A chance to demonstrate thy benevolence, mayhaps?"
units.italian: Saajret canticchia, i colori che continuano a nuotare sul loro corpo. Alla fine parla. "Sulla scia della ferita di Kaatrij, il nostro sospetto verso gli altri fu grande e largo. E tu fosti incluso, perché questi incidenti sono arrivati poco dopo il tuo arrivo. Alcuni credono che tu abbia avuto una parte, altri no." Si fermano un momento, passandoti gli occhi addosso. "È la seconda fazione a offrirti questa opportunità: un'attrezzatura qui deve tornare sul mondo natale. Un'occasione per dimostrare la tua benevolenza, forse?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	"All right. I assume the House is paying?"|593|0
units.english: "All right. I assume the House is paying?"
units.italian: "Va bene. Suppongo che la Casa paghi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	"I don't want to get involved in this."|595|0
units.english: "I don't want to get involved in this."
units.italian: "Non voglio essere coinvolto in questo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	"Very well," Saajret says. "'Tis thy own choice, after all."|597|0
units.english: "Very well," Saajret says. "'Tis thy own choice, after all."
units.italian: "Molto bene," dice Saajret. "Dopotutto è una tua scelta."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	"Of course," Saajret says. "I will see the items are loaded forthwith."|601|0
units.english: "Of course," Saajret says. "I will see the items are loaded forthwith."
units.italian: "Certamente," dice Saajret. "Farò caricare gli oggetti immediatamente."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|dialog|605|0
units.english: successor ghosts story failed
units.italian: Percorso dei Successori: fantasmi - missione fallita

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|dialog|608|0
units.english: successor ghosts story failed
units.italian: Percorso dei Successori: fantasmi - missione fallita

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|You've heard <planet> described by outsiders as an insular and well-guarded world, but neither of those prepared you for how strikingly quiet it is. The rainy spaceport seems almost deserted, the loudest sound almost always the pattering of heavy drops on the sail-like projections overhead, only occasionally interrupted by a soft-spoken announcement about an incoming ship landing or departing. None of the Successors you transported give any indication about whether this is typical or just a result of Kaatrij's recent incidents.|618|0
units.english: You've heard <planet> described by outsiders as an insular and well-guarded world, but neither of those prepared you for how strikingly quiet it is. The rainy spaceport seems almost deserted, the loudest sound almost always the pattering of heavy drops on the sail-like projections overhead, only occasionally interrupted by a soft-spoken announcement about an incoming ship landing or departing. None of the Successors you transported give any indication about whether this is typical or just a result of Kaatrij's recent incidents.
units.italian: Hai sentito <planet> descritto dagli stranieri come un mondo insulare e ben sorvegliato, ma nessuna delle due cose ti aveva preparato alla sua quiete così impressionante. Lo spazioporto piovoso sembra quasi deserto, il suono più forte è quasi sempre il tamburellare delle gocce pesanti sulle sporgenze simili a vele sopra di te, interrotto solo ogni tanto da un annuncio a voce bassa su una nave in arrivo o in partenza. Nessuno dei Successori che hai trasportato lascia capire se sia normale o solo il risultato dei recenti incidenti di Kaatrij.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|label|621|0
units.english: visited before
units.italian: visited before

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|The <planet> spaceport is caught in the midst of a gentle rainstorm. The loudest sound you hear during the time you spend there is the patter of the heavy drops overhead and the occasional whirring of the machinery the dockworkers use to unload your cargo.|622|0
units.english: The <planet> spaceport is caught in the midst of a gentle rainstorm. The loudest sound you hear during the time you spend there is the patter of the heavy drops overhead and the occasional whirring of the machinery the dockworkers use to unload your cargo.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di <planet> è avvolto da un temporale leggero. Il suono più forte che senti durante la tua permanenza è il tamburellare delle gocce pesanti sopra di te e il ronzio occasionale dei macchinari che i lavoratori del porto usano per scaricare il tuo carico.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 5|	Saajret meets with you on the landing pad, informing you that you've been credited <payment> by the House for your services. Before leaving, they ask you to return to the spaceport this evening to meet with them.|625|0
units.english: Saajret meets with you on the landing pad, informing you that you've been credited <payment> by the House for your services. Before leaving, they ask you to return to the spaceport this evening to meet with them.
units.italian: Saajret ti incontra sulla piazzola, informandoti che la Casa ti ha accreditato <payment> per i tuoi servizi. Prima di andarsene, ti chiede di tornare allo spazioporto stasera per incontrarli.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|name|630|0
units.english: Visit <planet> again
units.italian: Visita di nuovo <planet>

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|description|631|0
units.english: Saajret, of Somber Sejra has been instructed by House Kaatrij to scan the wildlife on <destination>, which must be of interest to multiple of the High Houses.
units.italian: A Saajret, di Somber Sejra, Casa Kaatrij ha ordinato di scansionare la fauna di <destination>, che deve interessare a più di una delle Casate Alte.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|The black-shrouded Saajret meets you back at the spaceport as the sun is setting, joining you in a lobby area looking out on a landing pad for Kaatrij's military ships. As they start to speak, a pair of Veusaden hover to the ground in the distance, their repulsor thrusters kicking into the air drops of the everpresent rain.|639|0
units.english: The black-shrouded Saajret meets you back at the spaceport as the sun is setting, joining you in a lobby area looking out on a landing pad for Kaatrij's military ships. As they start to speak, a pair of Veusaden hover to the ground in the distance, their repulsor thrusters kicking into the air drops of the everpresent rain.
units.italian: Il Saajret avvolto di nero ti incontra allo spazioporto mentre il sole tramonta, unendosi a te in un atrio che guarda su una piazzola per le navi militari di Kaatrij. Mentre cominciano a parlare, una coppia di Veusaden si libra fino a terra in lontananza, i propulsori a repulsione che scalciano nell'aria le gocce della pioggia perenne.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"I've managed to convince Kaatrij that thou mightst be helpful to us in one more task," they say. "As the situation develops, they now agree thou'rt too substantive to deny all dialog. Dost thou remember thy prior visit to <planet>, wherein thou didst confront the Kijran?"|640|0
units.english: "I've managed to convince Kaatrij that thou mightst be helpful to us in one more task," they say. "As the situation develops, they now agree thou'rt too substantive to deny all dialog. Dost thou remember thy prior visit to <planet>, wherein thou didst confront the Kijran?"
units.italian: "Sono riuscito a convincere Kaatrij che potresti esserci utile in un altro compito," dice. "Man mano che la situazione si sviluppa, ora convengono che sei troppo sostanzioso per negarti ogni dialogo. Ricordi la tua precedente visita a <planet>, quando affrontasti il Kijran?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"Yes."|642|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"It was hard to forget."|643|0
units.english: "It was hard to forget."
units.italian: "Difficile da dimenticare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|log|648|0
units.english: People
units.italian: People

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"My role here is... something of an archivist," Saajret says, "collecting and ordering information, items, records, of our Predecessors 'fore we left that period behind. Kaatrij believes certain data about the creatures on the old homeworld would be of use to them, and since thou now providest them the opportunity," they say, spreading their arms in a wide gesture, "Kaatrij is willing to compensate thee for taking me there to scan them."|649|0
units.english: "My role here is... something of an archivist," Saajret says, "collecting and ordering information, items, records, of our Predecessors 'fore we left that period behind. Kaatrij believes certain data about the creatures on the old homeworld would be of use to them, and since thou now providest them the opportunity," they say, spreading their arms in a wide gesture, "Kaatrij is willing to compensate thee for taking me there to scan them."
units.italian: "Il mio ruolo qui è... qualcosa come quello di un archivista," dice Saajret, "raccogliere e ordinare informazioni, oggetti, registri, dei nostri Predecessori prima che lasciassimo quel periodo alle spalle. Kaatrij crede che certi dati sulle creature del vecchio mondo natale sarebbero utili, e poiché ora offri loro l'occasione," dice, aprendo le braccia in un gesto ampio, "Kaatrij è disposta a compensarti per portarmici a scansionarle."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"I'm an archivist, as I told thee before," Saajret continues. "Kaatrij believes certain data about the creatures there would be of use to them and, since thou now providest them the opportunity, shall compensate thee for taking me there to scan them."|653|0
units.english: "I'm an archivist, as I told thee before," Saajret continues. "Kaatrij believes certain data about the creatures there would be of use to them and, since thou now providest them the opportunity, shall compensate thee for taking me there to scan them."
units.italian: "Sono un archivista, come ti ho detto prima," continua Saajret. "Kaatrij crede che certi dati sulle creature di là sarebbero utili e, poiché ora offri loro l'occasione, ti compenserà per portarmici a scansionarle."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"In the wake of an attack, Kaatrij's interest is in scanning plants and animals? I don't buy it."|657|0
units.english: "In the wake of an attack, Kaatrij's interest is in scanning plants and animals? I don't buy it."
units.italian: "Sulla scia di un attacco, l'interesse di Kaatrij è scansionare piante e animali? Non ci credo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"Last time I went the wildlife wasn't very friendly."|662|0
units.english: "Last time I went the wildlife wasn't very friendly."
units.italian: "L'ultima volta la fauna non era molto amichevole."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"All right."|667|0
units.english: "All right."
units.italian: "D'accordo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"I have no interest in going back there."|672|0
units.english: "I have no interest in going back there."
units.italian: "Non ho alcun interesse a tornarci."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	Saajret hums. "After thy prior experience, I wonder'd if that would be the case. Very well," they say. "I'll bid thee farewell, then."|674|0
units.english: Saajret hums. "After thy prior experience, I wonder'd if that would be the case. Very well," they say. "I'll bid thee farewell, then."
units.italian: Saajret canticchia. "Dopo la tua precedente esperienza, mi chiedevo se sarebbe andata così. Molto bene," dice. "Allora ti saluto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"So readily accepted?" Saajret says, more than a little surprised. "Perhaps thy prior experience was not as fearful as I thought. In that case, I shall ready myself to leave and meet thee at thy craft."|678|0
units.english: "So readily accepted?" Saajret says, more than a little surprised. "Perhaps thy prior experience was not as fearful as I thought. In that case, I shall ready myself to leave and meet thee at thy craft."
units.italian: "Accetti così di buon grado?" dice Saajret, più che un po' sorpreso. "Forse la tua precedente esperienza non è stata tanto spaventosa quanto pensavo. In tal caso, mi preparerò a partire e ti incontrerò alla tua nave."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"Indeed not," Saajret says, humming. "Thou shalt not be expected to face them again, if that concerns thee. The scans I mean to take are not invasive and would not arouse the fury of the Kijran-Khora, but thou'rt needed for naught but transportation there and back."|682|0
units.english: "Indeed not," Saajret says, humming. "Thou shalt not be expected to face them again, if that concerns thee. The scans I mean to take are not invasive and would not arouse the fury of the Kijran-Khora, but thou'rt needed for naught but transportation there and back."
units.italian: "Infatti no," dice Saajret, canticchiando. "Non ti si chiederà di affrontarli di nuovo, se è questo che ti preoccupa. Le scansioni che intendo fare non sono invasive e non desterebbero la furia del Kijran-Khora, ma tu servi solo per il trasporto, andata e ritorno."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	Saajret laughs, a quiet ruk-ruk sound that doesn't seem very mirthful. "Perhaps not," they say. "These creatures are important to the House nonetheless. They were important enough to House Sioeora to pay thee to steal, were they not?" They pause, continuing more quietly. "In their own way they are valuable to Kaatrij," they finally add. "What say'st thou to the House's offer?"|689|0
units.english: Saajret laughs, a quiet ruk-ruk sound that doesn't seem very mirthful. "Perhaps not," they say. "These creatures are important to the House nonetheless. They were important enough to House Sioeora to pay thee to steal, were they not?" They pause, continuing more quietly. "In their own way they are valuable to Kaatrij," they finally add. "What say'st thou to the House's offer?"
units.italian: Saajret ride, un sommesso ruk-ruk che non sembra molto allegro. "Forse no," dice. "Queste creature sono comunque importanti per la Casa. Furono abbastanza importanti per Casa Sioeora da pagarti per rubarle, no?" Si fermano, continuando più piano. "A modo loro sono preziose per Kaatrij," aggiungono alla fine. "Che dici all'offerta della Casa?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|label|692|0
units.english: kaatrij kijran
units.italian: kaatrij kijran

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	Saajret laughs, a quiet ruk-ruk sound that doesn't seem very mirthful. "'Twas the Kaatrij of old that engineered them, was it not? Is it not sensible that they would be important to the House, worthy of a cast gaze even in a fraught time?" They pause for a moment, a swirl of indeterminate colors on their face. "What say'st thou to the House's offer?" they finally say.|693|0
units.english: Saajret laughs, a quiet ruk-ruk sound that doesn't seem very mirthful. "'Twas the Kaatrij of old that engineered them, was it not? Is it not sensible that they would be important to the House, worthy of a cast gaze even in a fraught time?" They pause for a moment, a swirl of indeterminate colors on their face. "What say'st thou to the House's offer?" they finally say.
units.italian: Saajret ride, un sommesso ruk-ruk che non sembra molto allegro. "Fu la Kaatrij di un tempo a progettarli, no? Non è forse sensato che siano importanti per la Casa, degni di uno sguardo gettato anche in un momento teso?" Si fermano un momento, un gorgo di colori indeterminati sul viso. "Che dici all'offerta della Casa?" dicono infine.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|label|696|0
units.english: final choice
units.italian: final choice

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"All right, I'll do it."|698|0
units.english: "All right, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"I'm still not willing to go back."|699|0
units.english: "I'm still not willing to go back."
units.italian: "Continuo a non volerci tornare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"Kaatrij will be pleased," says Saajret. "I shall ready myself to leave and meet thee then at thy craft."|702|0
units.english: "Kaatrij will be pleased," says Saajret. "I shall ready myself to leave and meet thee then at thy craft."
units.italian: "Kaatrij sarà contenta," dice Saajret. "Mi preparerò a partire e ti incontrerò alla tua nave."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	You land your ship on the outskirts of the same facility you visited with Sieasej in the past; it looks much the same, though now many of the green plants have turned various shades of yellow and orange as the seasons have changed. Saajret meets you in your ship's cockpit, now dressed in a slightly different black, well-pocketed outfit. They carry a device with a rotating drum in one of their arms, probably some sort of scanner.|707|0
units.english: You land your ship on the outskirts of the same facility you visited with Sieasej in the past; it looks much the same, though now many of the green plants have turned various shades of yellow and orange as the seasons have changed. Saajret meets you in your ship's cockpit, now dressed in a slightly different black, well-pocketed outfit. They carry a device with a rotating drum in one of their arms, probably some sort of scanner.
units.italian: Posi la nave ai margini della stessa struttura che visitasti in passato con Sieasej; sembra molto simile, anche se ora molte delle piante verdi sono diventate varie tonalità di giallo e arancione col cambio di stagione. Saajret ti incontra nella cabina di pilotaggio, ora vestito con un abito nero leggermente diverso, pieno di tasche. Porta in una delle braccia un dispositivo con un tamburo rotante, probabilmente una specie di scanner.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"I shall keep in contact with thy craft," they say, "though I foresee no problems in my expedition. Expect me back about three hours hence."|708|0
units.english: "I shall keep in contact with thy craft," they say, "though I foresee no problems in my expedition. Expect me back about three hours hence."
units.italian: "Resterò in contatto con la tua nave," dice, "anche se non prevedo problemi nella mia spedizione. Aspettami qui tra circa tre ore."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	As they leave, you are left with little to do but wait.|709|0
units.english: As they leave, you are left with little to do but wait.
units.italian: Mentre se ne vanno, non ti resta che aspettare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	(Assess your ship's systems.)|711|0
units.english: (Assess your ship's systems.)
units.italian: (Controlla i sistemi della nave.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	(Look around outside.)|713|0
units.english: (Look around outside.)
units.italian: (Guardati intorno fuori.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	The remarkably peaceful vista conceals a feeling of unease; in the distance, you see cuts in a couple of trees, their bark leaking sap from a wound surely left by a serrated antenna. You spy what you recognize as a Kijra-riita flitting between trees; it drains a flower of nectar on a shrub and bats a twig full of dried leaves, knocking a few to the ground. Perhaps it's the same one you encountered the last time you visited.|718|0
units.english: The remarkably peaceful vista conceals a feeling of unease; in the distance, you see cuts in a couple of trees, their bark leaking sap from a wound surely left by a serrated antenna. You spy what you recognize as a Kijra-riita flitting between trees; it drains a flower of nectar on a shrub and bats a twig full of dried leaves, knocking a few to the ground. Perhaps it's the same one you encountered the last time you visited.
units.italian: Il panorama straordinariamente pacifico nasconde una sensazione di inquietudine; in lontananza vedi tagli su un paio di alberi, la corteccia che perde linfa da una ferita lasciata di sicuro da un'antenna seghettata. Scorgi quello che riconosci come un Kijra-riita che svolazza tra gli alberi; succhia il nettare da un fiore su un arbusto e colpisce con una zampa un rametto pieno di foglie secche, facendone cadere qualcuna a terra. Forse è lo stesso che hai incontrato l'ultima volta che sei stato qui.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|label|721|0
units.english: friend to animals
units.italian: friend to animals

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	It's a remarkably peaceful vista and only becomes more so as the day wears into late afternoon and the autumn color is amplified by the golden sunlight. In the distance you see what you recognize as a Kijra-riita flitting between trees; it laps nectar from a flower on a shrub and playfully bats at a twig full of dried leaves, knocking a few to the ground. Perhaps it's the same one you released the last time you visited.|722|0
units.english: It's a remarkably peaceful vista and only becomes more so as the day wears into late afternoon and the autumn color is amplified by the golden sunlight. In the distance you see what you recognize as a Kijra-riita flitting between trees; it laps nectar from a flower on a shrub and playfully bats at a twig full of dried leaves, knocking a few to the ground. Perhaps it's the same one you released the last time you visited.
units.italian: È un panorama straordinariamente pacifico, e lo diventa ancora di più quando il giorno volge al tardo pomeriggio e il colore autunnale è amplificato dalla luce dorata del sole. In lontananza vedi quello che riconosci come un Kijra-riita che svolazza tra gli alberi; lambisce il nettare da un fiore su un arbusto e colpisce giocoso un rametto pieno di foglie secche, facendone cadere qualcuna a terra. Forse è lo stesso che hai liberato l'ultima volta che sei stato qui.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	You check over the <ship>'s various internal systems, making sure its power couplings are operating within normal parameters and taking a long moment to admire its jump drive, which hums away inside its housing, inscrutable as always.|731|0
units.english: You check over the <ship>'s various internal systems, making sure its power couplings are operating within normal parameters and taking a long moment to admire its jump drive, which hums away inside its housing, inscrutable as always.
units.italian: Controlli i vari sistemi interni della <ship>, assicurandoti che gli accoppiamenti di potenza funzionino entro i parametri normali e prendendoti un lungo momento per ammirare il motore di salto, che ronza dentro il suo alloggiamento, imperscrutabile come sempre.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|label|734|0
units.english: killed riiria
units.italian: killed riiria

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	You check over the <ship>'s various internal systems, and discover a mysterious anomaly in one of the power consumption logs, though it's hard to track down what caused it or where it was located. Regardless, the anomaly resolved itself some time ago.|737|0
units.english: You check over the <ship>'s various internal systems, and discover a mysterious anomaly in one of the power consumption logs, though it's hard to track down what caused it or where it was located. Regardless, the anomaly resolved itself some time ago.
units.italian: Controlli i vari sistemi interni della <ship> e scopri un'anomalia misteriosa in uno dei registri di consumo energetico, anche se è difficile risalire a cosa l'abbia causata o dove si trovasse. In ogni caso, l'anomalia si è risolta da sola tempo fa.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	Saajret soon returns as they promised, apparently unharmed. They unload their equipment in the quarters you set aside for them before returning to you in the cockpit. "It went without incident," they say, a shade of satisfaction on their skin. As they turn to go away, they catch themself, turning back around with a bit of trepidation. "I may never get this chance again, so I'll speak now: I've a personal request to beg of thee. There's another world within the Shroud where in the past my ancestors resided. 'Fore we return to Kaatrij, I'd long to see it for myself. I'd pay thee for the diversion, of course."|740|0
units.english: Saajret soon returns as they promised, apparently unharmed. They unload their equipment in the quarters you set aside for them before returning to you in the cockpit. "It went without incident," they say, a shade of satisfaction on their skin. As they turn to go away, they catch themself, turning back around with a bit of trepidation. "I may never get this chance again, so I'll speak now: I've a personal request to beg of thee. There's another world within the Shroud where in the past my ancestors resided. 'Fore we return to Kaatrij, I'd long to see it for myself. I'd pay thee for the diversion, of course."
units.italian: Saajret torna presto come promesso, apparentemente illeso. Scarica la sua attrezzatura negli alloggi che gli hai riservato prima di tornare da te in cabina. "È andato senza incidenti," dice, un'ombra di soddisfazione sulla pelle. Mentre si volta per andarsene, si trattiene, tornando indietro con un po' di trepidazione. "Forse non avrò mai più questa occasione, quindi parlo ora: ho una richiesta personale da farti. C'è un altro mondo dentro lo Shroud dove in passato risiedevano i miei antenati. Prima di tornare a Kaatrij, desidero vederlo con i miei occhi. Ti pagherei per la deviazione, naturalmente."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"Sure, I'll take you."|742|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll take you."
units.italian: "Certo, ti ci porto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	"Sorry, you'll have to figure something else out."|744|0
units.english: "Sorry, you'll have to figure something else out."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, dovrai trovare un'altra soluzione."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	Saajret struggles to keep their disappointment from showing. "Very well," they manage to say before leaving.|745|0
units.english: Saajret struggles to keep their disappointment from showing. "Very well," they manage to say before leaving.
units.italian: Saajret fatica a non mostrare la delusione. "Molto bene," riesce a dire prima di andarsene.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	Saajret keeps their composure for a second before a faint pink color creeps up their face and arms. "My thanks to thee, Captain," they say. "The world is Osolaa-Val-Mavra; I'll give thee its place."|751|0
units.english: Saajret keeps their composure for a second before a faint pink color creeps up their face and arms. "My thanks to thee, Captain," they say. "The world is Osolaa-Val-Mavra; I'll give thee its place."
units.italian: Saajret mantiene la compostezza per un secondo, poi un rosa tenue risale sul viso e sulle braccia. "La mia gratitudine, capitano," dice. "Il mondo è Osolaa-Val-Mavra; te ne darò la posizione."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 6|	With nothing left to do here, you prepare to leave.|754|0
units.english: With nothing left to do here, you prepare to leave.
units.italian: Non resta altro da fare qui, quindi ti prepari a partire.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|name|761|0
units.english: Detour to Osolaa-Val-Mavra
units.italian: Deviazione su Osolaa-Val-Mavra

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|description|762|0
units.english: Saajret has asked to visit <stopovers> as a personal favor, before returning home to <planet>.
units.italian: Saajret ha chiesto di visitare <stopovers> come favore personale, prima di tornare a casa su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|log|770|0
units.english: Took Saajret to the Predecessor planet Osolaa-Val-Mavra. They visited an abandoned city on the surface where an ancestor of theirs once lived, retrieving from it a data-sphere and a small wooden box.
units.italian: Hai portato Saajret sul pianeta dei Predecessori Osolaa-Val-Mavra. Ha visitato una città abbandonata sulla superficie dove un tempo viveva un suo antenato, recuperando una sfera di dati e una piccola scatola di legno.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|You set the <ship> on one of the landing terraces of the planet's equatorial trench, near a location that Saajret indicates. The spot provides a dizzying view: snowflakes from a cloud overhead drift over ledges and deserted balconies before falling kilometers down into the abyss below. Saajret joins you by the airlock, now wrapped warmly in a shiny silver outfit with a collar of small ribbons that stream in the breeze.|772|0
units.english: You set the <ship> on one of the landing terraces of the planet's equatorial trench, near a location that Saajret indicates. The spot provides a dizzying view: snowflakes from a cloud overhead drift over ledges and deserted balconies before falling kilometers down into the abyss below. Saajret joins you by the airlock, now wrapped warmly in a shiny silver outfit with a collar of small ribbons that stream in the breeze.
units.italian: Posi la <ship> su una delle terrazze d'atterraggio della fossa equatoriale del pianeta, vicino a un punto che Saajret ti indica. Il posto offre una vista vertiginosa: fiocchi di neve da una nuvola sopra la testa vanno alla deriva sopra cornici e balconi deserti prima di cadere per chilometri nell'abisso sottostante. Saajret ti raggiunge vicino alla camera di equilibrio, ora avvolto in un abito argentato lucido con un colletto di piccoli nastri che ondeggiano nella brezza.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	"What is this place?" you ask.|773|0
units.english: "What is this place?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che posto è questo?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	A blue tone makes its way over Saajret's face. "'Twas an arc of homes and shops before they were abandoned," they say. A couple of snowflakes land on their skin and their arms wriggle against the white ground. "Thou may'st join me if thou desirest. Kaatrij demands no secrecy from us here."|774|0
units.english: A blue tone makes its way over Saajret's face. "'Twas an arc of homes and shops before they were abandoned," they say. A couple of snowflakes land on their skin and their arms wriggle against the white ground. "Thou may'st join me if thou desirest. Kaatrij demands no secrecy from us here."
units.italian: Una tonalità blu si fa strada sul viso di Saajret. "Era un arco di case e botteghe prima che fossero abbandonate," dice. Un paio di fiocchi si posano sulla sua pelle e le sue braccia si dimenano contro il terreno bianco. "Puoi unirti a me, se lo desideri. Kaatrij non ci impone segretezza qui."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	(Go with them.)|776|0
units.english: (Go with them.)
units.italian: (Va' con loro.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	(Stay.)|777|0
units.english: (Stay.)
units.italian: (Resta.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	The two of you make your way through the abandoned streets. You are struck by how well-preserved everything is; more than those of any other Predecessor world, the buildings here seem only temporarily vacant, as if the two of you had merely caught the city on a day with everyone missing. A trio of little cleaning robots run around the rim of a fountain, polishing away the snow before it even has time to melt in the sun.|779|0
units.english: The two of you make your way through the abandoned streets. You are struck by how well-preserved everything is; more than those of any other Predecessor world, the buildings here seem only temporarily vacant, as if the two of you had merely caught the city on a day with everyone missing. A trio of little cleaning robots run around the rim of a fountain, polishing away the snow before it even has time to melt in the sun.
units.italian: Vi fate strada tra le strade abbandonate. Ti colpisce quanto tutto sia ben conservato; più che in qualsiasi altro mondo dei Predecessori, gli edifici qui sembrano vuoti solo temporaneamente, come se aveste appena sorpreso la città in un giorno in cui tutti mancano. Un trio di piccoli robot pulitori corre intorno al bordo di una fontana, lucidando via la neve prima ancora che abbia il tempo di sciogliersi al sole.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	Saajret follows their own path, periodically checking what must be a map on a datapad they carry. Occasionally their skin will erupt in color as they see something that interests them, but they never stay distracted for long. Eventually the two of you arrive in an elegant square of organic buildings; Saajret checks their map a few times before declaring, "Here we are."|780|0
units.english: Saajret follows their own path, periodically checking what must be a map on a datapad they carry. Occasionally their skin will erupt in color as they see something that interests them, but they never stay distracted for long. Eventually the two of you arrive in an elegant square of organic buildings; Saajret checks their map a few times before declaring, "Here we are."
units.italian: Saajret segue la propria strada, controllando ogni tanto quella che dev'essere una mappa su un datapad che porta con sé. Di quando in quando la sua pelle esplode di colore quando vede qualcosa che lo interessa, ma non resta mai distratto a lungo. Alla fine arrivate in una piazza elegante di edifici organici; Saajret controlla la mappa un paio di volte prima di dichiarare: "Siamo arrivati."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	"And where is 'here'?"|782|0
units.english: "And where is 'here'?"
units.italian: "E dove sarebbe 'qui'?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	"It's a pretty spot."|783|0
units.english: "It's a pretty spot."
units.italian: "È un posto grazioso."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	(Stay silent.)|784|0
units.english: (Stay silent.)
units.italian: (Resta in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	"An ancestor of mine lived here briefly," they say. "One of import in the last days of House Sejra. But when they lived here, all that was still to come."|787|0
units.english: "An ancestor of mine lived here briefly," they say. "One of import in the last days of House Sejra. But when they lived here, all that was still to come."
units.italian: "Un mio antenato visse qui per breve tempo," dice. "Uno importante negli ultimi giorni di Casa Sejra. Ma quando visse qui, tutto ciò doveva ancora venire."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	Saajret walks inside the largest building, entering a code onto a spherical terminal beside the door. You move to go after them, but they hold out an arm to stop you. "This last part, I would prefer to go alone," they say. They point to a high bench outside.|790|0
units.english: Saajret walks inside the largest building, entering a code onto a spherical terminal beside the door. You move to go after them, but they hold out an arm to stop you. "This last part, I would prefer to go alone," they say. They point to a high bench outside.
units.italian: Saajret entra nell'edificio più grande, digitando un codice su un terminale sferico accanto alla porta. Ti muovi per seguirlo, ma allunga un braccio a fermarti. "Quest'ultima parte preferirei farla da solo," dice. Indica una panca alta fuori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	They stay inside for about half an hour; you watch the snow fall on the square and the terraces. When Saajret returns, they are carrying a data-sphere and a small wooden box that they carry cradled in one of their arms. There's a color on their face you can't quite place.|791|0
units.english: They stay inside for about half an hour; you watch the snow fall on the square and the terraces. When Saajret returns, they are carrying a data-sphere and a small wooden box that they carry cradled in one of their arms. There's a color on their face you can't quite place.
units.italian: Resta dentro una mezz'ora circa; tu guardi la neve cadere sulla piazza e sulle terrazze. Quando Saajret torna, porta una sfera di dati e una piccola scatola di legno che tiene in una delle braccia. Sul viso ha un colore che non sai bene collocare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	"Are you ready to return?"|793|0
units.english: "Are you ready to return?"
units.italian: "Sei pronto a tornare?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	"What did you get?"|794|0
units.english: "What did you get?"
units.italian: "Che cos'hai preso?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	They hum. "Yes, I have what I came for," they say, "thanks to thine indulgence of me. I shan't forget that."|796|0
units.english: They hum. "Yes, I have what I came for," they say, "thanks to thine indulgence of me. I shan't forget that."
units.italian: Canticchia. "Sì, ho quello per cui sono venuto," dice, "grazie alla tua indulgenza. Non lo dimenticherò."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	They hum. "One thing I had hoped for and another I had dreaded. So often those two go arm-in-arm, do they not?" The color on their face fades. "I have what I came for," they say. "My thanks to thee for indulging me in this."|800|0
units.english: They hum. "One thing I had hoped for and another I had dreaded. So often those two go arm-in-arm, do they not?" The color on their face fades. "I have what I came for," they say. "My thanks to thee for indulging me in this."
units.italian: Canticchia. "Una cosa che speravo e un'altra che temevo. Così spesso quelle due vanno a braccetto, non è vero?" Il colore sul viso svanisce. "Ho quello per cui sono venuto," dice. "La mia gratitudine per avermi assecondato in questo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	Saajret splays their arms as farewell and tells you to expect them back before nightfall. You look over your ship's systems, take in the views, and watch the snow clump in the joints of the <ship>'s hull.|804|0
units.english: Saajret splays their arms as farewell and tells you to expect them back before nightfall. You look over your ship's systems, take in the views, and watch the snow clump in the joints of the <ship>'s hull.
units.italian: Saajret apre le braccia in congedo e ti dice di aspettarlo prima di notte. Controlli i sistemi della nave, ti godi la vista, e guardi la neve che si accumula nei giunti dello scafo della <ship>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	A couple of hours later, Saajret returns. They carry in their arms a data-sphere and a small wooden box, intricately carved. "I have all I came for, I believe," they tell you, and there's a color on their face you can't quite place. "My thanks," they say, "for indulging me."|805|0
units.english: A couple of hours later, Saajret returns. They carry in their arms a data-sphere and a small wooden box, intricately carved. "I have all I came for, I believe," they tell you, and there's a color on their face you can't quite place. "My thanks," they say, "for indulging me."
units.italian: Un paio d'ore dopo, Saajret torna. Porta in braccio una sfera di dati e una piccola scatola di legno, intagliata in modo intricato. "Ho tutto quello per cui sono venuto, credo," ti dice, e sul viso ha un colore che non sai bene collocare. "La mia gratitudine," dice, "per avermi assecondato."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	The two of you pack up your things and prepare for departure.|808|0
units.english: The two of you pack up your things and prepare for departure.
units.italian: Fate i bagagli e vi preparate alla partenza.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|log|810|0
units.english: Saajret told a story about the hunting practices of the elusive self-camouflaging Kijran-Khora. These infiltrated House Kaatrij's bases long in the past. They suggested someone might do something similar.
units.italian: Saajret ha raccontato una storia sulle pratiche di caccia dell'elusivo Kijran-Khora, capace di automimetizzarsi. Questi si infiltrarono nelle basi di Casa Kaatrij molto tempo fa. Ha suggerito che qualcuno potrebbe fare qualcosa di simile.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7b|name|821|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7b|description|822|0
units.english: Having declined Saajret's request for a detour, return them home to <planet>.
units.italian: Avendo declinato la richiesta di Saajret di una deviazione, riportalo a casa su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7b|log|829|0
units.english: Saajret told a story about the hunting practices of the elusive self-camouflaging Kijran-Khora. These infiltrated House Kaatrij's bases long in the past. They suggested someone might do something similar.
units.italian: Saajret ha raccontato una storia sulle pratiche di caccia dell'elusivo Kijran-Khora, capace di automimetizzarsi. Questi si infiltrarono nelle basi di Casa Kaatrij molto tempo fa. Ha suggerito che qualcuno potrebbe fare qualcosa di simile.

units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	Your ship once again glides into the <planet> spaceport, slipping beneath a dense layer of early-morning fog. Saajret meets you just outside, informing you the data they were sent to collect has already been transmitted and thanking you for your help.|839|0
units.english: Your ship once again glides into the <planet> spaceport, slipping beneath a dense layer of early-morning fog. Saajret meets you just outside, informing you the data they were sent to collect has already been transmitted and thanking you for your help.
units.italian: La tua nave scivola di nuovo nello spazioporto di <planet>, insinuandosi sotto uno spesso strato di nebbia mattutina. Saajret ti incontra appena fuori, informandoti che i dati che era stato mandato a raccogliere sono già stati trasmessi, e ringraziandoti per il tuo aiuto.

units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	They tell you to expect a deposit of <payment> from House Kaatrij.|842|0
units.english: They tell you to expect a deposit of <payment> from House Kaatrij.
units.italian: Ti dicono di aspettarti un deposito di <payment> da Casa Kaatrij.

units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	They tell you to expect a deposit of 140000 credits from House Kaatrij and hand over a small chip containing 80000 additional credits.|846|0
units.english: They tell you to expect a deposit of 140000 credits from House Kaatrij and hand over a small chip containing 80000 additional credits.
units.italian: Ti dicono di aspettarti un deposito di 140000 crediti da Casa Kaatrij e ti consegnano un piccolo gettone contenente altri 80000 crediti.

units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	As Saajret watches a dockworker fitting a fuel hose to the <ship>'s side, something changes in their demeanor and a glint of almost furious orange sparks on their skin. "Captain," they say. "I'm told that thou'st experienced for thyself the hunting practices of the dread Kijran-Khora."|849|0
units.english: As Saajret watches a dockworker fitting a fuel hose to the <ship>'s side, something changes in their demeanor and a glint of almost furious orange sparks on their skin. "Captain," they say. "I'm told that thou'st experienced for thyself the hunting practices of the dread Kijran-Khora."
units.italian: Mentre Saajret guarda un lavoratore del porto che collega un tubo del carburante al fianco della <ship>, qualcosa cambia nel suo contegno e un bagliore di scintille quasi furiose, arancioni, gli accende la pelle. "Capitano," dice. "Mi dicono che hai provato tu stesso le pratiche di caccia del temibile Kijran-Khora."

units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	"I beg your pardon?"|851|0
units.english: "I beg your pardon?"
units.italian: "Come dici?"

units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	"A little too closely, actually."|852|0
units.english: "A little too closely, actually."
units.italian: "Un po' troppo da vicino, in realtà."

units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	They continue, the color continuing to sparkle on their skin. "Beautiful beasts, aren't they? Truly aspirational; adept at camouflage, hiding themselves beyond all but the most scrutinizing gaze before closing in on their quarry. In the early days of Kaatrij, when the Kijran were still new, some particularly well-cloaked ones slipped into a weather-control tower. Perhaps," they say, "one might learn from their example, were there somewhere notable one wished to go." They cast their gaze upward, where the shimmering dots of planets above peek through the clouds.|853|0
units.english: They continue, the color continuing to sparkle on their skin. "Beautiful beasts, aren't they? Truly aspirational; adept at camouflage, hiding themselves beyond all but the most scrutinizing gaze before closing in on their quarry. In the early days of Kaatrij, when the Kijran were still new, some particularly well-cloaked ones slipped into a weather-control tower. Perhaps," they say, "one might learn from their example, were there somewhere notable one wished to go." They cast their gaze upward, where the shimmering dots of planets above peek through the clouds.
units.italian: Continuano, con il colore che continua a scintillare sulla pelle. "Bestie bellissime, non è vero? Davvero da ammirare: abili nel mimetizzarsi, si nascondono oltre ogni sguardo che non sia il più indagatore, prima di chiudersi sulla preda. Nei primi giorni di Kaatrij, quando i Kijran erano ancora una novità, alcuni esemplari particolarmente ben occultati si insinuarono in una torre di controllo meteorologico. Forse," dicono, "si potrebbe imparare dal loro esempio, se ci fosse un posto notevole dove si desidera andare." Alzano lo sguardo, dove i puntini scintillanti dei pianeti sopra di voi trapelano tra le nuvole.

units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	"Why are you telling me this?"|855|0
units.english: "Why are you telling me this?"
units.italian: "Perché mi stai raccontando questo?"

units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	"Are you trying to tell me something?"|856|0
units.english: "Are you trying to tell me something?"
units.italian: "Stai cercando di dirmi qualcosa?"

units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	The sparkle of color on their skin dies down and they look at you with mirth in their eyes. "I'm an archivist," they say. "I adore a good story."|858|0
units.english: The sparkle of color on their skin dies down and they look at you with mirth in their eyes. "I'm an archivist," they say. "I adore a good story."
units.italian: Lo scintillio di colore sulla pelle si spegne e ti guardano con ilarità negli occhi. "Sono un archivista," dicono. "Adoro una bella storia."

units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	The sparkle of color on their face intensifies for a moment before dying out. "Naught but an archivist's foolish games," they say.|862|0
units.english: The sparkle of color on their face intensifies for a moment before dying out. "Naught but an archivist's foolish games," they say.
units.italian: Lo scintillio di colore sul viso si intensifica per un momento prima di spegnersi. "Nulla se non i giochi sciocchi di un archivista," dicono.

units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	They look over at the spaceport again. "Till again we meet, <first> <last>."|865|0
units.english: They look over at the spaceport again. "Till again we meet, <first> <last>."
units.italian: Guardano di nuovo verso lo spazioporto. "Finché non ci rivedremo, <first> <last>."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Cloak Prompt|name|871|0
units.english: Investigate <planet>
units.italian: Indaga su <planet>

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Cloak Prompt|description|872|0
units.english: Saajret's cryptic message may have been suggesting a way to more closely investigate House Kaatrij's hidden base on <planet>. Try to bypass the blockade by using a ship that can cloak.
units.italian: Il messaggio criptico di Saajret forse suggeriva un modo per indagare più da vicino la base nascosta di Casa Kaatrij su <planet>. Prova a superare il blocco usando una nave capace di occultarsi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Cloak Prompt|You spend a little while stretching your legs here on the <origin> spaceport, watching the various ships come in and go out and looking over the wide variety of Successors that mill about them. In many ways it's not unlike human space, though the elegance and efficiency with which the Successors build and operate their spaceports gives some hint about the much greater experience they have as an interstellar species.|882|0
units.english: You spend a little while stretching your legs here on the <origin> spaceport, watching the various ships come in and go out and looking over the wide variety of Successors that mill about them. In many ways it's not unlike human space, though the elegance and efficiency with which the Successors build and operate their spaceports gives some hint about the much greater experience they have as an interstellar species.
units.italian: Passi un po' di tempo a sgranchirti le gambe qui allo spazioporto di <origin>, guardando le varie navi entrare e uscire e osservando la grande varietà di Successori che si aggirano intorno. Per molti versi non è diverso dallo spazio umano, anche se l'eleganza e l'efficienza con cui i Successori costruiscono e gestiscono i loro spazioporti lasciano intuire la loro esperienza molto maggiore come specie interstellare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Cloak Prompt|	Some things are just the same, though, like the news display that you realize is right above you as it lets out a particularly noticeable warble. It catches your eye for a moment; the program is presenting a visualization of what the attack on House Seineq's base could have plausibly looked like, a well of morphic metal unspooling from the display to form small simulated Vujleten flying in formation, firing their weapons, and even cloaking themselves once they've delivered their payloads, their forms growing indistinct and wavy as the liquid metal returns to its origin.|883|0
units.english: Some things are just the same, though, like the news display that you realize is right above you as it lets out a particularly noticeable warble. It catches your eye for a moment; the program is presenting a visualization of what the attack on House Seineq's base could have plausibly looked like, a well of morphic metal unspooling from the display to form small simulated Vujleten flying in formation, firing their weapons, and even cloaking themselves once they've delivered their payloads, their forms growing indistinct and wavy as the liquid metal returns to its origin.
units.italian: Alcune cose sono però identiche, come il display delle notizie che ti accorgi di avere proprio sopra la testa quando emette un trillo particolarmente evidente. Ti cattura per un momento; il programma sta presentando una visualizzazione di come sarebbe potuto apparire plausibilmente l'attacco alla base di Casa Seineq: un pozzo di metallo morfico che si srotola dal display per formare piccoli Vujleten simulati che volano in formazione, sparano le loro armi e persino si occultano dopo aver consegnato il loro carico, le forme che si fanno indistinte e ondulate mentre il metallo liquido torna al suo origine.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Cloak Prompt|	As the narrator intones something about historical uses of cloaking technology, a spark of understanding suddenly lights in your mind: you recall your last conversation with Saajret and their story about the camouflaging Kijran-Khora, and in light of House Kaatrij's blockade over <planet>, how they might have been offering you a way that you could investigate Kaatrij's base for yourself. The moon's atmosphere is thin enough that a cloaked ship could probably approach the surface totally undetected, even considering the no-doubt advanced scanners House Kaatrij is using to detect intruders.|884|0
units.english: As the narrator intones something about historical uses of cloaking technology, a spark of understanding suddenly lights in your mind: you recall your last conversation with Saajret and their story about the camouflaging Kijran-Khora, and in light of House Kaatrij's blockade over <planet>, how they might have been offering you a way that you could investigate Kaatrij's base for yourself. The moon's atmosphere is thin enough that a cloaked ship could probably approach the surface totally undetected, even considering the no-doubt advanced scanners House Kaatrij is using to detect intruders.
units.italian: Mentre il narratore intona qualcosa sugli usi storici della tecnologia di occultamento, una scintilla di comprensione ti si accende all'improvviso: ricordi la tua ultima conversazione con Saajret e la sua storia dei Kijran-Khora mimetizzanti, e alla luce del blocco di Casa Kaatrij su <planet>, come potessero offrirti un modo per indagare tu stesso sulla base di Kaatrij. L'atmosfera della luna è abbastanza sottile perché una nave occultata possa probabilmente avvicinarsi alla superficie del tutto inosservata, anche considerando gli scanner senza dubbio avanzati che Casa Kaatrij usa per individuare gli intrusi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 8|As you enter orbit over <origin>, you can see that House Kaatrij continues to occupy the planet's surface, scanning and intercepting any ships that might attempt to land.|899|0
units.english: As you enter orbit over <origin>, you can see that House Kaatrij continues to occupy the planet's surface, scanning and intercepting any ships that might attempt to land.
units.italian: Mentre entri in orbita su <origin>, vedi che Casa Kaatrij continua a occupare la superficie del pianeta, scansionando e intercettando qualsiasi nave che tenti di atterrare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 8|	(Cloak.)|901|0
units.english: (Cloak.)
units.italian: (Occultati.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 8|	(Continue down.)|905|0
units.english: (Continue down.)
units.italian: (Continua a scendere.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 8|	(Leave.)|906|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 8|	The <ship> is soon detected by Kaatrij's scanners, and you are forced to return to orbit lest you face destruction.|908|0
units.english: The <ship> is soon detected by Kaatrij's scanners, and you are forced to return to orbit lest you face destruction.
units.italian: La <ship> viene presto individuata dagli scanner di Kaatrij, e sei costretto a tornare in orbita per non affrontare la distruzione.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 8|	The hull of the <ship> warbles as its cloaking equipment engages, and as the seconds pass it becomes clear that Kaatrij's ships cannot detect you above the mostly-airless moon. Though you must descend slowly to avoid disturbing the atmosphere, you eventually find your way over the sandy surface to right above the now-revealed base House Kaatrij went to so much effort to hide.|913|0
units.english: The hull of the <ship> warbles as its cloaking equipment engages, and as the seconds pass it becomes clear that Kaatrij's ships cannot detect you above the mostly-airless moon. Though you must descend slowly to avoid disturbing the atmosphere, you eventually find your way over the sandy surface to right above the now-revealed base House Kaatrij went to so much effort to hide.
units.italian: Lo scafo della <ship> ondeggia mentre l'apparecchiatura di occultamento si attiva, e col passare dei secondi diventa chiaro che le navi di Kaatrij non possono individuarti sopra la luna quasi priva d'aria. Devi scendere lentamente per non disturbare l'atmosfera, ma alla fine trovi la strada sopra la superficie sabbiosa fino a portarti proprio sopra la base ormai rivelata che Casa Kaatrij si era tanto sforzata di nascondere.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 8|	As you once saw in the news broadcast, the outline of it is an enormous circle several kilometers in radius. Though the shimmering effect is now gone and some of the damage has been repaired, much of it still remains visible and there appears to be ongoing work on the damaged sections - House Kaatrij-registered freighters land on temporary landing pads and offload massive amounts of materials, some familiar, some not.|914|0
units.english: As you once saw in the news broadcast, the outline of it is an enormous circle several kilometers in radius. Though the shimmering effect is now gone and some of the damage has been repaired, much of it still remains visible and there appears to be ongoing work on the damaged sections - House Kaatrij-registered freighters land on temporary landing pads and offload massive amounts of materials, some familiar, some not.
units.italian: Come avevi già visto nel notiziario, il suo profilo è un cerchio enorme, di diversi chilometri di raggio. Sebbene l'effetto di luccichio sia ora sparito e parte dei danni sia stata riparata, molto resta ancora visibile e sembra che i lavori sulle sezioni danneggiate siano in corso: mercantili registrati a Casa Kaatrij atterrano su piazzole temporanee e scaricano quantità enormi di materiali, alcuni familiari, altri no.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 8|	Most striking of all, however, is the appearance of some familiar-looking dark metal and purple lighting in the damaged section of the base; it's hard to be certain, but it bears a distinct resemblance to Quarg technology. Perhaps the Quarg might be able to provide some answers about what's been going on.|915|0
units.english: Most striking of all, however, is the appearance of some familiar-looking dark metal and purple lighting in the damaged section of the base; it's hard to be certain, but it bears a distinct resemblance to Quarg technology. Perhaps the Quarg might be able to provide some answers about what's been going on.
units.italian: La cosa più impressionante, però, è la comparsa di un metallo scuro dall'aria familiare e di un'illuminazione violacea nella sezione danneggiata della base; è difficile esserne certi, ma somiglia in modo distinto alla tecnologia Quarg. Forse i Quarg potrebbero dare qualche risposta su cosa stia succedendo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 8|	Not long after you see this, a thin sandstorm starts to roll in, and you take the <ship> back up to orbit before the mysterious absence of airborne grit gives your ship away.|916|0
units.english: Not long after you see this, a thin sandstorm starts to roll in, and you take the <ship> back up to orbit before the mysterious absence of airborne grit gives your ship away.
units.italian: Non molto dopo aver visto questo, comincia a rotolare dentro una sottile tempesta di sabbia, e riporti la <ship> in orbita prima che la misteriosa assenza di granelli nell'aria tradisca la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 8|log|920|0
units.english: Approached the base on Qasa-Sija-Iri while under cloak. Its design vaguely resembles Quarg construction - perhaps they have some answers about what's been going on with the Successors.
units.italian: Ti sei avvicinato alla base su Qasa-Sija-Iri sotto occultamento. Il suo disegno somiglia vagamente a una costruzione Quarg - forse hanno qualche risposta su cosa sta succedendo ai Successori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|Do you want to ask the Quarg here about their base on the Successor moon Qasa-Sija-Iri?|932|0
units.english: Do you want to ask the Quarg here about their base on the Successor moon Qasa-Sija-Iri?
units.italian: Vuoi chiedere ai Quarg qui della loro base sulla luna dei Successori Qasa-Sija-Iri?

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	(Yes.)|934|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	(Not now.)|935|0
units.english: (Not now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	Though so far individual Quarg have seemed equivalent in their ability to answer your questions, it is several minutes before you spot one here who, for some reason, seems like it would be able to answer. When you repeat your question to it, it blinks slowly, and answers even more so.|937|0
units.english: Though so far individual Quarg have seemed equivalent in their ability to answer your questions, it is several minutes before you spot one here who, for some reason, seems like it would be able to answer. When you repeat your question to it, it blinks slowly, and answers even more so.
units.italian: Anche se finora i singoli Quarg sono sembrati equivalenti nella capacità di rispondere alle tue domande, passano diversi minuti prima che tu ne individui uno che, per qualche motivo, sembra in grado di rispondere. Quando gli ripeti la domanda, sbatte le palpebre lentamente, e risponde ancora più lentamente.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"I see," it says. "You have uncovered one of our great secrets of the galaxy. You were right to think that the world you speak of is ours. After what that foolish species did to themselves, we the Quarg could not bear to leave them unobserved. But we dared not do so unshrouded, lest we once again rouse them to the heights of envy - so we built no ringworld, no stations, no open worlds. Only a little... watching post, to keep our gaze over the Myiara."|938|0
units.english: "I see," it says. "You have uncovered one of our great secrets of the galaxy. You were right to think that the world you speak of is ours. After what that foolish species did to themselves, we the Quarg could not bear to leave them unobserved. But we dared not do so unshrouded, lest we once again rouse them to the heights of envy - so we built no ringworld, no stations, no open worlds. Only a little... watching post, to keep our gaze over the Myiara."
units.italian: "Capisco," dice. "Hai scoperto uno dei nostri grandi segreti della galassia. Avevi ragione a pensare che il mondo di cui parli sia nostro. Dopo quello che quella specie sciocca ha fatto a sé stessa, noi Quarg non potevamo sopportare di lasciarli senza sorveglianza. Ma non osavamo farlo senza velo, per non suscitarli di nuovo alle vette dell'invidia: così non abbiamo costruito ringworld, né stazioni, né mondi aperti. Solo un piccolo... posto di osservazione, per tenere lo sguardo sui Myiara."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	You interject. "The Myiara? Do you mean the Successors?"|939|0
units.english: You interject. "The Myiara? Do you mean the Successors?"
units.italian: Lo interrompi. "I Myiara? Intendi i Successori?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	The Quarg considers the term. "Before they called themselves that, they were the Myiara. Have they truly become so rooted in their memories of their valorous past?" It makes a noise like the rumbling of distant thunder. "You must have questions."|940|0
units.english: The Quarg considers the term. "Before they called themselves that, they were the Myiara. Have they truly become so rooted in their memories of their valorous past?" It makes a noise like the rumbling of distant thunder. "You must have questions."
units.italian: Il Quarg considera il termine. "Prima di chiamarsi così, erano i Myiara. Sono davvero diventati così radicati nei ricordi del loro passato valoroso?" Emette un rumore come il rombo di un tuono lontano. "Dovrai avere delle domande."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"What is it that they did to themselves? Did they build some kind of terrible weapons?"|942|0
units.english: "What is it that they did to themselves? Did they build some kind of terrible weapons?"
units.italian: "Che cosa hanno fatto a sé stessi? Hanno costruito qualche tipo di arma terribile?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"I didn't think hiding away was in your nature."|944|0
units.english: "I didn't think hiding away was in your nature."
units.italian: "Non pensavo che nascondersi facesse parte della vostra natura."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"No," says the Quarg, "not weapons. That you have met them shows that you have found, or stolen, the secret to sail between the stars unhindered. Long, long ago, the Drak discovered that secret for the first time, and after many years, they shared it with us, the Quarg, so that peace and amity might reign in the galaxy. Then, only a few thousand human years ago, the Myiara found it too." The Quarg blinks slowly, and its whole body slumps as if burdened by a great sorrow.|948|0
units.english: "No," says the Quarg, "not weapons. That you have met them shows that you have found, or stolen, the secret to sail between the stars unhindered. Long, long ago, the Drak discovered that secret for the first time, and after many years, they shared it with us, the Quarg, so that peace and amity might reign in the galaxy. Then, only a few thousand human years ago, the Myiara found it too." The Quarg blinks slowly, and its whole body slumps as if burdened by a great sorrow.
units.italian: "No," dice il Quarg, "non armi. Il fatto che tu li abbia incontrati dimostra che hai trovato, o rubato, il segreto per navigare tra le stelle senza impedimenti. Molto, molto tempo fa, i Drak scoprirono quel segreto per la prima volta, e dopo molti anni lo condivisero con noi, i Quarg, perché pace e amicizia potessero regnare nella galassia. Poi, solo qualche migliaio di anni umani fa, lo trovarono anche i Myiara." Il Quarg sbatte le palpebre lentamente, e tutto il suo corpo si affloscia come oppresso da un grande dolore.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"What they discovered was not what the Drak had, nor the beauty that the Korath, despite all their warring, had wrought. It was a new and dangerous thing, and while it let them explore with new freedom, in the years that followed, its mark became clear. It rent wounds among the stars, tore apart the paths between them, led their ships away to nowhere, and turned their verdant worlds to ash."|949|0
units.english: "What they discovered was not what the Drak had, nor the beauty that the Korath, despite all their warring, had wrought. It was a new and dangerous thing, and while it let them explore with new freedom, in the years that followed, its mark became clear. It rent wounds among the stars, tore apart the paths between them, led their ships away to nowhere, and turned their verdant worlds to ash."
units.italian: "Quello che scoprirono non era ciò che avevano i Drak, né la bellezza che i Korath, con tutte le loro guerre, avevano forgiato. Era una cosa nuova e pericolosa, e se da un lato permise loro di esplorare con una libertà nuova, negli anni che seguirono il suo segno divenne chiaro. Squarciò ferite tra le stelle, lacerò i sentieri tra esse, portò le loro navi verso il nulla e trasformò in cenere i loro mondi verdeggianti."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"Why did you allow them to develop something so destructive?"|951|0
units.english: "Why did you allow them to develop something so destructive?"
units.italian: "Perché avete permesso che sviluppassero qualcosa di così distruttivo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"How did you keep yourselves hidden for so long?"|953|0
units.english: "How did you keep yourselves hidden for so long?"
units.italian: "Come avete fatto a restare nascosti così a lungo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"They were then upon the precipice of a great change. Their long-wrought divisions were melding; they had turned away from the gruesome vagaries of war, and were moved to explore and preserve the arts of others. We hoped," and the Quarg imparts a heightened tone on this word, "that in time, they could become as we are, guardians and friends to all. Our judgment was clouded by our desire for this."|957|0
units.english: "They were then upon the precipice of a great change. Their long-wrought divisions were melding; they had turned away from the gruesome vagaries of war, and were moved to explore and preserve the arts of others. We hoped," and the Quarg imparts a heightened tone on this word, "that in time, they could become as we are, guardians and friends to all. Our judgment was clouded by our desire for this."
units.italian: "Allora erano sull'orlo di un grande cambiamento. Le loro divisioni lungamente forgiate si stavano fondendo; si erano allontanati dalle orribili imprevedibilità della guerra ed erano spinti a esplorare e preservare le arti degli altri. Speravamo," e il Quarg dà a questa parola un tono più alto, "che col tempo potessero diventare come noi siamo: guardiani e amici di tutti. Il nostro giudizio fu offuscato dal desiderio di questo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"It's hard to believe they were ever so unified."|959|0
units.english: "It's hard to believe they were ever so unified."
units.italian: "È difficile credere che siano mai stati così uniti."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"You saw them as equals to yourselves?"|960|0
units.english: "You saw them as equals to yourselves?"
units.italian: "Li consideravate vostri pari?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	A demeanor of great reflection passes over the Quarg, and then is gone just as quickly. "The Myiara were like... children, just beginning to conceive of and adopt the responsibilities that lie beyond youth. Full of cleverness and arrogance still, but borne aloft by a new-blooming capacity to see beyond themselves and their own base concerns."|961|0
units.english: A demeanor of great reflection passes over the Quarg, and then is gone just as quickly. "The Myiara were like... children, just beginning to conceive of and adopt the responsibilities that lie beyond youth. Full of cleverness and arrogance still, but borne aloft by a new-blooming capacity to see beyond themselves and their own base concerns."
units.italian: Un contegno di grande riflessione passa sul Quarg, e poi sparisce altrettanto in fretta.
