"I Myiara erano come... bambini, che appena cominciavano a concepire e ad assumere le responsabilità che stanno oltre la giovinezza. Pieni ancora di scaltrezza e arroganza, ma sostenuti da una capacità appena sbocciata di vedere oltre sé stessi e le proprie preoccupazioni meschine."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"How did you keep yourself hidden from them for so long?"|963|0
units.english: "How did you keep yourself hidden from them for so long?"
units.italian: "Come avete fatto a restare nascosti a loro così a lungo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"Hiding indeed does not come naturally to us," the Quarg says. "With no other have we had need to conceal ourselves. One of their Houses, when it knew what they had done, agreed to work with us to preserve their species. They were most skilled in matters of illusion, and shared their cloaks with us to obscure our presence."|966|0
units.english: "Hiding indeed does not come naturally to us," the Quarg says. "With no other have we had need to conceal ourselves. One of their Houses, when it knew what they had done, agreed to work with us to preserve their species. They were most skilled in matters of illusion, and shared their cloaks with us to obscure our presence."
units.italian: "Nascondersi, in effetti, non ci viene naturale," dice il Quarg. "Con nessun altro abbiamo avuto bisogno di occultarci. Una delle loro Casate, quando seppe quello che avevano fatto, accettò di lavorare con noi per preservare la loro specie. Era abilissima nelle arti dell'illusione, e condivise i suoi mantelli con noi per oscurare la nostra presenza."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"What troubles this one most, though," says the Quarg, "is that this watching post of ours was laid bare to see at all. We made ourselves rancid to the Myiara for their own good, stole away their precious creations, worked with those of them who would help us to tear down so much of what they had built, sealed them away - all so they would not have the means to recreate their folly in a later age. That this deception of ours has come to light may drive them even further from what they were, undo even the meager gains they have wrought in their exile. For all their wrong, that would still be a cause for lament."|970|0
units.english: "What troubles this one most, though," says the Quarg, "is that this watching post of ours was laid bare to see at all. We made ourselves rancid to the Myiara for their own good, stole away their precious creations, worked with those of them who would help us to tear down so much of what they had built, sealed them away - all so they would not have the means to recreate their folly in a later age. That this deception of ours has come to light may drive them even further from what they were, undo even the meager gains they have wrought in their exile. For all their wrong, that would still be a cause for lament."
units.italian: "Ciò che più turba questo uno," dice il Quarg, "è che questo nostro posto di osservazione sia stato messo a nudo, visibile. Ci siamo resi ripugnanti ai Myiara per il loro bene, abbiamo sottratto le loro preziose creazioni, abbiamo lavorato con quelli di loro che ci avrebbero aiutato a demolire tanto di ciò che avevano costruito, li abbiamo sigillati via: tutto perché non avessero i mezzi per ricreare la loro follia in un'epoca successiva. Che questo nostro inganno sia venuto alla luce potrebbe allontanarli ancora di più da ciò che erano, annullare anche i miseri guadagni che hanno ottenuto nel loro esilio. Con tutte le loro colpe, sarebbe comunque motivo di lamento."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	With that, the Quarg offers you a gentle bow. "Goodbye now, Captain," they say, and quietly walk away.|971|0
units.english: With that, the Quarg offers you a gentle bow. "Goodbye now, Captain," they say, and quietly walk away.
units.italian: Detto questo, il Quarg ti offre un inchino leggero. "Addio, capitano," dice, e si allontana in silenzio.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|log|976|0
units.english: Spoke with the Quarg, who revealed that they have kept a base on Qasa-Sija-Iri to monitor the Successors. It has remained cloaked by House Kaatrij, who has collaborated with the Quarg since the collapse of the Predecessors.
units.italian: Hai parlato con i Quarg, che hanno rivelato di tenere una base su Qasa-Sija-Iri per sorvegliare i Successori. È rimasta occultata da Casa Kaatrij, che collabora con i Quarg dal crollo dei Predecessori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|log|977|0
units.english: Factions
units.italian: Factions

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|name|983|0
units.english: Meet with House Kaatrij
units.italian: Incontra Casa Kaatrij

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|description|984|0
units.english: Having allied with House Kaatrij, go with one of their military ships to their base at <destination>.
units.italian: Dopo esserti alleato con Casa Kaatrij, vai con una delle loro navi militari alla loro base su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|As you disembark from your ship, you notice a group of Successor soldiers emerging from another craft in the spaceport, a Seiitej bearing House Kaatrij's colors. They meet you outside your own vessel, their weapons held at attention.|993|0
units.english: As you disembark from your ship, you notice a group of Successor soldiers emerging from another craft in the spaceport, a Seiitej bearing House Kaatrij's colors. They meet you outside your own vessel, their weapons held at attention.
units.italian: Mentre sbarchi dalla nave, noti un gruppo di soldati Successori che escono da un altro mezzo nello spazioporto, un Seiitej che porta i colori di Casa Kaatrij. Ti incontrano fuori dal tuo vascello, le armi tenute in posizione di attenti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Captain <first> <last>," their leader says, "We've been instructed to take thee with us."|994|0
units.english: "Captain <first> <last>," their leader says, "We've been instructed to take thee with us."
units.italian: "Capitano <first> <last>," dice il loro capo, "abbiamo ordine di portarti con noi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"For what purpose exactly?"|996|0
units.english: "For what purpose exactly?"
units.italian: "Per quale scopo, esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"And if I refuse?"|998|0
units.english: "And if I refuse?"
units.italian: "E se rifiuto?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"That would not be wise," the officer says. "Thou shalt understand, we trust?"|999|0
units.english: "That would not be wise," the officer says. "Thou shalt understand, we trust?"
units.italian: "Non sarebbe saggio," dice l'ufficiale. "Lo capirai, confidiamo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Kaatrij wishes to speak with thee," says the lead officer. "And to hear what thou hast to say."|1003|0
units.english: "Kaatrij wishes to speak with thee," says the lead officer. "And to hear what thou hast to say."
units.italian: "Kaatrij desidera parlare con te," dice l'ufficiale capo. "E sentire cosa hai da dire."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	With apparently no choice, you accompany the officers back to their ship; they remove your sidearm and take you to a room inside. Two stand guard over you while the rest attend to other things outside, and it's only after the better part of an hour that someone else finally enters, a tall Successor who looks over you with an incisive glare.|1006|0
units.english: With apparently no choice, you accompany the officers back to their ship; they remove your sidearm and take you to a room inside. Two stand guard over you while the rest attend to other things outside, and it's only after the better part of an hour that someone else finally enters, a tall Successor who looks over you with an incisive glare.
units.italian: Senza apparente alternativa, accompagni gli ufficiali alla loro nave; ti tolgono l'arma da fianco e ti portano in una stanza all'interno. Due montano la guardia su di te mentre gli altri si occupano di altro fuori, e solo dopo quasi un'ora qualcun altro entra finalmente: un Successore alto che ti scruta con uno sguardo incisivo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Captain <first> <last>," they say. "How didst thou acquire cloaking technology?"|1007|0
units.english: "Captain <first> <last>," they say. "How didst thou acquire cloaking technology?"
units.italian: "Capitano <first> <last>," dice. "Come hai ottenuto la tecnologia di occultamento?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"It comes from another society, far away from here."|1009|0
units.english: "It comes from another society, far away from here."
units.italian: "Viene da un'altra società, molto lontano da qui."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"I was given it by a human government; they found it in an alien cargo hold."|1010|0
units.english: "I was given it by a human government; they found it in an alien cargo hold."
units.italian: "Me l'ha data un governo umano; l'hanno trovata in una stiva aliena."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"So it was not given to thee by a faction here, among the Successors?"|1013|0
units.english: "So it was not given to thee by a faction here, among the Successors?"
units.italian: "Quindi non ti è stata data da una fazione di qui, tra i Successori?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"No," you say. The Successor relaxes, if only a little. "We will search thy ship t'confirm this," they say. "But I do not believe thou liest."|1014|0
units.english: "No," you say. The Successor relaxes, if only a little. "We will search thy ship t'confirm this," they say. "But I do not believe thou liest."
units.italian: "No," dici. Il Successore si rilassa, anche se solo un poco. "Perquisiremo la tua nave per confermarlo," dice. "Ma non credo che tu mentisca."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"You won't find anything, my current ship isn't cloak-capable."|1019|0
units.english: "You won't find anything, my current ship isn't cloak-capable."
units.italian: "Non troverete nulla, la mia nave attuale non è capace di occultarsi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	The Successor looks over you with a curious gaze. "Intriguing," they say. "'Tis no matter; we shall consult our records of thy craft."|1020|0
units.english: The Successor looks over you with a curious gaze. "Intriguing," they say. "'Tis no matter; we shall consult our records of thy craft."
units.italian: Il Successore ti guarda con uno sguardo curioso. "Interessante," dice. "Non importa; consulteremo i nostri registri sul tuo vascello."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	After a moment passes, your interrogator leans over you and the guards in the back stand, attentive. "Now we must decide what is to be done with thee," they say, "now that thou hast learned of our arrangement with the Quarg. Thou shouldst understand we do not wish that information to be avail'ble to all. Not all the Houses nor their members regard the Quarg with amity."|1023|0
units.english: After a moment passes, your interrogator leans over you and the guards in the back stand, attentive. "Now we must decide what is to be done with thee," they say, "now that thou hast learned of our arrangement with the Quarg. Thou shouldst understand we do not wish that information to be avail'ble to all. Not all the Houses nor their members regard the Quarg with amity."
units.italian: Dopo un momento, il tuo interrogatore si china su di te e le guardie in fondo si alzano, attente. "Ora dobbiamo decidere cosa fare di te," dice, "ora che hai appreso del nostro accordo con i Quarg. Dovresti capire che non desideriamo che quell'informazione sia disponibile a tutti. Non tutte le Casate né i loro membri guardano ai Quarg con amicizia."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"I have no intention of spilling your secret."|1025|0
units.english: "I have no intention of spilling your secret."
units.italian: "Non ho alcuna intenzione di rivelare il vostro segreto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"I'll keep my lips sealed, for a price."|1027|0
units.english: "I'll keep my lips sealed, for a price."
units.italian: "Terrò la bocca chiusa, a un prezzo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"The people deserve to know about this."|1029|0
units.english: "The people deserve to know about this."
units.italian: "La gente merita di sapere questo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Perhaps they shall one day, but neither thee nor I should decide that now. 'Tis a time far too fraught to bring such a thing to light. No," they say, one of their arms moving toward you, "but Kaatrij would be willing to offer thee an alternative: a formal relation with the House, that thou mightst be brought into our circle of knowledge and receive our boons. And, of course, be subject to our directives, including those of silence."|1031|0
units.english: "Perhaps they shall one day, but neither thee nor I should decide that now. 'Tis a time far too fraught to bring such a thing to light. No," they say, one of their arms moving toward you, "but Kaatrij would be willing to offer thee an alternative: a formal relation with the House, that thou mightst be brought into our circle of knowledge and receive our boons. And, of course, be subject to our directives, including those of silence."
units.italian: "Forse un giorno lo saprà, ma né tu né io dobbiamo deciderlo ora. È un momento troppo teso per portare una cosa simile alla luce. No," dice, con uno dei suoi bracci che si muove verso di te, "ma Kaatrij sarebbe disposta a offrirti un'alternativa: una relazione formale con la Casa, così che tu possa essere ammesso nel nostro cerchio di conoscenza e ricevere i nostri doni. E, naturalmente, essere soggetto alle nostre direttive, comprese quelle del silenzio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"And what would House Sioeora think of this?"|1033|0
units.english: "And what would House Sioeora think of this?"
units.italian: "E cosa penserebbe Casa Sioeora di questo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"What would that entail, exactly?"|1037|0
units.english: "What would that entail, exactly?"
units.italian: "Che cosa comporterebbe, in pratica?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Yes, if it finally gets me some answers."|1039|0
units.english: "Yes, if it finally gets me some answers."
units.italian: "Sì, se alla fine mi darà qualche risposta."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"No, I'm not willing to lie for you."|1041|0
units.english: "No, I'm not willing to lie for you."
units.italian: "No, non sono disposto a mentire per voi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Thou shouldst be careful with such propositions, Captain," they say. Their skin remains a murky, ashen blue. "Kaatrij would be willing to offer thee an alternative, however: a formal relation with the House, that thou mightst be brought into our circle of knowledge and receive our boons. Of course, thou wouldst also be subject to our directives, including those of silence. Wouldst that be sufficient reward for thine efforts?"|1045|0
units.english: "Thou shouldst be careful with such propositions, Captain," they say. Their skin remains a murky, ashen blue. "Kaatrij would be willing to offer thee an alternative, however: a formal relation with the House, that thou mightst be brought into our circle of knowledge and receive our boons. Of course, thou wouldst also be subject to our directives, including those of silence. Wouldst that be sufficient reward for thine efforts?"
units.italian: "Dovresti stare attento con simili proposte, capitano," dice. La pelle resta di un blu torbido, cinereo. "Kaatrij sarebbe però disposta a offrirti un'alternativa: una relazione formale con la Casa, così che tu possa essere ammesso nel nostro cerchio di conoscenza e ricevere i nostri doni. Naturalmente saresti anche soggetto alle nostre direttive, comprese quelle del silenzio. Sarebbe per te una ricompensa sufficiente per i tuoi sforzi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"And what would House Sioeora think of this?"|1047|0
units.english: "And what would House Sioeora think of this?"
units.italian: "E cosa penserebbe Casa Sioeora di questo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"And what would that entail, exactly?"|1051|0
units.english: "And what would that entail, exactly?"
units.italian: "E cosa comporterebbe, esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Yes, if it finally gets me some answers."|1053|0
units.english: "Yes, if it finally gets me some answers."
units.italian: "Sì, se alla fine mi darà qualche risposta."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"No, I think I'll stick to credits."|1055|0
units.english: "No, I think I'll stick to credits."
units.italian: "No, credo che mi terrò i crediti."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Most discreet, Captain," they say. "But forgive me for not taking thy word alone. To that, Kaatrij is willing to make thee an offer: a formal relation with our House, that thou mightst be brought into our circle of knowledge and receive our boons. And in turn, thou wouldst also be subject to our directives, including those of silence. An arrangement, Kaatrij believes, of mutual benefit."|1061|0
units.english: "Most discreet, Captain," they say. "But forgive me for not taking thy word alone. To that, Kaatrij is willing to make thee an offer: a formal relation with our House, that thou mightst be brought into our circle of knowledge and receive our boons. And in turn, thou wouldst also be subject to our directives, including those of silence. An arrangement, Kaatrij believes, of mutual benefit."
units.italian: "Molto discreto, capitano," dice. "Ma perdonami se non mi fido della tua sola parola. A questo, Kaatrij è disposta a farti un'offerta: una relazione formale con la nostra Casa, così che tu possa essere ammesso nel nostro cerchio di conoscenza e ricevere i nostri doni. E a tua volta saresti soggetto alle nostre direttive, comprese quelle del silenzio. Un accordo, crede Kaatrij, di beneficio reciproco."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"And what would House Sioeora think of this?"|1063|0
units.english: "And what would House Sioeora think of this?"
units.italian: "E cosa penserebbe Casa Sioeora di questo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"And what would that entail, exactly?"|1067|0
units.english: "And what would that entail, exactly?"
units.italian: "E cosa comporterebbe, esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Yes, if it finally gets me some answers."|1069|0
units.english: "Yes, if it finally gets me some answers."
units.italian: "Sì, se alla fine mi darà qualche risposta."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"No, I prefer to remain a free agent."|1071|0
units.english: "No, I prefer to remain a free agent."
units.italian: "No, preferisco restare un agente libero."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	Incendiary yellow speckles dot the Successor's face, and they continue with some small hint of satisfaction. "No doubt they would be displeas'd to have lost one they so dearly wish'd to possess. But they have fail'd to act with swiftness. What sayest thou to our offer?"|1075|0
units.english: Incendiary yellow speckles dot the Successor's face, and they continue with some small hint of satisfaction. "No doubt they would be displeas'd to have lost one they so dearly wish'd to possess. But they have fail'd to act with swiftness. What sayest thou to our offer?"
units.italian: Macchioline gialle incendiarie punteggiano il viso del Successore, che prosegue con un piccolo accenno di soddisfazione. "Senza dubbio sarebbero scontenti di aver perso uno che desideravano tanto possedere. Ma non hanno agito con prontezza. Che dici alla nostra offerta?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"All right, I'll do it."|1077|0
units.english: "All right, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"No, I don't want to get any more tangled up in this than I already am."|1079|0
units.english: "No, I don't want to get any more tangled up in this than I already am."
units.italian: "No, non voglio impelagarmi più di quanto già non sia."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Thou wouldst be counted as an alien vassal of House Kaatrij, thus granted access to our facilities, subject to our rules and directives, and empowered to fight our enemies on our behalf under a commission of war. Thou wouldst retain thy freedom of movement, thine ability to go elsewhere in the galaxy. But when thou dost travel 'tween the stars of the Successors, 'tis House Kaatrij that thou shalt call thy home."|1083|0
units.english: "Thou wouldst be counted as an alien vassal of House Kaatrij, thus granted access to our facilities, subject to our rules and directives, and empowered to fight our enemies on our behalf under a commission of war. Thou wouldst retain thy freedom of movement, thine ability to go elsewhere in the galaxy. But when thou dost travel 'tween the stars of the Successors, 'tis House Kaatrij that thou shalt call thy home."
units.italian: "Saresti considerato un vassallo alieno di Casa Kaatrij, e avresti accesso alle nostre strutture, soggetto alle nostre regole e direttive, e autorizzato a combattere i nostri nemici per nostro conto sotto una commissione di guerra. Conserveresti la libertà di movimento, la capacità di andare altrove nella galassia. Ma quando viaggerai tra le stelle dei Successori, sarà Casa Kaatrij che dovrai chiamare casa."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"All right, I accept."|1085|0
units.english: "All right, I accept."
units.italian: "Va bene, accetto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"No, I don't want to get any more tangled up in this than I already am."|1087|0
units.english: "No, I don't want to get any more tangled up in this than I already am."
units.italian: "No, non voglio impelagarmi più di quanto già non sia."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Excellent," the Successor says. "I would have thee come with us, then, to the moon where this all began, our base on <planet>. There, some of thy no-doubt-pressing questions shall be answered."|1095|0
units.english: "Excellent," the Successor says. "I would have thee come with us, then, to the moon where this all began, our base on <planet>. There, some of thy no-doubt-pressing questions shall be answered."
units.italian: "Eccellente," dice il Successore. "Vorrei allora che venissi con noi, sulla luna dove tutto è cominciato, la nostra base su <planet>. Là alcune delle tue domande, senza dubbio urgenti, avranno risposta."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"A shame," your interrogator says, making a motion with one of their arms; behind them, one of the guards raises their rifle. Instinctively, you go to grab your own sidearm, only to remember that it was taken from you minutes ago just as the guard's railgun round pierces your body.|1102|0
units.english: "A shame," your interrogator says, making a motion with one of their arms; behind them, one of the guards raises their rifle. Instinctively, you go to grab your own sidearm, only to remember that it was taken from you minutes ago just as the guard's railgun round pierces your body.
units.italian: "Peccato," dice il tuo interrogatore, facendo un gesto con uno dei bracci; dietro di lui una guardia alza il fucile. Istintivamente vai a prendere la tua arma da fianco, per ricordarti solo che ti è stata tolta pochi minuti fa, proprio mentre il proiettile a rotaia della guardia ti trapassa il corpo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|label|1105|0
units.english: was discreet
units.italian: was discreet

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	Your interrogator regards you thoughtfully for a moment. "Consider thy choice carefully, Captain," they say. "Among us, there is little way forward for a 'free agent,' as thou namest it. An offer such as this one shall not come again."|1106|0
units.english: Your interrogator regards you thoughtfully for a moment. "Consider thy choice carefully, Captain," they say. "Among us, there is little way forward for a 'free agent,' as thou namest it. An offer such as this one shall not come again."
units.italian: Il tuo interrogatore ti considera per un momento, pensieroso. "Valuta bene la tua scelta, capitano," dice. "Tra noi, c'è poca via avanti per un 'agente libero', come lo chiami. Un'offerta come questa non verrà di nuovo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"All right, then, if it's the only way forward for me."|1108|0
units.english: "All right, then, if it's the only way forward for me."
units.italian: "Va bene, allora, se è l'unica via avanti per me."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"No, I've made my decision. I won't join you."|1110|0
units.english: "No, I've made my decision. I won't join you."
units.italian: "No, ho deciso. Non mi unisco a voi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"A shame," the Successor says. "But so long as thou dost not give up what thou hast learned or otherwise make thyself an enemy of this House, Kaatrij shall not impede thee." They pause and their skin blossoms with intense color. "Do not make us regret this leniency."|1114|0
units.english: "A shame," the Successor says. "But so long as thou dost not give up what thou hast learned or otherwise make thyself an enemy of this House, Kaatrij shall not impede thee." They pause and their skin blossoms with intense color. "Do not make us regret this leniency."
units.italian: "Peccato," dice il Successore. "Ma finché non rivelerai quello che hai appreso e non ti renderai in altro modo nemico di questa Casa, Kaatrij non ti ostacolerà." Si fermano e la loro pelle sboccia di colori intensi. "Non farci pentire di questa clemenza."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	They gesture towards the door and the guards move to the side, allowing you to leave. As you walk back to your ship, the Seiitej takes off, leaving you alone but free.|1115|0
units.english: They gesture towards the door and the guards move to the side, allowing you to leave. As you walk back to your ship, the Seiitej takes off, leaving you alone but free.
units.italian: Fanno un gesto verso la porta e le guardie si spostano di lato, permettendoti di uscire. Mentre torni alla tua nave, il Seiitej decolla, lasciandoti solo ma libero.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|government|1119|0
units.english: House Kaatrij
units.italian: House Kaatrij

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|log|1124|0
units.english: Formally inducted as a vassal of House Kaatrij, with all the attendant responsibilities and rewards.
units.italian: Sei stato formalmente introdotto come vassallo di Casa Kaatrij, con tutte le responsabilità e le ricompense che ne derivano.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|log|1125|0
units.english: People
units.italian: People

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|You once again descend to the dusty moon, though this time with the authorization to pass through the blockade. The ring-shaped base is now nowhere to be seen, but as you proceed to your landing coordinates, a shimmering aperture opens in the sand to reveal an advanced landing bay. As you set the <ship> down inside it, the top closes up again, sealing you off from the outside. Your hear the deep hum of motors and a faint sense of weightlessness as the whole landing bay plunges deep into the moon's crust, and only once it comes to a stop do the ground crew permit you to exit with an escort of House Kaatrij soldiers.|1127|0
units.english: You once again descend to the dusty moon, though this time with the authorization to pass through the blockade. The ring-shaped base is now nowhere to be seen, but as you proceed to your landing coordinates, a shimmering aperture opens in the sand to reveal an advanced landing bay. As you set the <ship> down inside it, the top closes up again, sealing you off from the outside. Your hear the deep hum of motors and a faint sense of weightlessness as the whole landing bay plunges deep into the moon's crust, and only once it comes to a stop do the ground crew permit you to exit with an escort of House Kaatrij soldiers.
units.italian: Scendi di nuovo sulla luna polverosa, anche se questa volta con l'autorizzazione a passare il blocco. La base ad anello ora non si vede più, ma mentre procedi verso le tue coordinate d'atterraggio, un'apertura scintillante si apre nella sabbia per rivelare una baia d'atterraggio avanzata. Mentre posi la <ship> dentro, la cima si richiude, sigillandoti dall'esterno. Senti il rombo profondo dei motori e una debole sensazione di assenza di peso mentre l'intera baia d'atterraggio si inabissa nella crosta della luna, e solo quando si ferma la squadra di terra ti permette di uscire con una scorta di soldati di Casa Kaatrij.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	The inside of the facility is unlike that of any other Successor spaceport; though most of the structure features Successor - or to the Quarg, Myiaran - technology, the visual style of the interior shows a distinct Quarg influence. Though most of those who walk the spacious halls are Successors, every so often you catch a glimpse of a Quarg loping its way down a corridor or across an open area.|1128|0
units.english: The inside of the facility is unlike that of any other Successor spaceport; though most of the structure features Successor - or to the Quarg, Myiaran - technology, the visual style of the interior shows a distinct Quarg influence. Though most of those who walk the spacious halls are Successors, every so often you catch a glimpse of a Quarg loping its way down a corridor or across an open area.
units.italian: L'interno della struttura non somiglia a nessun altro spazioporto dei Successori; anche se la maggior parte della struttura presenta tecnologia Successore - o, per i Quarg, Myiara - lo stile visivo degli interni mostra una distinta influenza Quarg. Sebbene quasi tutti quelli che percorrono gli ampi corridoi siano Successori, ogni tanto intravedi un Quarg che procede a balzi lungo un corridoio o attraverso uno spazio aperto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	Your escort finally stops outside a gleaming white door, indicating for you to open it.|1129|0
units.english: Your escort finally stops outside a gleaming white door, indicating for you to open it.
units.italian: La tua scorta si ferma infine davanti a una porta bianca lucente, indicandoti di aprirla.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	(Go inside.)|1131|0
units.english: (Go inside.)
units.italian: (Entra.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"What should I expect?"|1133|0
units.english: "What should I expect?"
units.italian: "Che cosa devo aspettarmi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	The leader of the soldiers escorting you says nothing, instead only gesturing toward the door with a little more force. Getting the hint, you enter.|1134|0
units.english: The leader of the soldiers escorting you says nothing, instead only gesturing toward the door with a little more force. Getting the hint, you enter.
units.italian: Il capo dei soldati che ti scortano non dice nulla, limitandosi a indicare la porta con un po' più di forza. Capito il suggerimento, entri.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	Three figures stand on the other side: one is the Successor who interrogated you, one you recognize as Saajret, and the third is a Quarg who stands overlooking the other two. All three focus their eyes on you as the door opens, the Successors splaying their arms in polite greeting, the Quarg merely examining you.|1137|0
units.english: Three figures stand on the other side: one is the Successor who interrogated you, one you recognize as Saajret, and the third is a Quarg who stands overlooking the other two. All three focus their eyes on you as the door opens, the Successors splaying their arms in polite greeting, the Quarg merely examining you.
units.italian: Dall'altra parte ci sono tre figure: una è il Successore che ti ha interrogato, una la riconosci come Saajret, e la terza è un Quarg che sta in disparte a osservare gli altri due. Tutti e tre puntano gli occhi su di te quando la porta si apre, i Successori aprendo le braccia in un saluto cortese, il Quarg che si limita a esaminarti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Captain <last>, 'tis good of thee to join us," the first Successor says. "We have not had a formal introduction, I recall. My name is Kampa; I lead one of Kaatrij's fleets. Thou hast already made acquaintance with Saajret, of Somber Sejra, of course." Saajret bows gently at this, their skin warbling with faint colors. "Already thine induction to our circles presents us with tasks for thee, but there is aught we must complete before that: to formalize the process."|1138|0
units.english: "Captain <last>, 'tis good of thee to join us," the first Successor says. "We have not had a formal introduction, I recall. My name is Kampa; I lead one of Kaatrij's fleets. Thou hast already made acquaintance with Saajret, of Somber Sejra, of course." Saajret bows gently at this, their skin warbling with faint colors. "Already thine induction to our circles presents us with tasks for thee, but there is aught we must complete before that: to formalize the process."
units.italian: "Capitano <last>, è cosa buona che ti unisca a noi," dice il primo Successore. "Non abbiamo avuto una presentazione formale, mi pare. Mi chiamo Kampa; comando una delle flotte di Kaatrij. Hai già conosciuto Saajret, di Somber Sejra, naturalmente." Saajret fa un inchino leggero, la pelle che gorgheggia di colori tenui. "Già la tua introduzione nei nostri circoli ci presenta dei compiti per te, ma c'è una cosa che dobbiamo completare prima: formalizzare il processo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	They produce a data-sphere which they give over to you. It feels slightly cold to the touch. "Thine acceptance binds thee to this House as vassal; herefore it shall expect of thee thine support and secrecy, and thou might expect from it the powers and privileges thou might require. Dost thou accept?"|1139|0
units.english: They produce a data-sphere which they give over to you. It feels slightly cold to the touch. "Thine acceptance binds thee to this House as vassal; herefore it shall expect of thee thine support and secrecy, and thou might expect from it the powers and privileges thou might require. Dost thou accept?"
units.italian: Producono una sfera di dati che ti consegnano. Sembra leggermente fredda al tatto. "La tua accettazione ti lega a questa Casa come vassallo; d'ora in poi essa si aspetterà da te sostegno e segretezza, e tu potrai aspettarti da essa i poteri e i privilegi di cui potresti aver bisogno. Accetti?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"I do."|1141|0
units.english: "I do."
units.italian: "Accetto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Maybe this was a bad idea."|1143|0
units.english: "Maybe this was a bad idea."
units.italian: "Forse è stata una cattiva idea."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Does this mean you'll sell me weapons and warships?"|1145|0
units.english: "Does this mean you'll sell me weapons and warships?"
units.italian: "Vuol dire che mi venderete armi e navi da guerra?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	A color flits upon Kampa's face, but you can't quite tell if it's amusement or suspicion. "Strictly, yes, but such exchanges are governed by treaty. For the moment, while thine alignment with us is still unclear to the rest, Kaatrij declines this responsibility."|1147|0
units.english: A color flits upon Kampa's face, but you can't quite tell if it's amusement or suspicion. "Strictly, yes, but such exchanges are governed by treaty. For the moment, while thine alignment with us is still unclear to the rest, Kaatrij declines this responsibility."
units.italian: Un colore guizza sul viso di Kampa, ma non sai dire se sia divertimento o sospetto. "A rigore, sì, ma simili scambi sono regolati da trattato. Per il momento, finché il tuo allineamento con noi non sarà chiaro al resto, Kaatrij declina questa responsabilità."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"All right, I formally accept."|1149|0
units.english: "All right, I formally accept."
units.italian: "Va bene, accetto formalmente."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Maybe this was a bad idea."|1151|0
units.english: "Maybe this was a bad idea."
units.italian: "Forse è stata una cattiva idea."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Thou hast already seen this place, Captain, hast already accepted in word if not in bond. Thou art... too far in already."|1154|0
units.english: "Thou hast already seen this place, Captain, hast already accepted in word if not in bond. Thou art... too far in already."
units.italian: "Hai già visto questo posto, capitano, hai già accettato a parole se non col vincolo. Sei... troppo dentro ormai."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"I suppose I am."|1156|0
units.english: "I suppose I am."
units.italian: "Suppongo di sì."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	The data-sphere flares with color, registering your assent. "'Tis done then," Kampa says. "Welcome to House Kaatrij." Both Kampa and Saajret bow again, the Quarg the only one in the room remaining motionless. "Thou shalt have access to much of our works, which now thou mightst explore at thy leisure. When thou'rt ready, thou shouldst meet Saajret at the spaceport here for thy first official task for us."|1159|0
units.english: The data-sphere flares with color, registering your assent. "'Tis done then," Kampa says. "Welcome to House Kaatrij." Both Kampa and Saajret bow again, the Quarg the only one in the room remaining motionless. "Thou shalt have access to much of our works, which now thou mightst explore at thy leisure. When thou'rt ready, thou shouldst meet Saajret at the spaceport here for thy first official task for us."
units.italian: La sfera di dati si accende di colore, registrando il tuo assenso. "Allora è fatto," dice Kampa. "Benvenuto in Casa Kaatrij." Sia Kampa sia Saajret si inchinano di nuovo, e il Quarg è l'unico nella stanza a restare immobile. "Avrai accesso a gran parte delle nostre opere, che ora potrai esplorare a tuo agio. Quando sarai pronto, dovresti incontrare Saajret allo spazioporto qui per il tuo primo incarico ufficiale per noi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"You said you would answer my questions."|1161|0
units.english: "You said you would answer my questions."
units.italian: "Avevi detto che avresti risposto alle mie domande."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	(Stay silent.)|1162|0
units.english: (Stay silent.)
units.italian: (Resta in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Very well," Kampa says. "Thou may'st query as thou please."|1165|0
units.english: "Very well," Kampa says. "Thou may'st query as thou please."
units.italian: "Molto bene," dice Kampa. "Puoi domandare come preferisci."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"That's all."|1168|0
units.english: "That's all."
units.italian: "È tutto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Do you know who attacked your base?"|1176|0
units.english: "Do you know who attacked your base?"
units.italian: "Sapete chi ha attaccato la vostra base?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Are you behind the drone ships in Predecessor space?"|1180|0
units.english: "Are you behind the drone ships in Predecessor space?"
units.italian: "Siete voi dietro le navi drone nello spazio dei Predecessori?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"What exactly is this arrangement with the Quarg that you have?"|1184|0
units.english: "What exactly is this arrangement with the Quarg that you have?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è esattamente questo accordo con i Quarg?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"How much cloaking technology do you actually have?"|1188|0
units.english: "How much cloaking technology do you actually have?"
units.italian: "Quanta tecnologia di occultamento avete davvero?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"Did you attack House Seineq?"|1193|0
units.english: "Did you attack House Seineq?"
units.italian: "Avete attaccato Casa Seineq?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"'Twas one of the High Houses, but which exactly, we do not know yet for certain." Kampa contemplates for a moment. "Each of the Houses keeps a few heirloom warships from the time of the old empire, and most dare not bring them from the gilded vaults where they lie, for they are far too precious to risk in petty conflicts. Yet another still fielded one of theirs, raided the moon, killed hundreds, all to steal a single cloaking unit. Now they flit about unseen."|1204|0
units.english: "'Twas one of the High Houses, but which exactly, we do not know yet for certain." Kampa contemplates for a moment. "Each of the Houses keeps a few heirloom warships from the time of the old empire, and most dare not bring them from the gilded vaults where they lie, for they are far too precious to risk in petty conflicts. Yet another still fielded one of theirs, raided the moon, killed hundreds, all to steal a single cloaking unit. Now they flit about unseen."
units.italian: "È stata una delle Casate Alte, ma quale esattamente non lo sappiamo ancora con certezza." Kampa riflette un momento. "Ognuna delle Casate conserva alcune navi da guerra di famiglia dell'epoca del vecchio impero, e quasi tutte non osano portarle fuori dalle volte dorate dove giacciono, perché sono troppo preziose per rischiarle in conflitti meschini. Eppure un'altra ha schierato una delle sue, ha fatto razzia sulla luna, ha ucciso centinaia di persone, tutto per rubare un singolo dispositivo di occultamento. Ora svolazzano invisibili."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	There's a pause as Kampa looks at you with incisive eyes. "Thou'rt fair to ask it," they say. "No," they say, "'twas not Kaatrij that struck them. Once our cloak was stolen, our 'lusive foe had all 'twas needed t'frame us of that trait'rous blow: t'let themselves be seen with signs that we alone had once posses'd."|1210|0
units.english: There's a pause as Kampa looks at you with incisive eyes. "Thou'rt fair to ask it," they say. "No," they say, "'twas not Kaatrij that struck them. Once our cloak was stolen, our 'lusive foe had all 'twas needed t'frame us of that trait'rous blow: t'let themselves be seen with signs that we alone had once posses'd."
units.italian: C'è una pausa mentre Kampa ti guarda con occhi incisivi. "È giusto che tu lo chieda," dice. "No," dice, "non è stata Kaatrij a colpirli. Una volta rubato il nostro mantello, il nostro elusivo nemico aveva tutto ciò che serviva per incolparci di quel colpo proditorio: lasciarsi vedere con segni che noi soli un tempo possedevamo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	Kampa's skin ripples with hollow mirth. "Not exactly," they say. "'Twere creations of an ally of the old House Kaatrij during the last great inter-Houses war, a bold engineer of Aqrabe. Autonomous as they were, they could - when stripp'd of those drives that spoiled the savor of our victory - remain to ward off plund'rers of our cities and hidden vaults."|1216|0
units.english: Kampa's skin ripples with hollow mirth. "Not exactly," they say. "'Twere creations of an ally of the old House Kaatrij during the last great inter-Houses war, a bold engineer of Aqrabe. Autonomous as they were, they could - when stripp'd of those drives that spoiled the savor of our victory - remain to ward off plund'rers of our cities and hidden vaults."
units.italian: La pelle di Kampa si increspa di un'ilarità vuota. "Non esattamente," dice. "Erano creazioni di un alleato della vecchia Casa Kaatrij durante l'ultima grande guerra tra le Casate, un ingegnere audace di Aqrabe. Autonome com'erano, potevano - una volta spogliate di quei motori che guastavano il sapore della nostra vittoria - restare a guardia dai predoni delle nostre città e delle nostre volte nascoste."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"I shan't tell thee exactly," Kampa says. "Thy retrieval of the stellar metal for Aqrabe has been a boon to us in that, though."|1222|0
units.english: "I shan't tell thee exactly," Kampa says. "Thy retrieval of the stellar metal for Aqrabe has been a boon to us in that, though."
units.italian: "Non te lo dirò esattamente," dice Kampa. "Il tuo recupero del metallo stellare per Aqrabe è stato però un aiuto in questo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	"We do not claim to be the equals of the Quarg in wisdom or grace," says Kampa, "but we share an affection for our species, and we would not see ourselves destroyed. The Quarg benefit from our cloaks and these dusty lands of ours; in turn, we have their counsel and consideration and, as 'tis necessary, some small material support."|1228|0
units.english: "We do not claim to be the equals of the Quarg in wisdom or grace," says Kampa, "but we share an affection for our species, and we would not see ourselves destroyed. The Quarg benefit from our cloaks and these dusty lands of ours; in turn, we have their counsel and consideration and, as 'tis necessary, some small material support."
units.italian: "Non pretendiamo di essere pari ai Quarg in saggezza o in grazia," dice Kampa, "ma condividiamo un affetto per la nostra specie, e non vorremmo vederci distrutti. I Quarg traggono beneficio dai nostri mantelli e da queste nostre terre polverose; in cambio abbiamo il loro consiglio e la loro considerazione e, quando è necessario, un piccolo sostegno materiale."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|	With that said, Kampa leaves the room, as does a distracted-looking Saajret soon after. As you also turn to go and explore the facility, the Quarg, still watching, stops you as it starts to speak. "Do you believe that the threads of the universe must tend to constrict?" it says in your own language. "Perhaps there is something inherent in separation that existence abhors." It hums, a deep and organic rumble. "You may go. Saajret waits for you in the spaceport."|1240|0
units.english: With that said, Kampa leaves the room, as does a distracted-looking Saajret soon after. As you also turn to go and explore the facility, the Quarg, still watching, stops you as it starts to speak. "Do you believe that the threads of the universe must tend to constrict?" it says in your own language. "Perhaps there is something inherent in separation that existence abhors." It hums, a deep and organic rumble. "You may go. Saajret waits for you in the spaceport."
units.italian: Detto questo, Kampa lascia la stanza, e poco dopo anche Saajret, dall'aria distratta. Mentre ti volti anche tu per andare a esplorare la struttura, il Quarg, che sta ancora osservando, ti ferma mentre comincia a parlare. "Credi che i fili dell'universo debbano tendere a stringersi?" dice nella tua lingua. "Forse c'è qualcosa di inerente nella separazione che l'esistenza aborrisce." Canticchia, un rombo profondo e organico. "Puoi andare. Saajret ti aspetta allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|name|1248|0
units.english: Visit Kaatrij archive
units.italian: Visita l'archivio Kaatrij

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|description|1249|0
units.english: Take Saajret to <planet stopovers> so they can consult one of House Kaatrij's offworld archives, before returning them to <planet>.
units.italian: Porta Saajret a <planet stopovers> perché possa consultare uno degli archivi fuori mondo di Casa Kaatrij, prima di riportarlo su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|Saajret meets you in a room overlooking your ship, once again dressed in their black pocket-laden outfit. They bow as you approach.|1257|0
units.english: Saajret meets you in a room overlooking your ship, once again dressed in their black pocket-laden outfit. They bow as you approach.
units.italian: Saajret ti incontra in una stanza che guarda sulla tua nave, di nuovo vestito con il suo abito nero pieno di tasche. Si inchina mentre ti avvicini.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"What's our task?"|1259|0
units.english: "What's our task?"
units.italian: "Qual è il nostro compito?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"How have you been?"|1261|0
units.english: "How have you been?"
units.italian: "Come stai?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	Saajret hums, colors of preoccupation dancing over their skin. "Well enough to focus on what's before us," they say. They pull their body into a more rigid posture.|1265|0
units.english: Saajret hums, colors of preoccupation dancing over their skin. "Well enough to focus on what's before us," they say. They pull their body into a more rigid posture.
units.italian: Saajret canticchia, colori di preoccupazione che danzano sulla pelle. "Abbastanza bene da concentrarmi su ciò che abbiamo davanti," dice. Raddrizza il corpo in una postura più rigida.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	Saajret hums, colors of preoccupation dancing over their skin. "Well enough to focus on what's before us," they say. "I shall thank thee again for indulging my little trip into the past. The sense of it stays with me." They shake their head and offer you another gentle bow.|1269|0
units.english: Saajret hums, colors of preoccupation dancing over their skin. "Well enough to focus on what's before us," they say. "I shall thank thee again for indulging my little trip into the past. The sense of it stays with me." They shake their head and offer you another gentle bow.
units.italian: Saajret canticchia, colori di preoccupazione che danzano sulla pelle. "Abbastanza bene da concentrarmi su ciò che abbiamo davanti," dice. "Ti ringrazio di nuovo per aver assecondato il mio piccolo viaggio nel passato. Il senso di ciò resta con me." Scuote la testa e ti offre un altro inchino leggero.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"Kaatrij maintains a number of offworld archives for our files since the time of our Predecessors. I've a certain angle I'd like to investigate at our archive on <planet stopovers>. Would'st thou transport me?"|1272|0
units.english: "Kaatrij maintains a number of offworld archives for our files since the time of our Predecessors. I've a certain angle I'd like to investigate at our archive on <planet stopovers>. Would'st thou transport me?"
units.italian: "Kaatrij mantiene diversi archivi fuori mondo per i nostri documenti dai tempi dei nostri Predecessori. Ho un certo punto che vorrei approfondire nel nostro archivio su <planet stopovers>. Mi ci porteresti?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"What sort of angle?"|1274|0
units.english: "What sort of angle?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di punto?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"I can't right now."|1275|0
units.english: "I can't right now."
units.italian: "Non posso, adesso."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	Saajret nods. "Kampa believes 'twas an heirloom warship of the Houses that was used against us. By comparing our scan data of the attack with historical information of ships used before our Predecessors' exile, I think I may be able to determine exactly which ship it was that struck us. And with it, the House that lies behind it."|1278|0
units.english: Saajret nods. "Kampa believes 'twas an heirloom warship of the Houses that was used against us. By comparing our scan data of the attack with historical information of ships used before our Predecessors' exile, I think I may be able to determine exactly which ship it was that struck us. And with it, the House that lies behind it."
units.italian: Saajret annuisce. "Kampa crede che contro di noi sia stata usata una nave da guerra di famiglia delle Casate. Confrontando i nostri dati di scansione dell'attacco con le informazioni storiche sulle navi usate prima dell'esilio dei nostri Predecessori, credo di poter determinare esattamente quale nave ci abbia colpito. E con essa, la Casa che vi sta dietro."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"All right, let's go."|1280|0
units.english: "All right, let's go."
units.italian: "Va bene, andiamo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"I can't right now."|1282|0
units.english: "I can't right now."
units.italian: "Non posso, adesso."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|Saajret directs you to land at a small facility set into the ground in the midst of one of this planet's forests. A couple of guards greet the two of you at the entrance, where Saajret presents their authorization, inserting a small data-chip into a pad beside the facility's door while a scanner beam passes over them. They wave you inside once the process is complete.|1288|0
units.english: Saajret directs you to land at a small facility set into the ground in the midst of one of this planet's forests. A couple of guards greet the two of you at the entrance, where Saajret presents their authorization, inserting a small data-chip into a pad beside the facility's door while a scanner beam passes over them. They wave you inside once the process is complete.
units.italian: Saajret ti indica di atterrare presso una piccola struttura incassata nel terreno, in mezzo a una delle foreste di questo pianeta. Un paio di guardie vi accolgono all'ingresso, dove Saajret presenta la sua autorizzazione, inserendo un piccolo chip di dati in un lettore accanto alla porta della struttura mentre un raggio scanner gli passa sopra. Vi fanno cenno di entrare quando la procedura è completa.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	The archive proves to be relatively modest by Successor standards; most of the engineering effort seems to have gone into armor rather than lush adornment. The two of you walk between long rows of storage units, each one suspending thousands of individual data-spheres in a bath of liquid metal. Saajret stops at a corner terminal in a section labeled for records between the years 1620 and 1636 and, after a few minutes of work, several data-spheres are bubbled up from one of the surrounding storage baths.|1289|0
units.english: The archive proves to be relatively modest by Successor standards; most of the engineering effort seems to have gone into armor rather than lush adornment. The two of you walk between long rows of storage units, each one suspending thousands of individual data-spheres in a bath of liquid metal. Saajret stops at a corner terminal in a section labeled for records between the years 1620 and 1636 and, after a few minutes of work, several data-spheres are bubbled up from one of the surrounding storage baths.
units.italian: L'archivio si rivela relativamente modesto per gli standard dei Successori; la maggior parte dello sforzo ingegneristico sembra essere andata nell'armatura più che negli ornamenti lussureggianti. Vi incamminate tra lunghe file di unità di stoccaggio, ognuna delle quali sospende migliaia di singole sfere di dati in un bagno di metallo liquido. Saajret si ferma a un terminale d'angolo in una sezione etichettata per i registri tra gli anni 1620 e 1636 e, dopo qualche minuto di lavoro, diverse sfere di dati risalgono a bolle da uno dei bagni di stoccaggio circostanti.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	Saajret plugs the spheres into the terminal and you watch over their shoulder as they consult the data within; what appears to be a mixture of dossiers on warships of the era and biographical data about their engineers. Saajret's skin blotches with confusion.|1290|0
units.english: Saajret plugs the spheres into the terminal and you watch over their shoulder as they consult the data within; what appears to be a mixture of dossiers on warships of the era and biographical data about their engineers. Saajret's skin blotches with confusion.
units.italian: Saajret collega le sfere al terminale e tu guardi sopra la sua spalla mentre consulta i dati all'interno; sembra una miscela di fascicoli su navi da guerra dell'epoca e dati biografici sui loro ingegneri. La pelle di Saajret si macchia di confusione.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"What is it?"|1292|0
units.english: "What is it?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"Have you found what you're looking for?"|1293|0
units.english: "Have you found what you're looking for?"
units.italian: "Hai trovato quello che cercavi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	Saajret hums. "To our knowledge," they say, "twenty-three heirloom warships were smuggled through the wormhole in our Predecessors' era. Of these, six were fast battlecruisers, named Valkkyiaran - and of those, only three could possibly be the craft that struck at Qasa-Sija-Iri. Their names were Alasii-i-Lua, Ijahti-Khora, and Akhos-Itran."|1294|0
units.english: Saajret hums. "To our knowledge," they say, "twenty-three heirloom warships were smuggled through the wormhole in our Predecessors' era. Of these, six were fast battlecruisers, named Valkkyiaran - and of those, only three could possibly be the craft that struck at Qasa-Sija-Iri. Their names were Alasii-i-Lua, Ijahti-Khora, and Akhos-Itran."
units.italian: Saajret canticchia. "A nostra conoscenza," dice, "ventitré navi da guerra di famiglia furono fatte passare di contrabbando dal cunicolo nell'epoca dei nostri Predecessori. Di queste, sei erano incrociatori da battaglia veloci, chiamati Valkkyiaran - e di quelle, solo tre potevano essere il vascello che ha colpito Qasa-Sija-Iri. I loro nomi erano Alasii-i-Lua, Ijahti-Khora e Akhos-Itran."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"Do you know what House they belonged to?"|1296|0
units.english: "Do you know what House they belonged to?"
units.italian: "Sai a quale Casa appartenevano?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"Is there no way to tell which one exactly was behind the attack?"|1297|0
units.english: "Is there no way to tell which one exactly was behind the attack?"
units.italian: "Non c'è modo di dire quale esattamente sia stata dietro l'attacco?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"That is where misfortune meets us," Saajret says. "All three of those were made for a combined alliance that fought in the last great inter-Houses war; when t'were disassembled and smuggled away, we know not which House of the alliance spirited each away. Much remains unclear."|1298|0
units.english: "That is where misfortune meets us," Saajret says. "All three of those were made for a combined alliance that fought in the last great inter-Houses war; when t'were disassembled and smuggled away, we know not which House of the alliance spirited each away. Much remains unclear."
units.italian: "È qui che la sfortuna ci viene incontro," dice Saajret. "Tutte e tre furono costruite per un'alleanza congiunta che combatté nell'ultima grande guerra tra le Casate; quando furono smontate e portate via di contrabbando, non sappiamo quale Casa dell'alleanza abbia portato via ciascuna. Molto resta poco chiaro."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"Do you have any data on the drone ships?"|1300|0
units.english: "Do you have any data on the drone ships?"
units.italian: "Hai dei dati sulle navi drone?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"We'd better return, then."|1301|0
units.english: "We'd better return, then."
units.italian: "Meglio tornare, allora."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	"A good thought, captain," Saajret says. A difficult-to-identify emotion flits over their skin as they return to the terminal. They download some of the biographical data they were consulting into a portable data-sphere and, once they have tracked down data pertaining to the ships themselves, download that as well.|1304|0
units.english: "A good thought, captain," Saajret says. A difficult-to-identify emotion flits over their skin as they return to the terminal. They download some of the biographical data they were consulting into a portable data-sphere and, once they have tracked down data pertaining to the ships themselves, download that as well.
units.italian: "Buona idea, capitano," dice Saajret. Un'emozione difficile da identificare guizza sulla pelle mentre torna al terminale. Scarica alcuni dei dati biografici che stava consultando in una sfera di dati portatile e, una volta rintracciati i dati riguardanti le navi stesse, scarica anche quelli.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	The drone ships themselves were designed by a Myiara named Resja, a noted shipwright for the old House Aqrabe. Initially, the craft were designed for small crews, but after Resja's death - apparently by poisoning - they were retrofitted with drone cores and robotic maintenance systems, after which they served first as expendable rearguards and finally as the lingering defense systems that you've encountered.|1305|0
units.english: The drone ships themselves were designed by a Myiara named Resja, a noted shipwright for the old House Aqrabe. Initially, the craft were designed for small crews, but after Resja's death - apparently by poisoning - they were retrofitted with drone cores and robotic maintenance systems, after which they served first as expendable rearguards and finally as the lingering defense systems that you've encountered.
units.italian: Le navi drone stesse furono progettate da una Myiara di nome Resja, nota costruttrice navale della vecchia Casa Aqrabe. Inizialmente il vascello era progettato per equipaggi ridotti, ma dopo la morte di Resja - apparentemente per avvelenamento - fu riadattato con nuclei drone e sistemi di manutenzione robotici, dopo di che servì prima come retroguardia sacrificabile e infine come i sistemi di difesa persistenti che hai incontrato.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	The biographical data is added to your log.|1306|0
units.english: The biographical data is added to your log.
units.italian: I dati biografici vengono aggiunti al tuo diario.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|log|1311|0
units.english: People
units.italian: People

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	With Saajret satisfied that the two of you have gleaned what information you can, you both return to the <ship> outside.|1314|0
units.english: With Saajret satisfied that the two of you have gleaned what information you can, you both return to the <ship> outside.
units.italian: Con Saajret soddisfatto che abbiate raccolto le informazioni che potevate, tornate entrambi alla <ship> fuori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|dialog|1317|0
units.english: Saajret thanks you for transporting them and asks to meet you back in one of the spaceport planning rooms once they have shown their data to Kaatrij's military officers.
units.italian: Saajret ti ringrazia per il trasporto e ti chiede di incontrarlo in una delle sale di pianificazione dello spazioporto, dopo che avrà mostrato i suoi dati agli ufficiali militari di Kaatrij.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 12|name|1325|0
units.english: Pick up keystone shipment
units.italian: Ritira il carico di chiavi di volta

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 12|description|1326|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to pick up 16 tons of modified quantum keystones from House Aqrabe.
units.italian: Viaggia verso <destination> per ritirare 16 tonnellate di chiavi di volta quantistiche modificate da Casa Aqrabe.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 12|Though Saajret fails to meet you at the spaceport, you are soon delivered a data-sphere with a message from them:|1333|0
units.english: Though Saajret fails to meet you at the spaceport, you are soon delivered a data-sphere with a message from them:
units.italian: Sebbene Saajret non si presenti allo spazioporto, poco dopo ti viene consegnata una sfera di dati con un suo messaggio:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 12|	'My apologies for not meeting thee as we agreed. Kaatrij requests thou transport a quantity of Aqrabe's new keystones from <destination> back here for outfitting. They should amount to sixteen tons in total.|1334|0
units.english: 'My apologies for not meeting thee as we agreed. Kaatrij requests thou transport a quantity of Aqrabe's new keystones from <destination> back here for outfitting. They should amount to sixteen tons in total.
units.italian: 'Le mie scuse per non incontrarti come convenuto. Kaatrij chiede che tu trasporti una quantità delle nuove chiavi di volta di Aqrabe da <destination> fino a qui per l'allestimento. Dovrebbero ammontare a sedici tonnellate in totale.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 12|	This I myself attest as K- I- Saajret, of Somber Sejra.|1335|0
units.english: This I myself attest as K- I- Saajret, of Somber Sejra.
units.italian: Questo io stesso attesto come K- I- Saajret, di Somber Sejra.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 13|name|1345|0
units.english: Deliver keystone shipment
units.italian: Consegna il carico di chiavi di volta

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 13|description|1346|0
units.english: Return the <tons> of <cargo> to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta le <tons> di <cargo> su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 13|Not long after disembarking you are met by Tiliia, the Aqrabe engineer you worked with before. They splay their arms courteously to you while, behind them, crates of keystones are carried by and soon loaded into the <ship>.|1357|0
units.english: Not long after disembarking you are met by Tiliia, the Aqrabe engineer you worked with before. They splay their arms courteously to you while, behind them, crates of keystones are carried by and soon loaded into the <ship>.
units.italian: Poco dopo lo sbarco ti incontra Tiliia, l'ingegnera di Aqrabe con cui hai già lavorato. Apre le braccia con cortesia verso di te mentre, dietro di lei, casse di chiavi di volta vengono portate e caricate poco dopo sulla <ship>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 13|	"I thought it fair to see this shipment off myself," Tiliia says by way of introduction. "Though it pleaseth me to see thee again as well, Captain."|1358|0
units.english: "I thought it fair to see this shipment off myself," Tiliia says by way of introduction. "Though it pleaseth me to see thee again as well, Captain."
units.italian: "Mi è parso giusto salutare di persona questa spedizione," dice Tiliia come presentazione. "Anche se mi fa piacere rivederti, capitano."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 13|	"Likewise."|1360|0
units.english: "Likewise."
units.italian: "Altrettanto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 13|	"I'm surprised you're letting go of the keystones so easily."|1362|0
units.english: "I'm surprised you're letting go of the keystones so easily."
units.italian: "Mi sorprende che lasciate andare le chiavi di volta tanto facilmente."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 13|	Some mirth seems to come over Tiliia. "We've enough to do so now. And I imagine House Kaatrij has offered Aqrabe generous compensation for them, too. It's good they're trading with us at all now. If only I could work fast enough to satisfy that appetite for novelty!"|1364|0
units.english: Some mirth seems to come over Tiliia. "We've enough to do so now. And I imagine House Kaatrij has offered Aqrabe generous compensation for them, too. It's good they're trading with us at all now. If only I could work fast enough to satisfy that appetite for novelty!"
units.italian: Una certa ilarità sembra impadronirsi di Tiliia. "Ora ne abbiamo abbastanza per farlo. E immagino che Casa Kaatrij abbia offerto ad Aqrabe un compenso generoso. È già buono che commerci con noi, ora. Se solo potessi lavorare abbastanza in fretta da soddisfare quell'appetito di novità!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 13|	The two of you chat for a few more minutes as the keystones are loaded. Eventually, Tiliia offers you a "farewell" before returning to their work and leaving you to prepare your ship for departure.|1368|0
units.english: The two of you chat for a few more minutes as the keystones are loaded. Eventually, Tiliia offers you a "farewell" before returning to their work and leaving you to prepare your ship for departure.
units.italian: Chiacchierate ancora qualche minuto mentre le chiavi di volta vengono caricate. Alla fine Tiliia ti dà un "arrivederci" prima di tornare al suo lavoro e lasciarti preparare la nave alla partenza.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 13|label|1371|0
units.english: prototypes only
units.italian: prototypes only

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 13|Not long after disembarking you are met by Tiliia, the Aqrabe engineer you worked with recently. They offer you a perfunctory and hurried splay of the arms. "Thou'rt here for the keystone shipment, I take it?" they say in a clipped tone. You nod in reply. "Well, Kaatrij will get their sixteen tons, but let them know they're only prototypes. Politics moves faster than my work." They turn to depart, clearly eager to get back to it, before stopping and offering you a quick "good to see thee, Captain," before they leave you to oversee the loading of the keystones.|1372|0
units.english: Not long after disembarking you are met by Tiliia, the Aqrabe engineer you worked with recently. They offer you a perfunctory and hurried splay of the arms. "Thou'rt here for the keystone shipment, I take it?" they say in a clipped tone. You nod in reply. "Well, Kaatrij will get their sixteen tons, but let them know they're only prototypes. Politics moves faster than my work." They turn to depart, clearly eager to get back to it, before stopping and offering you a quick "good to see thee, Captain," before they leave you to oversee the loading of the keystones.
units.italian: Poco dopo lo sbarco ti incontra Tiliia, l'ingegnera di Aqrabe con cui hai lavorato di recente. Ti offre un'apertura delle braccia frettolosa e di pura formalità. "Sei qui per il carico di chiavi di volta, immagino?" dice in tono brusco. Annuisci in risposta. "Beh, Kaatrij avrà le sue sedici tonnellate, ma fagli sapere che sono solo prototipi. La politica si muove più in fretta del mio lavoro." Si volta per andarsene, chiaramente impaziente di tornarci, prima di fermarsi e offrirti un rapido "piacere di vederti, capitano", e poi ti lascia a sovrintendere al carico delle chiavi di volta.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 13|dialog|1376|0
units.english: The base's outfitter takes possession of the keystones and informs you that Saajret would like to see you in the spaceport later this evening.
units.italian: Il fornitore della base prende possesso delle chiavi di volta e ti informa che Saajret vorrebbe vederti allo spazioporto stasera.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|name|1384|0
units.english: Destroy sensor probes
units.italian: Distruggi le sonde sensore

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|description|1385|0
units.english: House Kaatrij is concerned that the sensor probes in Predecessor space are being used against them, and have asked you to destroy them in Avasaa-Novaa, Eta Carinae, Khasola-Ryuit, and Kasii-Sola.
units.italian: Casa Kaatrij teme che le sonde sensore nello spazio dei Predecessori siano usate contro di loro, e ti ha chiesto di distruggerle in Avasaa-Novaa, Eta Carinae, Khasola-Ryuit e Kasii-Sola.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|Saajret meets you in another one of the spaceport's overlooking rooms, a liquid-metal starchart laid out on a table before them. It looks like it's showing areas of Predecessor space. They greet you with a splay of the arms as you enter.|1395|0
units.english: Saajret meets you in another one of the spaceport's overlooking rooms, a liquid-metal starchart laid out on a table before them. It looks like it's showing areas of Predecessor space. They greet you with a splay of the arms as you enter.
units.italian: Saajret ti incontra in un'altra delle sale panoramiche dello spazioporto, con una mappa stellare di metallo liquido stesa su un tavolo davanti a sé. Sembra mostrare aree dello spazio dei Predecessori. Ti saluta con un'apertura delle braccia mentre entri.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|	"Is this my next mission?" you ask, gesturing to the starchart.|1396|0
units.english: "Is this my next mission?" you ask, gesturing to the starchart.
units.italian: "È la mia prossima missione?" chiedi, indicando la mappa stellare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|	Saajret hums thoughtfully. "Yes," they say. "One of the things thou did earli'r was the placement of scanning eyes throughout the Shroud, at Seineq's dear request."|1397|0
units.english: Saajret hums thoughtfully. "Yes," they say. "One of the things thou did earli'r was the placement of scanning eyes throughout the Shroud, at Seineq's dear request."
units.italian: Saajret canticchia pensieroso. "Sì," dice. "Una delle cose che facesti prima fu il collocamento di occhi scanner in tutto lo Shroud, su gradita richiesta di Seineq."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|	"I recall."|1399|0
units.english: "I recall."
units.italian: "Ricordo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|	"Could Seineq be the House behind the attack?"|1401|0
units.english: "Could Seineq be the House behind the attack?"
units.italian: "Seineq potrebbe essere la Casa dietro l'attacco?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|	Whorls of pink mirth erupt over Saajret's skin. "Perhaps so, perhaps not," they say. "For now, Kaatrij's aim is more direct. The eyes make notes of jumps of the proper sort, as are made by thine own craft and the Quarg - but the flitting of our foe relies on aught uncanni'r that we believe evades their gaze. Thus, as Kampa's wont to say, they are to us a tactical disadvantage. Kaatrij seeks that thou, and I, observing, destroy them."|1403|0
units.english: Whorls of pink mirth erupt over Saajret's skin. "Perhaps so, perhaps not," they say. "For now, Kaatrij's aim is more direct. The eyes make notes of jumps of the proper sort, as are made by thine own craft and the Quarg - but the flitting of our foe relies on aught uncanni'r that we believe evades their gaze. Thus, as Kampa's wont to say, they are to us a tactical disadvantage. Kaatrij seeks that thou, and I, observing, destroy them."
units.italian: Gorghi di ilarità rosa erompono sulla pelle di Saajret. "Forse sì, forse no," dice. "Per ora l'obiettivo di Kaatrij è più diretto. Gli occhi prendono nota dei salti del tipo giusto, come quelli della tua nave e dei Quarg; ma il guizzare del nostro nemico si basa su qualcosa di più arcano che crediamo sfugga al loro sguardo. Perciò, come usa dire Kampa, sono per noi uno svantaggio tattico. Kaatrij chiede che tu e io, osservando, li distruggiamo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|	"Kaatrij now seeks that thou undoeth this, with my presence as observer. 'Thout Seineq's control of those, our foe might come to watch them - 'tis a risk Kaatrij is loath to take. For they make note of jumps of the proper sort, as made by thy craft and the Quarg's alike. But the flitting of our foe relies on aught uncanni'r that we think evades their gaze. Thus, they reveal not the comings and goings of the guilty but thee and perhaps our own craft."|1407|0
units.english: "Kaatrij now seeks that thou undoeth this, with my presence as observer. 'Thout Seineq's control of those, our foe might come to watch them - 'tis a risk Kaatrij is loath to take. For they make note of jumps of the proper sort, as made by thy craft and the Quarg's alike. But the flitting of our foe relies on aught uncanni'r that we think evades their gaze. Thus, they reveal not the comings and goings of the guilty but thee and perhaps our own craft."
units.italian: "Kaatrij ora chiede che tu disfaccia questo, con la mia presenza come osservatore. Senza il controllo di Seineq su di essi, il nostro nemico potrebbe venire a sorvegliarli: un rischio che Kaatrij ripugna correre. Perché essi prendono nota dei salti del tipo giusto, come quelli della tua nave e di quelle dei Quarg. Ma il guizzare del nostro nemico si basa su qualcosa di più arcano che pensiamo sfugga al loro sguardo. Così non rivelano gli andirivieni dei colpevoli, ma te e forse le nostre stesse navi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|	"Why are you joining me?"|1411|0
units.english: "Why are you joining me?"
units.italian: "Perché vieni con me?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|	"What do you mean, 'something uncannier?'"|1415|0
units.english: "What do you mean, 'something uncannier?'"
units.italian: "Che vuoi dire con 'qualcosa di più arcano'?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|	"All right, I'm ready to go."|1419|0
units.english: "All right, I'm ready to go."
units.italian: "Va bene, sono pronto a partire."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|	Saajret's skin bubbles with dark blue spots. "The Quarg say thou hast already learn'd of our Predecessors' efforts to sail beyond the bound'ries set by the Drak. The drives 'twere built to do this are that uncanny thing of which I speak."|1425|0
units.english: Saajret's skin bubbles with dark blue spots. "The Quarg say thou hast already learn'd of our Predecessors' efforts to sail beyond the bound'ries set by the Drak. The drives 'twere built to do this are that uncanny thing of which I speak."
units.italian: La pelle di Saajret ribolle di macchie blu scuro. "I Quarg dicono che hai già saputo degli sforzi dei nostri Predecessori per navigare oltre i confini fissati dai Drak. I motori costruiti per farlo sono quella cosa arcana di cui parlo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|	Saajret hums. "Thy presence here is still new, captain, and Kaatrij would not send thee far 'thout someone to look over thee. And for myself particularly," they say, looking out at your ship below them, "I have spoken to thee the most, and my role as archivist makes me knowledgeable of the things we may find in the blighted worlds of the Shroud."|1431|0
units.english: Saajret hums. "Thy presence here is still new, captain, and Kaatrij would not send thee far 'thout someone to look over thee. And for myself particularly," they say, looking out at your ship below them, "I have spoken to thee the most, and my role as archivist makes me knowledgeable of the things we may find in the blighted worlds of the Shroud."
units.italian: Saajret canticchia. "La tua presenza qui è ancora nuova, capitano, e Kaatrij non ti manderebbe lontano senza qualcuno che ti tenga d'occhio. E quanto a me in particolare," dice, guardando la tua nave sotto di loro, "ho parlato con te più che con chiunque altro, e il mio ruolo di archivista mi rende esperto delle cose che possiamo trovare nei mondi colpiti dalla rovina dello Shroud."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|dialog|1435|0
units.english: Though it takes several seconds for your ship's targeting scanners to pinpoint the scanning probe you deployed earlier, they eventually find it. A single shot is all it takes to destroy it.
units.italian: Anche se ci vogliono diversi secondi perché gli scanner di puntamento della nave individuino la sonda scanner che hai schierato prima, alla fine la trovano. Basta un solo colpo per distruggerla.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|dialog|1438|0
units.english: You find the scanner tucked among some particularly vibrant nebular gas. It is easily dispatched.
units.italian: Trovi lo scanner nascosto tra del gas nebulare particolarmente vivace. È facilmente eliminabile.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|dialog|1441|0
units.english: Undoing your earlier hard work, you locate and destroy the scanner in this system.
units.italian: Disfacendo il tuo duro lavoro precedente, individui e distruggi lo scanner in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 14|dialog|1444|0
units.english: With this system cleared, you've destroyed all the sensor probes except the one in Kasii-Sola.
units.italian: Con questo sistema ripulito, hai distrutto tutte le sonde sensore tranne quella in Kasii-Sola.
