units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 15|As you enter the system, your ship's sensors remark on an object that wasn't here the last time: a space station has appeared in close solar orbit. Every few seconds your lock on the station breaks before it is quickly reacquired.|1469|0
units.english: As you enter the system, your ship's sensors remark on an object that wasn't here the last time: a space station has appeared in close solar orbit. Every few seconds your lock on the station breaks before it is quickly reacquired.
units.italian: Mentre entri nel sistema, i sensori della nave segnalano un oggetto che non c'era l'ultima volta: una stazione spaziale è comparsa in orbita solare ravvicinata. Ogni pochi secondi l'aggancio alla stazione si perde prima di essere rapidamente riacquisito.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 15|	Saajret's look at examining the station is one of despair. "Wretches!" they say. "We shall need to address this upon returning. Our time is running short, Captain. Let us destroy the fourth probe with haste."|1470|0
units.english: Saajret's look at examining the station is one of despair. "Wretches!" they say. "We shall need to address this upon returning. Our time is running short, Captain. Let us destroy the fourth probe with haste."
units.italian: Lo sguardo di Saajret mentre esamina la stazione è di disperazione. "Miserabili!" dice. "Dovremo occuparcene al ritorno. Il nostro tempo si accorcia, capitano. Distruggiamo la quarta sonda in fretta."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 15|	"You recognize that station?"|1472|0
units.english: "You recognize that station?"
units.italian: "Riconosci quella stazione?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 15|	"What's going on here?"|1473|0
units.english: "What's going on here?"
units.italian: "Che cosa succede qui?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 15|	Saajret hums for a moment. "Fine, fine. It's one of ours, a citadel of old Kaatrij from bygone years. 'Twas cloaked, of course. 'Til now, t'would seem; and so we are outmaneuvered again. That is why we must be quick, Captain; thou mustn't delay."|1474|0
units.english: Saajret hums for a moment. "Fine, fine. It's one of ours, a citadel of old Kaatrij from bygone years. 'Twas cloaked, of course. 'Til now, t'would seem; and so we are outmaneuvered again. That is why we must be quick, Captain; thou mustn't delay."
units.italian: Saajret canticchia per un momento. "Va bene, va bene. È una delle nostre, una cittadella della vecchia Kaatrij di anni passati. Era occultata, naturalmente. Fino a ora, a quanto pare; e così siamo di nuovo superati in astuzia. Ecco perché dobbiamo fare presto, capitano; non devi indugiare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 15|While you are presenting your landing authorization, Saajret calls for several members of Kaatrij to meet you in the docking bay; by the time you land, they are there waiting, slithering over to speak to Saajret almost immediately. The leader of this group dismisses you and Saajret, with an apologetic bow, asks you to meet them at the <planet> spaceport in an hour.|1479|0
units.english: While you are presenting your landing authorization, Saajret calls for several members of Kaatrij to meet you in the docking bay; by the time you land, they are there waiting, slithering over to speak to Saajret almost immediately. The leader of this group dismisses you and Saajret, with an apologetic bow, asks you to meet them at the <planet> spaceport in an hour.
units.italian: Mentre presenti la tua autorizzazione all'atterraggio, Saajret chiama diversi membri di Kaatrij a incontrarvi nella baia di attracco; quando atterri sono già lì ad aspettare, e strisciano verso Saajret per parlargli quasi subito. Il capo di questo gruppo ti congeda e Saajret, con un inchino di scuse, ti chiede di incontrarli allo spazioporto di <planet> tra un'ora.

units.id: mission:Successors: Saajret Remarks|As the stygian fog of the Tangled Shroud fades away to reveal normal space, Saajret makes a small noise of excitement, their skin dancing with bright hues. "So long it's been," they say, "since one of ours has seen beyond the horizon of our folly. I confess I wonder what the rest of the galaxy has become after fifteen hundred years of solitude." They shake their head, the regions of color splashing like water. "Yet our task remains. Perhaps in some future time..."|1496|0
units.english: As the stygian fog of the Tangled Shroud fades away to reveal normal space, Saajret makes a small noise of excitement, their skin dancing with bright hues. "So long it's been," they say, "since one of ours has seen beyond the horizon of our folly. I confess I wonder what the rest of the galaxy has become after fifteen hundred years of solitude." They shake their head, the regions of color splashing like water. "Yet our task remains. Perhaps in some future time..."
units.italian: Mentre la nebbia stigia del Tangled Shroud svanisce per rivelare lo spazio normale, Saajret emette un piccolo rumore di eccitazione, la pelle che danza di tinte brillanti. "È tanto che non accadeva," dice, "che uno dei nostri vedesse oltre l'orizzonte della nostra follia. Confesso che mi chiedo cosa sia diventato il resto della galassia dopo millecinquecento anni di solitudine." Scuote la testa, le regioni di colore che si spargono come acqua. "Eppure il nostro compito resta. Forse in qualche tempo futuro..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Saajret Remarks|	"There are more things in heaven and earth, Saajret, than are dreamed of in your philosophy."|1498|0
units.english: "There are more things in heaven and earth, Saajret, than are dreamed of in your philosophy."
units.italian: "Ci sono più cose in cielo e in terra, Saajret, di quante ne sogni la tua filosofia."

units.id: mission:Successors: Saajret Remarks|	"The galaxy isn't all you make it out to be, at least in my experience."|1499|0
units.english: "The galaxy isn't all you make it out to be, at least in my experience."
units.italian: "La galassia non è tutto quello che pensi, almeno per la mia esperienza."

units.id: mission:Successors: Saajret Remarks|	They hum, long and slow. "Perhaps," they say.|1500|0
units.english: They hum, long and slow. "Perhaps," they say.
units.italian: Canticchiano, a lungo e lentamente. "Forse," dicono.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|name|1506|0
units.english: Investigate mysterious station
units.italian: Indaga sulla stazione misteriosa

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|description|1507|0
units.english: Return to the mysterious station in <system> with Saajret to investigate what has happened to it.
units.italian: Torna alla stazione misteriosa in <system> con Saajret per indagare su cosa le è successo.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|government|1513|0
units.english: House Kaatrij
units.italian: House Kaatrij

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|Saajret meets with you in a small room about fifteen degrees around the ring of the cloaked facility. It's circular with a shallow pool in the middle; something similar to moss crawls up the walls and a couple of small flowering plants poke their colorful heads up underfoot.|1518|0
units.english: Saajret meets with you in a small room about fifteen degrees around the ring of the cloaked facility. It's circular with a shallow pool in the middle; something similar to moss crawls up the walls and a couple of small flowering plants poke their colorful heads up underfoot.
units.italian: Saajret ti incontra in una piccola stanza a circa quindici gradi lungo l'anello della struttura occultata. È circolare, con una pozza poco profonda al centro; qualcosa di simile a muschio si arrampica sui muri e un paio di piccole piante fiorite spuntano i loro capi colorati sotto i piedi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"My thanks to thee for thy help so far," Saajret says. "I hope thou hast found our little shared space here comfortable enough."|1519|0
units.english: "My thanks to thee for thy help so far," Saajret says. "I hope thou hast found our little shared space here comfortable enough."
units.italian: "La mia gratitudine per il tuo aiuto finora," dice Saajret. "Spero che tu abbia trovato abbastanza confortevole il nostro piccolo spazio condiviso qui."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"I have."|1521|0
units.english: "I have."
units.italian: "L'ho fatto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"What's the situation with that station?"|1522|0
units.english: "What's the situation with that station?"
units.italian: "Qual è la situazione con quella stazione?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	Saajret nods. "I've conferred with Kaatrij and our Quarg patrons and, for once, we are all agreed. Two tasks lie before us, with thou included if thou wilt: first, we must assess how our citadel has been plunder'd. 'Tis well-defended, and seeing as its cloak was not fully disabled, its security must remain at least partially op'rative. For this, thou might'st play a vital role, again with thy unhind'red craft."|1523|0
units.english: Saajret nods. "I've conferred with Kaatrij and our Quarg patrons and, for once, we are all agreed. Two tasks lie before us, with thou included if thou wilt: first, we must assess how our citadel has been plunder'd. 'Tis well-defended, and seeing as its cloak was not fully disabled, its security must remain at least partially op'rative. For this, thou might'st play a vital role, again with thy unhind'red craft."
units.italian: Saajret annuisce. "Mi sono consultato con Kaatrij e con i nostri patroni Quarg e, per una volta, siamo tutti d'accordo. Ci restano due compiti, con te incluso se accetti: primo, dobbiamo valutare come la nostra cittadella sia stata saccheggiata. È ben difesa, e visto che il suo mantello non è stato del tutto disattivato, la sua sicurezza deve restare almeno in parte operativa. In questo potresti avere un ruolo vitale, sempre con la tua nave senza impedimenti."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|label|1524|0
units.english: questions 1
units.italian: questions 1

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"'Security?' Not sure I like the sound of that."|1526|0
units.english: "'Security?' Not sure I like the sound of that."
units.italian: "'Sicurezza?' Non so se mi piace come suona."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"How could it have been revealed in the first place?"|1530|0
units.english: "How could it have been revealed in the first place?"
units.italian: "Come ha potuto essere rivelata, in primo luogo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"What's the second task?"|1534|0
units.english: "What's the second task?"
units.italian: "Qual è il secondo compito?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	Saajret prods a flower on the floor with the tip of one of their arms. "I've been fashioned with keys to elude the station's own defenses. That which poses the most threat to us are the independent ones; thou hast before met the guardian drone ships? With the citadel reveal'd, no doubt one has already taken up residence there."|1540|0
units.english: Saajret prods a flower on the floor with the tip of one of their arms. "I've been fashioned with keys to elude the station's own defenses. That which poses the most threat to us are the independent ones; thou hast before met the guardian drone ships? With the citadel reveal'd, no doubt one has already taken up residence there."
units.italian: Saajret stuzzica un fiore sul pavimento con la punta di uno dei suoi bracci. "Sono stato fornito di chiavi per eludere le difese della stazione stessa. Quelle che ci minacciano di più sono quelle indipendenti; hai già incontrato le navi drone guardiane? Con la cittadella rivelata, senza dubbio una vi ha già preso dimora."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"That may be the most pertinent question that faces us all now, Captain." Many-colored waves ripple over Saajret's skin. "The location of our citadel, I am now told, was known to precious few within Kaatrij and none without. It suggests what I've suspected all along; one within Kaatrij has betrayed the House, sold our secrets to another."|1546|0
units.english: "That may be the most pertinent question that faces us all now, Captain." Many-colored waves ripple over Saajret's skin. "The location of our citadel, I am now told, was known to precious few within Kaatrij and none without. It suggests what I've suspected all along; one within Kaatrij has betrayed the House, sold our secrets to another."
units.italian: "Potrebbe essere la domanda più pertinente che ci sta davanti ora, capitano." Onde multicolori si propagano sulla pelle di Saajret. "La posizione della nostra cittadella, mi dicono ora, era nota a pochissimi dentro Kaatrij e a nessuno fuori. Il che suggerisce ciò che sospetto da sempre: uno dentro Kaatrij ha tradito la Casa, ha venduto i nostri segreti a un'altra."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"Secondly," says Saajret, "'tis clear we must end this flitting about in the shadow of our foe. While thou and I breach the citadel, Kaatrij and the Quarg here plan a trap to snare an heirloom warship. To destroy such a craft would be a great wound to our attacker, and would, if we are fortunate, give us some measure of their identity.|1553|0
units.english: "Secondly," says Saajret, "'tis clear we must end this flitting about in the shadow of our foe. While thou and I breach the citadel, Kaatrij and the Quarg here plan a trap to snare an heirloom warship. To destroy such a craft would be a great wound to our attacker, and would, if we are fortunate, give us some measure of their identity.
units.italian: "In secondo luogo," dice Saajret, "è chiaro che dobbiamo porre fine a questo svolazzare nell'ombra del nostro nemico. Mentre tu e io violiamo la cittadella, Kaatrij e i Quarg qui preparano una trappola per catturare una nave da guerra di famiglia. Distruggere un vascello simile sarebbe una grande ferita per il nostro aggressore e, se saremo fortunati, ci darebbe qualche misura della sua identità.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"How do you plan to catch it if it's cloaked?"|1555|0
units.english: "How do you plan to catch it if it's cloaked?"
units.italian: "Come pensate di catturarla, se è occultata?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"All right, what's next?"|1556|0
units.english: "All right, what's next?"
units.italian: "Va bene, e adesso?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	The mess of colors dotting Saajret's face resolves into a unified shade of satisfaction. "The Quarg, it seems, have certain ways to uncover such hidden craft. An old foe of theirs used a similar tactic, I'm told. Convincing them to share aught is a lifetime task for the most persuasive of diplomats, but in this instance they may help us for the sake of quieting that ship's space-ripping drive. For that," they say, "they are most eager."|1558|0
units.english: The mess of colors dotting Saajret's face resolves into a unified shade of satisfaction. "The Quarg, it seems, have certain ways to uncover such hidden craft. An old foe of theirs used a similar tactic, I'm told. Convincing them to share aught is a lifetime task for the most persuasive of diplomats, but in this instance they may help us for the sake of quieting that ship's space-ripping drive. For that," they say, "they are most eager."
units.italian: Il guazzabuglio di colori sul viso di Saajret si ricompone in un'unica tonalità di soddisfazione. "I Quarg, pare, hanno certi modi per scoprire simili vascelli nascosti. Un loro vecchio nemico usò una tattica simile, mi dicono. Convincerli a condividere qualcosa è un'impresa lunga quanto una vita per il più persuasivo dei diplomatici, ma in questo caso potrebbero aiutarci per quietare il motore che squarcia lo spazio di quella nave. Per questo," dice, "sono quanto mai desiderosi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	A fine mist is emitted by ports on the ceiling, watering the plants and gathering in tiny spheres on your clothes. "We should prepare for our journey to the citadel. Equip thy craft as thou desireth, then let us depart."|1561|0
units.english: A fine mist is emitted by ports on the ceiling, watering the plants and gathering in tiny spheres on your clothes. "We should prepare for our journey to the citadel. Equip thy craft as thou desireth, then let us depart."
units.italian: Una nebbiolina fine viene emessa da bocche sul soffitto, che annaffia le piante e si raccoglie in piccole sfere sui tuoi vestiti. "Dovremmo prepararci al viaggio alla cittadella. Attrezza la nave come desideri, poi partiamo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|As you approach a central docking port on the citadel, alarms momentarily ring throughout the <ship>'s bridge as numerous weapon locks are detected. A moment later they cease and Saajret radios you from their own craft that it is safe to land, the shape of the Vujlet disappearing into the station's wide mouth.|1566|0
units.english: As you approach a central docking port on the citadel, alarms momentarily ring throughout the <ship>'s bridge as numerous weapon locks are detected. A moment later they cease and Saajret radios you from their own craft that it is safe to land, the shape of the Vujlet disappearing into the station's wide mouth.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini a un porto di attracco centrale della cittadella, allarmi risuonano per un momento su tutto il ponte della <ship> mentre vengono rilevati numerosi agganci d'arma. Un attimo dopo cessano e Saajret ti chiama via radio dalla sua nave che è sicuro atterrare, la forma del Vujlet che sparisce nella bocca larga della stazione.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	The inside is truly cavernous; the circular vault of the station's core forms an artificial sky, the landing pad for your ship a stamp-sized rectangle on its perimeter. Saajret exits from their landed ship and meets you with a pair of Kaatrij soldiers; you recognize one as having accompanied Kampa before when they interrogated you.|1567|0
units.english: The inside is truly cavernous; the circular vault of the station's core forms an artificial sky, the landing pad for your ship a stamp-sized rectangle on its perimeter. Saajret exits from their landed ship and meets you with a pair of Kaatrij soldiers; you recognize one as having accompanied Kampa before when they interrogated you.
units.italian: L'interno è davvero cavernoso; la volta circolare del nucleo della stazione forma un cielo artificiale, e la piazzola d'atterraggio della tua nave è un rettangolo grande come un francobollo sul suo perimetro. Saajret esce dalla sua nave atterrata e ti incontra con un paio di soldati Kaatrij; ne riconosci uno, che aveva accompagnato Kampa quando ti hanno interrogato.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"I've added us as allies in the station's security rolls," says Saajret. "It should permit us access below." They check a data-pad that they produce from one of their pockets, looking from the shifting metallic screen to the layout of the docking bay. Eventually, they point to one of several circular apertures on the floor. As you approach, a large elevator pod emerges from it and its doors open expectantly.|1568|0
units.english: "I've added us as allies in the station's security rolls," says Saajret. "It should permit us access below." They check a data-pad that they produce from one of their pockets, looking from the shifting metallic screen to the layout of the docking bay. Eventually, they point to one of several circular apertures on the floor. As you approach, a large elevator pod emerges from it and its doors open expectantly.
units.italian: "Ci ho aggiunti come alleati nei registri di sicurezza della stazione," dice Saajret. "Dovrebbe permetterci l'accesso ai livelli inferiori." Controlla un data-pad che tira fuori da una delle tasche, passando dallo schermo metallico cangiante alla disposizione della baia di attracco. Alla fine indica una delle diverse aperture circolari sul pavimento. Mentre ti avvicini, una grande capsula ascensore emerge da essa e le sue porte si aprono in attesa.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"What's with the Myiara and these massive constructions?"|1570|0
units.english: "What's with the Myiara and these massive constructions?"
units.italian: "Che c'è con i Myiara e queste costruzioni enormi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"How far down are we going?"|1571|0
units.english: "How far down are we going?"
units.italian: "Quanto in basso andiamo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	Saajret is speckled with mirth and hums. "Myiara?" they say. "'Twas the Quarg that told thee this, no doubt. Ah, but to answer thy query: after the discovery of cloaks, Kaatrij's outposts grew smaller and more independent. This one was simply older, and 'twas no challenge in the day to clad even a citadel such as this in stellar metal. That way, even small generators could cloak it whole." They rub the tips of two of their arms over a data-sphere embedded in the elevator pod.|1573|0
units.english: Saajret is speckled with mirth and hums. "Myiara?" they say. "'Twas the Quarg that told thee this, no doubt. Ah, but to answer thy query: after the discovery of cloaks, Kaatrij's outposts grew smaller and more independent. This one was simply older, and 'twas no challenge in the day to clad even a citadel such as this in stellar metal. That way, even small generators could cloak it whole." They rub the tips of two of their arms over a data-sphere embedded in the elevator pod.
units.italian: Saajret è punteggiato di ilarità e canticchia. "Myiara?" dice. "Sono stati i Quarg a dirtelo, senza dubbio. Ah, ma per rispondere alla tua domanda: dopo la scoperta dei mantelli, gli avamposti di Kaatrij diventarono più piccoli e più indipendenti. Questo era semplicemente più antico, e a quei tempi non era una sfida rivestire di metallo stellare anche una cittadella come questa. Così anche piccoli generatori potevano occultarla tutta." Strofina le punte di due dei suoi bracci su una sfera di dati incassata nella capsula dell'ascensore.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"How far down are we going?"|1575|0
units.english: "How far down are we going?"
units.italian: "Quanto in basso andiamo?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"We shall want to check the systems core and the vault, at least," says Saajret. "A very long way, for certain."|1578|0
units.english: "We shall want to check the systems core and the vault, at least," says Saajret. "A very long way, for certain."
units.italian: "Dovremo controllare il nucleo dei sistemi e la volta, almeno," dice Saajret. "Molto in basso, di sicuro."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	The elevator takes the four of you down for several minutes; every once in a while, a window to the outside shows individual flashes of the sun setting as the station continues in its orbit. It finally stops on a platform overlooking a vast, dizzyingly-tall space, where pillars rise up for what seems like kilometers below you and terminate kilometers above. Myriad cargo containers are attached to their sides, and between them rest eight gleaming starships. Some of the designs are familiar, like polished versions of those you've seen in Successor space; others are entirely new to you.|1579|0
units.english: The elevator takes the four of you down for several minutes; every once in a while, a window to the outside shows individual flashes of the sun setting as the station continues in its orbit. It finally stops on a platform overlooking a vast, dizzyingly-tall space, where pillars rise up for what seems like kilometers below you and terminate kilometers above. Myriad cargo containers are attached to their sides, and between them rest eight gleaming starships. Some of the designs are familiar, like polished versions of those you've seen in Successor space; others are entirely new to you.
units.italian: L'ascensore vi porta giù tutti e quattro per diversi minuti; ogni tanto una finestra verso l'esterno mostra lampi individuali del sole che tramonta mentre la stazione continua la sua orbita. Si ferma infine su una piattaforma che si affaccia su uno spazio vasto e di altezza vertiginosa, dove pilastri si innalzano per quella che sembra chilometri sotto di voi e terminano chilometri sopra. Miriadi di container cargo sono attaccati ai loro fianchi, e tra essi riposano otto astronavi scintillanti. Alcuni dei disegni sono familiari, come versioni lucidate di quelli che hai visto nello spazio dei Successori; altri ti sono del tutto nuovi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	Saajret directs their two soldiers to set up a trio of small poles on the surface of the platform. They then radio to their ship and the poles light up, projecting barely-visible laser scanning beams throughout the vast space. After a couple of seconds, they mutter something to themself and order the soldiers to pack up the scanners.|1580|0
units.english: Saajret directs their two soldiers to set up a trio of small poles on the surface of the platform. They then radio to their ship and the poles light up, projecting barely-visible laser scanning beams throughout the vast space. After a couple of seconds, they mutter something to themself and order the soldiers to pack up the scanners.
units.italian: Saajret ordina ai suoi due soldati di montare un trio di piccoli pali sulla superficie della piattaforma. Poi chiama via radio la loro nave e i pali si accendono, proiettando fasci di scansione laser appena visibili in tutto lo spazio vasto. Dopo un paio di secondi mormorano qualcosa tra sé e sé e ordinano ai soldati di imballare gli scanner.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"What is it?"|1582|0
units.english: "What is it?"
units.italian: "Che cos'è?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"Everything here that's supposed to be?"|1583|0
units.english: "Everything here that's supposed to be?"
units.italian: "Tutto qui è dove dovrebbe essere?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"Kaatrij's fortune glows today," they say. "Naught lies out of place here; all is as 'twas when Kaatrij left it long ago."|1585|0
units.english: "Kaatrij's fortune glows today," they say. "Naught lies out of place here; all is as 'twas when Kaatrij left it long ago."
units.italian: "La fortuna di Kaatrij splende oggi," dicono. "Nulla è fuori posto qui; tutto è come era quando Kaatrij lo lasciò molto tempo fa."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"Fortunately," they say, "it is. Naught lies out of place; all is as 'twas when Kaatrij left it long ago."|1589|0
units.english: "Fortunately," they say, "it is. Naught lies out of place; all is as 'twas when Kaatrij left it long ago."
units.italian: "Per fortuna," dicono, "lo è. Nulla è fuori posto; tutto è come era quando Kaatrij lo lasciò molto tempo fa."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	You all return to the elevator and it once again begins to plunge you deeper into the citadel. You start to feel something prickling in your ear, but it is gone as soon as it began. The views of outside stop and the elevator shaft seems to grow darker and redder as the four of you travel deeper. Eventually it reaches another platform, but the door of the elevator refuses to open. Saajret enters some commands on the elevator controls, and the reason is revealed: as the elevator's door blushes transparent, you can see the corridor behind it has been perforated and torn open from outside. In the distance you can see a blast door leading into an armored, spherical construction, but that too has been blasted apart.|1591|0
units.english: You all return to the elevator and it once again begins to plunge you deeper into the citadel. You start to feel something prickling in your ear, but it is gone as soon as it began. The views of outside stop and the elevator shaft seems to grow darker and redder as the four of you travel deeper. Eventually it reaches another platform, but the door of the elevator refuses to open. Saajret enters some commands on the elevator controls, and the reason is revealed: as the elevator's door blushes transparent, you can see the corridor behind it has been perforated and torn open from outside. In the distance you can see a blast door leading into an armored, spherical construction, but that too has been blasted apart.
units.italian: Tornate tutti all'ascensore, che ricomincia a calarvi più a fondo nella cittadella. Cominci a sentire qualcosa che ti pizzica nell'orecchio, ma sparisce appena cominciato. Le vedute dell'esterno cessano e il pozzo dell'ascensore sembra farsi più scuro e più rosso mentre viaggiate più in profondità. Alla fine raggiunge un'altra piattaforma, ma la porta dell'ascensore rifiuta di aprirsi. Saajret inserisce alcuni comandi sui controlli dell'ascensore, e il motivo si rivela: mentre la porta dell'ascensore diventa trasparente, vedi che il corridoio dietro di essa è stato perforato e squarciato dall'esterno. In lontananza vedi una porta a tenuta stagna che conduce a una costruzione corazzata e sferica, ma anche quella è stata aperta con un'esplosione.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	Saajret mutters darkly and once again orders the soldiers to set up the scanners, and once again they project their beams, now through the transparent door and into the breached segment. A wave of black ruffles over Saajret's skin. "All but one of the station's cloaking nodes have been remov'd. So strange..." they say, "to have stolen these and yet left the vault unassailed." The wave passes, leaving only colorlessness in its wake. "We must bring this news with haste. Let us hurry back."|1592|0
units.english: Saajret mutters darkly and once again orders the soldiers to set up the scanners, and once again they project their beams, now through the transparent door and into the breached segment. A wave of black ruffles over Saajret's skin. "All but one of the station's cloaking nodes have been remov'd. So strange..." they say, "to have stolen these and yet left the vault unassailed." The wave passes, leaving only colorlessness in its wake. "We must bring this news with haste. Let us hurry back."
units.italian: Saajret mormora cupo e ordina di nuovo ai soldati di montare gli scanner, e di nuovo questi proiettano i loro fasci, ora attraverso la porta trasparente e nel segmento violato. Un'onda di nero si increspa sulla pelle di Saajret. "Tutti i nodi di occultamento della stazione tranne uno sono stati rimossi. Così strano..." dicono, "aver rubato questi e aver lasciato la volta intatta." L'onda passa, lasciando solo incolore dietro di sé. "Dobbiamo portare questa notizia in fretta. Torniamo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	All of a sudden, the station's comm system crackles to life. A rapid series of interweaving clicks emerge, and they soon shift and warp in your ears as your translation device begins to interpret them. "Interloper!" something screams, and you feel dizzy. "Despoiler! Invading wretch!"|1593|0
units.english: All of a sudden, the station's comm system crackles to life. A rapid series of interweaving clicks emerge, and they soon shift and warp in your ears as your translation device begins to interpret them. "Interloper!" something screams, and you feel dizzy. "Despoiler! Invading wretch!"
units.italian: Improvvisamente, il sistema di comunicazione della stazione prende vita con uno scoppio. Ne emerge una serie rapida di clic intrecciati, che presto si spostano e si deformano nelle tue orecchie mentre il dispositivo di traduzione comincia a interpretarli. "Intruso!" urla qualcosa, e ti senti girare la testa. "Saccheggiatore! Verme invasore!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	(Rip off the translation device.)|1595|0
units.english: (Rip off the translation device.)
units.italian: (Stacca il dispositivo di traduzione.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	(Try to block out the sounds.)|1596|0
units.english: (Try to block out the sounds.)
units.italian: (Prova a bloccare i suoni.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	As soon as you move, something punches against your inner ear and you crumple to the ground. The screaming voice stops, and another one takes its place, less pointed but no less painful. "We recognize thy kind," it says. "And the other with thee, too. Saajret?" As their name is spoken, Saajret stands over you, their words unintelligible. The voice shifts again. "Deceiver!" it screams. "Thou who hast plundered beast and bone from where they shouldst forever lie!"|1597|0
units.english: As soon as you move, something punches against your inner ear and you crumple to the ground. The screaming voice stops, and another one takes its place, less pointed but no less painful. "We recognize thy kind," it says. "And the other with thee, too. Saajret?" As their name is spoken, Saajret stands over you, their words unintelligible. The voice shifts again. "Deceiver!" it screams. "Thou who hast plundered beast and bone from where they shouldst forever lie!"
units.italian: Appena ti muovi, qualcosa ti colpisce l'orecchio interno e crolli a terra. La voce che urla si ferma, e un'altra prende il suo posto, meno acuta ma non meno dolorosa. "Riconosciamo la tua specie," dice. "E anche l'altro con te. Saajret?" Al pronunciare il loro nome, Saajret si china su di te, le sue parole incomprensibili. La voce cambia di nuovo. "Ingannatore!" urla. "Tu che hai saccheggiato bestie e ossa da dove dovrebbero giacere per sempre!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"I'm trying to stop the thieves!"|1599|0
units.english: "I'm trying to stop the thieves!"
units.italian: "Sto cercando di fermare i ladri!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"How are you in my head!?"|1600|0
units.english: "How are you in my head!?"
units.italian: "Come fai a essere nella mia testa?!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	"What about Saajret?"|1601|0
units.english: "What about Saajret?"
units.italian: "E Saajret?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	The rage of the artificial voice chills. "Insignificant," it shouts, and as something else begins to interleave with the sound, something sharp and painful, there comes a quiet final phrase: "I missed thee," the voice says. "I missed thee."|1602|0
units.english: The rage of the artificial voice chills. "Insignificant," it shouts, and as something else begins to interleave with the sound, something sharp and painful, there comes a quiet final phrase: "I missed thee," the voice says. "I missed thee."
units.italian: La rabbia della voce artificiale si raffredda. "Irrilevante," grida, e mentre qualcos'altro comincia a intrecciarsi al suono, qualcosa di acuto e doloroso, arriva una frase finale e quieta: "Mi sei mancato," dice la voce. "Mi sei mancato."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	And all of a sudden it stops; the pain, the voice. The pressure fades away from your head and Saajret looks down at you, the translation device plucked from your body and held in their arm. They help you to your feet and return it to you; you store it in a pocket, deactivated.|1603|0
units.english: And all of a sudden it stops; the pain, the voice. The pressure fades away from your head and Saajret looks down at you, the translation device plucked from your body and held in their arm. They help you to your feet and return it to you; you store it in a pocket, deactivated.
units.italian: E all'improvviso si ferma: il dolore, la voce. La pressione svanisce dalla tua testa e Saajret ti guarda dal basso, il dispositivo di traduzione strappato dal tuo corpo e tenuto in un braccio. Ti aiutano a rialzarti e te lo restituiscono; tu lo riponi in tasca, disattivato.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	Saajret confers with their guards for a moment, their words a mess of unintelligible sound. One of them interacts with the elevator controls and the carriage starts to move upwards again, the station's com system shrieking to no avail. Saajret comes to speak to you, gently poking your chest with the tip of one of their arms; they say something that sounds a bit like your name. Suddenly the elevator is shaken by an impact from outside, and soon after dozens more follow. The four of you are deposited back in the landing bay just as you catch a glimpse of a ship in the distance firing on the station. You dash back to your own craft and prepare to flee or fight.|1604|0
units.english: Saajret confers with their guards for a moment, their words a mess of unintelligible sound. One of them interacts with the elevator controls and the carriage starts to move upwards again, the station's com system shrieking to no avail. Saajret comes to speak to you, gently poking your chest with the tip of one of their arms; they say something that sounds a bit like your name. Suddenly the elevator is shaken by an impact from outside, and soon after dozens more follow. The four of you are deposited back in the landing bay just as you catch a glimpse of a ship in the distance firing on the station. You dash back to your own craft and prepare to flee or fight.
units.italian: Saajret si consulta per un momento con le guardie, le loro parole un guazzabuglio di suoni incomprensibili. Una di loro interagisce con i comandi dell'ascensore e la cabina ricomincia a salire, il sistema di comunicazione della stazione che strilla invano. Saajret viene a parlarti, pungendoti piano il petto con la punta di un braccio; dicono qualcosa che suona un po' come il tuo nome. Improvvisamente l'ascensore è scosso da un impatto dall'esterno, e poco dopo ne seguono decine. Venite depositati di nuovo nella baia d'atterraggio proprio mentre intravedi una nave in lontananza che spara sulla stazione. Corri verso la tua nave e ti prepari a fuggire o a combattere.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 17|name|1614|0
units.english: Flee to Successor space
units.italian: Fuggi nello spazio dei Successori

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 17|description|1615|0
units.english: Escape the drone ship and return to <destination>.
units.italian: Sfuggi alla nave drone e torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 17|dialog|1626|0
units.english: As the drone ship explodes it transmits some data to your own vessel. It cannot be deciphered at this time.
units.italian: Mentre la nave drone esplode, trasmette alcuni dati al tuo vascello. Non è possibile decifrarli in questo momento.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 17|government|1628|0
units.english: House Kaatrij
units.italian: House Kaatrij

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|name|1654|0
units.english: Set up cloak detectors
units.italian: Installa i rilevatori di mantelli

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|description|1655|0
units.english: Set up the Quarg cloak detectors on the far side of the Successors' wormhole before landing on <destination> to lay in wait for the heirloom warship.
units.italian: Installa i rilevatori di mantelli Quarg dall'altra parte del cunicolo dei Successori prima di atterrare su <destination> per tendere un'imboscata alla nave da guerra di famiglia.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|blocked|1669|0
units.english: You need a ship with at least 10 units of free cargo space to begin this mission.
units.italian: Ti serve una nave con almeno 10 unità di spazio cargo libero per iniziare questa missione.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|Saajret meets you soon after you disembark, their voice once again being translated by your now-reactivated translation device. "I've no time to consult with thee immediately," they say, "but please join me once I've updated Kaatrij."|1675|0
units.english: Saajret meets you soon after you disembark, their voice once again being translated by your now-reactivated translation device. "I've no time to consult with thee immediately," they say, "but please join me once I've updated Kaatrij."
units.italian: Saajret ti incontra poco dopo lo sbarco, la loro voce di nuovo tradotta dal tuo dispositivo di traduzione ora riattivato. "Non ho tempo di consultarmi con te subito," dicono, "ma unisciti a me appena avrò aggiornato Kaatrij."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	"Before you go! Thank you."|1677|0
units.english: "Before you go! Thank you."
units.italian: "Prima che tu vada! Grazie."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	(Wait.)|1678|0
units.english: (Wait.)
units.italian: (Aspetta.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	The cool blue of satisfaction washes over Saajret's skin. "Thou art most welcome, Captain," they say, and leave you to wait.|1683|0
units.english: The cool blue of satisfaction washes over Saajret's skin. "Thou art most welcome, Captain," they say, and leave you to wait.
units.italian: Il blu freddo della soddisfazione si diffonde sulla pelle di Saajret. "Sei il benvenuto, capitano," dicono, e ti lasciano ad aspettare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	While you wait, you notice the two scout ships that joined you in the Oublaa-Khora system have landed nearby. Three other Vujleten-Usaqri soon join them, forming a small fleet within one of the larger hangar bays of the spaceport.|1686|0
units.english: While you wait, you notice the two scout ships that joined you in the Oublaa-Khora system have landed nearby. Three other Vujleten-Usaqri soon join them, forming a small fleet within one of the larger hangar bays of the spaceport.
units.italian: Mentre aspetti, noti che le due navi esploratrici che ti hanno raggiunto nel sistema Oublaa-Khora sono atterrate lì vicino. Altri tre Vujleten-Usaqri si uniscono presto a loro, formando una piccola flotta dentro una delle baie di hangar più grandi dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	After a while, one of the members of House Kaatrij comes to meet you and guides you to the same conference room you were shown on your first visit to the base. Inside stands Kampa, now dressed in an opulent uniform, along with Saajret and a number of Kaatrij's military officers.|1687|0
units.english: After a while, one of the members of House Kaatrij comes to meet you and guides you to the same conference room you were shown on your first visit to the base. Inside stands Kampa, now dressed in an opulent uniform, along with Saajret and a number of Kaatrij's military officers.
units.italian: Dopo un po', uno dei membri di Casa Kaatrij viene a incontrarti e ti guida alla stessa sala conferenze che ti era stata mostrata alla prima visita alla base. Dentro c'è Kampa, ora vestito con un'uniforme opulenta, insieme a Saajret e a diversi ufficiali militari di Kaatrij.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	"Captain <last>," Kampa says. "With Saajret's report on the Kasii-Sola citadel's plund'ring we've no time to squander." A metallic pool in the center of the room splashes and forms into a depiction of a warship, more sharp and elegant than any you've seen the Successors use.|1688|0
units.english: "Captain <last>," Kampa says. "With Saajret's report on the Kasii-Sola citadel's plund'ring we've no time to squander." A metallic pool in the center of the room splashes and forms into a depiction of a warship, more sharp and elegant than any you've seen the Successors use.
units.italian: "Capitano <last>," dice Kampa. "Con il rapporto di Saajret sul saccheggio della cittadella di Kasii-Sola, non abbiamo tempo da sprecare." Una pozza metallica al centro della stanza schizza e prende la forma di una nave da guerra, più affilata ed elegante di qualsiasi altra tu abbia visto usare ai Successori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	"Another House," they say, "has dragg'd an heirloom starship from their reliquary and set it 'gainst us, and now used it t'steal no less than five sep'rable cloaks. So long as such a craft flies free, Kaatrij shan't know peace. To catch it, the Quarg provide us on loan some tools of theirs, detectors to wrap round the wormhole's mouth and catch our quarry when next it seeks to pass through.|1689|0
units.english: "Another House," they say, "has dragg'd an heirloom starship from their reliquary and set it 'gainst us, and now used it t'steal no less than five sep'rable cloaks. So long as such a craft flies free, Kaatrij shan't know peace. To catch it, the Quarg provide us on loan some tools of theirs, detectors to wrap round the wormhole's mouth and catch our quarry when next it seeks to pass through.
units.italian: "Un'altra Casa," dicono, "ha trascinato una nave stellare di famiglia fuori dal suo reliquiario e l'ha schierata contro di noi, e ora l'ha usata per rubare non meno di cinque mantelli separabili. Finché un vascello simile vola libero, Kaatrij non conoscerà pace. Per catturarlo, i Quarg ci danno in prestito alcuni loro strumenti: rilevatori da avvolgere intorno alla bocca del cunicolo e prendere la nostra preda la prossima volta che cercherà di passare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	Our plan's an ambush; a fleet of our own cloaked craft shall lay in wait for it and intercept it while 'tis stricken. The alien captain shall join them, should it please them."|1690|0
units.english: Our plan's an ambush; a fleet of our own cloaked craft shall lay in wait for it and intercept it while 'tis stricken. The alien captain shall join them, should it please them."
units.italian: Il nostro piano è un'imboscata: una flotta di nostri vascelli occultati la aspetterà e la intercetterà mentre è colpita. Il capitano alieno si unirà a loro, se gli farà piacere."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	"My current ship isn't able to cloak."|1693|0
units.english: "My current ship isn't able to cloak."
units.italian: "La mia nave attuale non è in grado di occultarsi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	"What if the fleet is disabled?"|1697|0
units.english: "What if the fleet is disabled?"
units.italian: "E se la flotta viene messa fuori uso?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	"What sort of fight should I expect?"|1701|0
units.english: "What sort of fight should I expect?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di combattimento devo aspettarmi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	"All right, I'm ready."|1705|0
units.english: "All right, I'm ready."
units.italian: "Va bene, sono pronto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	Kampa nods. "We've a second plan, with crews already prepar'd. But 'tisn't thy responsibility to know it."|1712|0
units.english: Kampa nods. "We've a second plan, with crews already prepar'd. But 'tisn't thy responsibility to know it."
units.italian: Kampa annuisce. "Abbiamo un secondo piano, con equipaggi già pronti. Ma non è tua responsabilità conoscerlo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	Saajret is the one who speaks now. "'Tis a proper battlecruiser of our Predecessors' age," they say. "Our warships in their day were second only to those of the Quarg; one could not doubt stand against a fleet of lesser craft handily."|1718|0
units.english: Saajret is the one who speaks now. "'Tis a proper battlecruiser of our Predecessors' age," they say. "Our warships in their day were second only to those of the Quarg; one could not doubt stand against a fleet of lesser craft handily."
units.italian: Ora parla Saajret. "È un vero incrociatore da battaglia dell'epoca dei nostri Predecessori," dice. "Le nostre navi da guerra, ai loro tempi, erano seconde solo a quelle dei Quarg; non si può dubitare che resisterebbe con facilità a una flotta di vascelli minori."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	Saajret speaks. "I'll join thee, <last>, before we depart. Thou shalt need a guide to the world where we seek to plan the ambush."|1722|0
units.english: Saajret speaks. "I'll join thee, <last>, before we depart. Thou shalt need a guide to the world where we seek to plan the ambush."
units.italian: Parla Saajret. "Mi unirò a te, <last>, prima della partenza. Ti servirà una guida per il mondo dove intendiamo pianificare l'imboscata."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|label|1725|0
units.english: no cloak
units.italian: no cloak

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	Kampa considers this for a moment. "The benefit of thy joining us outweighs the loss of a small delay," they say. "We can afford to wait on thee to acquire such a craft if it enables this ambush. Please act quickly if thou wish t'assist."|1728|0
units.english: Kampa considers this for a moment. "The benefit of thy joining us outweighs the loss of a small delay," they say. "We can afford to wait on thee to acquire such a craft if it enables this ambush. Please act quickly if thou wish t'assist."
units.italian: Kampa ci riflette un momento. "Il beneficio della tua compagnia supera la perdita di un piccolo ritardo," dice. "Possiamo permetterci di aspettare che tu procuri un vascello simile, se questo rende possibile l'imboscata. Agisci in fretta, se vuoi aiutarci."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	Having acquired a cloak-capable flagship, you are quickly directed back to a briefing room within the base where Kampa reiterates the plan: you will join a fleet of House Kaatrij's ships to deploy Quarg cloak detectors around the wormhole, before laying in wait on <destination> to ambush the heirloom warship that attacked Kaatrij.|1735|0
units.english: Having acquired a cloak-capable flagship, you are quickly directed back to a briefing room within the base where Kampa reiterates the plan: you will join a fleet of House Kaatrij's ships to deploy Quarg cloak detectors around the wormhole, before laying in wait on <destination> to ambush the heirloom warship that attacked Kaatrij.
units.italian: Dopo esserti procurato un vascello ammiraglia capace di occultarsi, vieni subito indirizzato a una sala briefing nella base dove Kampa ripete il piano: ti unirai a una flotta di navi di Casa Kaatrij per installare i rilevatori di mantelli Quarg intorno al cunicolo, prima di appostarti su <destination> per tendere l'imboscata alla nave da guerra di famiglia che ha attaccato Kaatrij.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|label|1738|0
units.english: still no cloak
units.italian: still no cloak

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	Without a cloak-capable flagship, you cannot join House Kaatrij in their ambush.|1739|0
units.english: Without a cloak-capable flagship, you cannot join House Kaatrij in their ambush.
units.italian: Senza un vascello ammiraglia capace di occultarsi, non puoi unirti a Casa Kaatrij nella loro imboscata.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|dialog|1744|0
units.english: As you exit the wormhole, you trigger the release of the cloak detector from your ship's cargo bay. The metal orb floats into position at the wormhole's edge before disappearing from view entirely as its cloaking armor activates. Apparently satisfied, Saajret directs you to land on the nearby planet.
units.italian: Mentre esci dal cunicolo, fai scattare il rilascio del rilevatore di mantelli dalla stiva della nave. L'orbe metallico si posiziona al bordo del cunicolo prima di sparire del tutto alla vista mentre la sua armatura occultante si attiva. Apparentemente soddisfatto, Saajret ti indica di atterrare sul pianeta vicino.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|Once the rest of House Kaatrij's fleet has deployed their own cloak detectors, the fleet of Vujleten follow you into <planet>'s atmosphere, bedding down in the shadow of an ancient weather control tower to shield them from the dust. Several of the Successors inside exit to inspect the tower's functioning, and return after a few minutes. They bring long fuel hoses out of their ships and connect them to ports on the tower's side; one by one, the flock of Vujleten shimmer and then disappear as their own cloaks engage.|1748|0
units.english: Once the rest of House Kaatrij's fleet has deployed their own cloak detectors, the fleet of Vujleten follow you into <planet>'s atmosphere, bedding down in the shadow of an ancient weather control tower to shield them from the dust. Several of the Successors inside exit to inspect the tower's functioning, and return after a few minutes. They bring long fuel hoses out of their ships and connect them to ports on the tower's side; one by one, the flock of Vujleten shimmer and then disappear as their own cloaks engage.
units.italian: Una volta che il resto della flotta di Casa Kaatrij ha installato i propri rilevatori di mantelli, la flotta di Vujleten ti segue nell'atmosfera di <planet>, accovacciandosi all'ombra di un'antica torre di controllo meteorologico per ripararsi dalla polvere. Diversi Successori all'interno escono per ispezionare il funzionamento della torre, e tornano dopo qualche minuto. Tirano fuori dalle navi lunghi tubi del carburante e li collegano alle prese sul fianco della torre; uno dopo l'altro, lo stormo di Vujleten ondeggia e poi sparisce mentre i loro mantelli si attivano.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	As one of the crew of the Kaatrij ships links the <ship>'s own fuel tank to the tower's reserves, Saajret slithers onto the bridge and greets you. "Now, it seems, we wait," they say. Black and white patterns of dots dance across their face, whirling around each other and occasionally splashing apart.|1749|0
units.english: As one of the crew of the Kaatrij ships links the <ship>'s own fuel tank to the tower's reserves, Saajret slithers onto the bridge and greets you. "Now, it seems, we wait," they say. Black and white patterns of dots dance across their face, whirling around each other and occasionally splashing apart.
units.italian: Mentre uno dell'equipaggio delle navi Kaatrij collega il serbatoio della <ship> alle riserve della torre, Saajret scivola sul ponte e ti saluta. "Ora, a quanto pare, aspettiamo," dicono. Motivi di puntini neri e bianchi danzano sul loro viso, turbinando gli uni intorno agli altri e ogni tanto spruzzando via.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	"What makes you think they'll even come back this way?"|1751|0
units.english: "What makes you think they'll even come back this way?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ti fa pensare che torneranno da questa parte?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	"How long will we be able to stay here?"|1753|0
units.english: "How long will we be able to stay here?"
units.italian: "Quanto potremo restare qui?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	Saajret tilts their head to the side as the whirling colors slow. "Some few days, at most. The tower's fuel has mostly long since gone, and we drink now only the last dregs of it. I think we shall not need to, though," they say. "Soon after leaving, Kaatrij pulled its fleets from Aaura-Kaska, circled them around our core. 'Tis an invitation to the wormhole, we should think - fewer scans, fewer edits to one's course."|1754|0
units.english: Saajret tilts their head to the side as the whirling colors slow. "Some few days, at most. The tower's fuel has mostly long since gone, and we drink now only the last dregs of it. I think we shall not need to, though," they say. "Soon after leaving, Kaatrij pulled its fleets from Aaura-Kaska, circled them around our core. 'Tis an invitation to the wormhole, we should think - fewer scans, fewer edits to one's course."
units.italian: Saajret inclina la testa di lato mentre i colori turbinanti rallentano. "Qualche giorno, al massimo. Il carburante della torre è in gran parte finito da tempo, e ora ne beviamo solo le ultime fecce. Credo però che non ce ne sarà bisogno," dicono. "Poco dopo la partenza, Kaatrij ha ritirato le sue flotte da Aaura-Kaska, facendole girare intorno al nostro nucleo. È un invito al cunicolo, crediamo: meno scansioni, meno correzioni alla propria rotta."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	Saajret's skin sparkles with satisfaction. "Soon after leaving, Kaatrij pulled its fleets from Aaura-Kaska, circled them around our core. 'Tis an invitation to the wormhole, we should think - fewer scans, fewer edits to one's course. Open we leave the gate, and now something wicked this way comes."|1758|0
units.english: Saajret's skin sparkles with satisfaction. "Soon after leaving, Kaatrij pulled its fleets from Aaura-Kaska, circled them around our core. 'Tis an invitation to the wormhole, we should think - fewer scans, fewer edits to one's course. Open we leave the gate, and now something wicked this way comes."
units.italian: La pelle di Saajret scintilla di soddisfazione. "Poco dopo la partenza, Kaatrij ha ritirato le sue flotte da Aaura-Kaska, facendole girare intorno al nostro nucleo. È un invito al cunicolo, crediamo: meno scansioni, meno correzioni alla propria rotta. Apriamo noi il cancello, e ora qualcosa di malvagio viene da questa parte."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	"Won't they think it could be a trap?"|1761|0
units.english: "Won't they think it could be a trap?"
units.italian: "Non penseranno che possa essere una trappola?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	"Perhaps." Outside, a gust of wind throws up enough grit to leave tiny blue flashes against the shields of one of the cloaked Vuljeten. "We've become our own quarries, though, isolated from our allies, no longer fearsome in scale. Surprise," they say, "is only worth so much."|1762|0
units.english: "Perhaps." Outside, a gust of wind throws up enough grit to leave tiny blue flashes against the shields of one of the cloaked Vuljeten. "We've become our own quarries, though, isolated from our allies, no longer fearsome in scale. Surprise," they say, "is only worth so much."
units.italian: "Forse." Fuori, una raffica di vento solleva abbastanza polvere da lasciare piccoli lampi blu contro gli scudi di uno dei Vuljeten occultati. "Siamo diventati le nostre stesse prede, però: isolati dai nostri alleati, non più temibili per numero. La sorpresa," dicono, "vale solo fino a un certo punto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	Saajret excuses themself there, offering you a short bow and splay of the arms. With nothing left to do but wait, you and your crew work to prepare the <ship> for the forthcoming battle.|1763|0
units.english: Saajret excuses themself there, offering you a short bow and splay of the arms. With nothing left to do but wait, you and your crew work to prepare the <ship> for the forthcoming battle.
units.italian: Saajret si congeda a quel punto, offrendoti un breve inchino e un'apertura delle braccia. Non resta altro da fare che aspettare, e tu e il tuo equipaggio lavorate per preparare la <ship> alla battaglia imminente.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	(Wait.)|1765|0
units.english: (Wait.)
units.italian: (Aspetta.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 18|	In the early morning of the following day, an alarm rings on the bridge of the <ship>. Your sensors pick up the annihilation of countless antiprotons against the shields of a cloaked ship emerging from the wormhole and soon after, a new contact blinks into existence as its cloak fails. The radios between your ship and Kaatrij's spring to life as you all cut loose your fuel cables and take off.|1766|0
units.english: In the early morning of the following day, an alarm rings on the bridge of the <ship>. Your sensors pick up the annihilation of countless antiprotons against the shields of a cloaked ship emerging from the wormhole and soon after, a new contact blinks into existence as its cloak fails. The radios between your ship and Kaatrij's spring to life as you all cut loose your fuel cables and take off.
units.italian: Al mattino presto del giorno seguente, un allarme risuona sul ponte della <ship>. I sensori rilevano l'annichilimento di innumerevoli antiprotoni contro gli scudi di una nave occultata che emerge dal cunicolo e, poco dopo, un nuovo contatto lampeggia in esistenza mentre il suo mantello cede. Le radio tra la tua nave e quelle di Kaatrij si animano mentre tutti staccate i cavi del carburante e decollate.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|name|1776|0
units.english: Defeat the heirloom warship
units.italian: Sconfiggi la nave da guerra di famiglia

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|description|1777|0
units.english: Destroy the Myiaran heirloom warship with the help of House Kaatrij before returning to their base on <destination> for debriefing.
units.italian: Distruggi la nave da guerra di famiglia dei Myiara con l'aiuto di Casa Kaatrij, prima di tornare alla loro base su <destination> per il debriefing.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|government|1783|0
units.english: High Houses (Unknown)
units.italian: High Houses (Unknown)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|dialog|1788|0
units.english: With the warship destroyed, you should return to Qasa-Sija-Iri for debriefing.
units.italian: Con la nave da guerra distrutta, dovresti tornare a Qasa-Sija-Iri per il debriefing.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|log|1803|0
units.english: Fought and destroyed an heirloom warship of the High Houses with the support of House Kaatrij, likely the same ship that attacked their base on Qasa-Sija-Iri.
units.italian: Hai combattuto e distrutto una nave da guerra di famiglia delle Casate Alte con il sostegno di Casa Kaatrij, probabilmente la stessa nave che ha attaccato la loro base su Qasa-Sija-Iri.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|As the <ship> returns to the Kaatrij base, it is scanned even more thoroughly than usual, planetary coilguns tracking it carefully until at last the scanners are satisfied. The portal in the sand opens to a curiously quiet scene; the whole facility seems to be waiting for whatever comes next. As soon as your landing gear touches ground, everything springs into motion.|1805|0
units.english: As the <ship> returns to the Kaatrij base, it is scanned even more thoroughly than usual, planetary coilguns tracking it carefully until at last the scanners are satisfied. The portal in the sand opens to a curiously quiet scene; the whole facility seems to be waiting for whatever comes next. As soon as your landing gear touches ground, everything springs into motion.
units.italian: Mentre la <ship> torna alla base di Kaatrij, viene scansionata con più scrupolo del solito, le coilgun planetarie che la seguono con attenzione finché gli scanner non si dichiarano soddisfatti. Il portale nella sabbia si apre su una scena curiosamente silenziosa; l'intera struttura sembra in attesa di ciò che verrà dopo. Appena il carrello tocca terra, tutto scatta in movimento.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	Saajret slithers off almost immediately, only offering a hasty promise of their return and a poorly-concealed tint of satisfaction. You don't have to wait long, though; by the time the spaceport's automated repair arms have folded down to assess the <ship>'s battle damage, you notice Saajret coming back, Kampa and a smattering of Kaatrij officers at their side. Though none of the base's Quarg join them, you notice one watching the scene from one of the rooms overlooking the spaceport.|1806|0
units.english: Saajret slithers off almost immediately, only offering a hasty promise of their return and a poorly-concealed tint of satisfaction. You don't have to wait long, though; by the time the spaceport's automated repair arms have folded down to assess the <ship>'s battle damage, you notice Saajret coming back, Kampa and a smattering of Kaatrij officers at their side. Though none of the base's Quarg join them, you notice one watching the scene from one of the rooms overlooking the spaceport.
units.italian: Saajret scivola via quasi subito, offrendo solo una frettolosa promessa di tornare e una tinta di soddisfazione mal celata. Non devi aspettare molto, però; quando i bracci di riparazione automatici dello spazioporto si sono abbassati per valutare i danni di battaglia della <ship>, vedi Saajret tornare, con Kampa e una manciata di ufficiali Kaatrij al fianco. Nessuno dei Quarg della base si unisce a loro, ma ne noti uno che osserva la scena da una delle stanze che si affacciano sullo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	Kampa speaks first as they lead you away from your ship and into a more secluded region of the port. "'Tis good that thou prevail'd," they say, sharing in Saajret's satisfaction. "'Twas a fraught battle, I trust?"|1807|0
units.english: Kampa speaks first as they lead you away from your ship and into a more secluded region of the port. "'Tis good that thou prevail'd," they say, sharing in Saajret's satisfaction. "'Twas a fraught battle, I trust?"
units.italian: Kampa parla per primo mentre ti portano via dalla nave verso una zona più appartata del porto. "È cosa buona che tu abbia vinto," dice, condividendo la soddisfazione di Saajret. "Una battaglia tesa, immagino?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"Indeed. We were lucky it was just one ship."|1809|0
units.english: "Indeed. We were lucky it was just one ship."
units.italian: "Infatti. Siamo stati fortunati che fosse una nave sola."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"It was. I'm sorry none of your own crews survived."|1811|0
units.english: "It was. I'm sorry none of your own crews survived."
units.italian: "Lo è stata. Mi dispiace che nessuno dei tuoi equipaggi sia sopravvissuto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"I've fought tougher."|1815|0
units.english: "I've fought tougher."
units.italian: "Ho combattuto contro di peggio."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"Indeed?" Kampa says. "Later thou shalt have to tell us more of this."|1817|0
units.english: "Indeed?" Kampa says. "Later thou shalt have to tell us more of this."
units.italian: "Davvero?" dice Kampa. "Più tardi dovrai raccontarci di più su questo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"As are we," says Kampa. "But their names shall be honored ones for their courage and devotion."|1820|0
units.english: "As are we," says Kampa. "But their names shall be honored ones for their courage and devotion."
units.italian: "Lo siamo anche noi," dice Kampa. "Ma i loro nomi saranno onorati per il loro coraggio e la loro dedizione."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	They produce a data-sphere from their outfit and offer it to you. As you take it, they continue, "I shall enjoy debriefing thee after our conversation here, but for now, Kaatrij has seen fit to offer thee a reward for thy able service. Since thou hast yet to receive the ability to purchase our technologies, today 'tis purely monetary. The sphere authorizes the transfer of <payment> to thee."|1822|0
units.english: They produce a data-sphere from their outfit and offer it to you. As you take it, they continue, "I shall enjoy debriefing thee after our conversation here, but for now, Kaatrij has seen fit to offer thee a reward for thy able service. Since thou hast yet to receive the ability to purchase our technologies, today 'tis purely monetary. The sphere authorizes the transfer of <payment> to thee."
units.italian: Estraggono una sfera di dati dall'abito e te la offrono. Mentre la prendi, continuano: "Mi godrò il debriefing con te dopo la nostra conversazione qui, ma per ora Kaatrij ha ritenuto opportuno offrirti una ricompensa per il tuo abile servizio. Dato che non hai ancora ricevuto la possibilità di acquistare le nostre tecnologie, oggi è puramente monetaria. La sfera autorizza il trasferimento di <payment> a te."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"Has this brought us any closer to knowing which House committed the attacks?"|1824|0
units.english: "Has this brought us any closer to knowing which House committed the attacks?"
units.italian: "Ci ha avvicinati a sapere quale Casa ha commesso gli attacchi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"And what about purchasing your technology, since you mention it?"|1825|0
units.english: "And what about purchasing your technology, since you mention it?"
units.italian: "E a proposito di acquistare la vostra tecnologia, visto che l'hai menzionato?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"Thank you. It's most generous."|1827|0
units.english: "Thank you. It's most generous."
units.italian: "Grazie. È molto generoso."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	Kampa nods. "It shall, if fortune favors us. We've dispatched fleets to examine the wreckage left after the fray. There is little chance anything clearly identifying remains, but the wreckage may give valuable context to our intelligence."|1830|0
units.english: Kampa nods. "It shall, if fortune favors us. We've dispatched fleets to examine the wreckage left after the fray. There is little chance anything clearly identifying remains, but the wreckage may give valuable context to our intelligence."
units.italian: Kampa annuisce. "Lo farà, se la fortuna ci assiste. Abbiamo inviato flotte a esaminare i rottami lasciati dopo lo scontro. Poche possibilità che resti qualcosa che identifichi chiaramente, ma i rottami potrebbero dare un contesto prezioso alle nostre informazioni."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	Saajret interjects. "That wedding 'tween Myurej and Chydiyi, too, offers us an opportunity to observe the other Houses in the wake of this. One there has been wounded now, and we shall see if it shows."|1831|0
units.english: Saajret interjects. "That wedding 'tween Myurej and Chydiyi, too, offers us an opportunity to observe the other Houses in the wake of this. One there has been wounded now, and we shall see if it shows."
units.italian: Saajret interviene. "Anche quel matrimonio tra Myurej e Chydiyi ci offre l'occasione di osservare le altre Casate sulla scia di questo. Una di loro è ora ferita, e vedremo se si vedrà."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"Such a gathering also fulfills the treaty conditions under which we may offer thee our license," says Kampa. "In short, we await it eagerly."|1832|0
units.english: "Such a gathering also fulfills the treaty conditions under which we may offer thee our license," says Kampa. "In short, we await it eagerly."
units.italian: "Un simile raduno soddisfa anche le condizioni del trattato in base alle quali possiamo offrirti la nostra licenza," dice Kampa. "In breve, lo aspettiamo con impazienza."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	Saajret nods here. "That wedding 'tween Myurej and Chydiyi is likely to happen soon," they say. "Thy time of shrouded service to Kaatrij has come to its close; with all the Houses there, 'tis a fair opportunity to present thee with our license."|1836|0
units.english: Saajret nods here. "That wedding 'tween Myurej and Chydiyi is likely to happen soon," they say. "Thy time of shrouded service to Kaatrij has come to its close; with all the Houses there, 'tis a fair opportunity to present thee with our license."
units.italian: Qui Saajret annuisce. "Quel matrimonio tra Myurej e Chydiyi avverrà probabilmente presto," dice. "Il tuo periodo di servizio occultato a Kaatrij è giunto al termine; con tutte le Casate presenti, è una buona occasione per presentarti la nostra licenza."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"Thou hast done service to other Houses, too," Kampa says, "so it should be 'thout much resistance."|1837|0
units.english: "Thou hast done service to other Houses, too," Kampa says, "so it should be 'thout much resistance."
units.italian: "Hai fatto servizio anche per altre Casate," dice Kampa, "quindi dovrebbe essere senza molta resistenza."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	Kampa bows and Saajret interjects. "That wedding 'tween Myurej and Chydiyi is likely to happen soon," they say. "And with it, the end to thy shrouded service to Kaatrij. 'Tis a fair time to present thee with our license, as much as it may interest thee."|1841|0
units.english: Kampa bows and Saajret interjects. "That wedding 'tween Myurej and Chydiyi is likely to happen soon," they say. "And with it, the end to thy shrouded service to Kaatrij. 'Tis a fair time to present thee with our license, as much as it may interest thee."
units.italian: Kampa si inchina e Saajret interviene. "Quel matrimonio tra Myurej e Chydiyi avverrà probabilmente presto," dicono. "E con esso la fine del tuo servizio occultato a Kaatrij. È un buon momento per presentarti la nostra licenza, per quanto ti possa interessare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"Thou hast done service to other Houses, too," Kampa says, "so it should be 'thout much resistance."|1842|0
units.english: "Thou hast done service to other Houses, too," Kampa says, "so it should be 'thout much resistance."
units.italian: "Hai fatto servizio anche per altre Casate," dice Kampa, "quindi dovrebbe essere senza molta resistenza."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|label|1844|0
units.english: what now
units.italian: what now

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"What now?"|1846|0
units.english: "What now?"
units.italian: "E adesso?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"Do you have anything else for me?"|1847|0
units.english: "Do you have anything else for me?"
units.italian: "Hai qualcos'altro per me?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"Just to wait," Kampa says. "Kaatrij must now determine its next move."|1852|0
units.english: "Just to wait," Kampa says. "Kaatrij must now determine its next move."
units.italian: "Solo aspettare," dice Kampa. "Kaatrij deve ora determinare la sua prossima mossa."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|label|1855|0
units.english: wedding preparations
units.italian: wedding preparations

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	"On the matter of the forthcoming wedding," Kampa says. "Myurej continues to whine about some absent gifts of theirs. Shouldst thou need to earn thyself an invitation, that would be a matter to pursue."|1857|0
units.english: "On the matter of the forthcoming wedding," Kampa says. "Myurej continues to whine about some absent gifts of theirs. Shouldst thou need to earn thyself an invitation, that would be a matter to pursue."
units.italian: "A proposito delle nozze imminenti," dice Kampa. "Myurej continua a piagnucolare per certi suoi doni mancanti. Se ti servisse guadagnarti un invito, sarebbe una questione da seguire."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 19|	With that said, Kampa bows and leaves. "I expect thou shouldst wish to supervise thy craft's repairs," Saajret says, "or perhaps merely enjoy some rest." Their skin speckles with mirth. "Farewell, Captain. I hope to see thee again soon."|1861|0
units.english: With that said, Kampa bows and leaves. "I expect thou shouldst wish to supervise thy craft's repairs," Saajret says, "or perhaps merely enjoy some rest." Their skin speckles with mirth. "Farewell, Captain. I hope to see thee again soon."
units.italian: Detto questo, Kampa si inchina e se ne va. "Immagino che tu voglia sovrintendere alle riparazioni della tua nave," dice Saajret, "o magari semplicemente goderti un po' di riposo." La loro pelle si punteggia di ilarità. "Addio, capitano. Spero di rivederti presto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|name|1890|0
units.english: Go to the scions' wedding
units.italian: Vai alle nozze degli eredi

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|description|1891|0
units.english: The long-awaited wedding between scions of House Myurej and Chydiyi will take place at <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Il matrimonio tanto atteso tra gli eredi di Casa Myurej e Chydiyi avrà luogo su <destination> entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|Shortly after landing here, a data-sphere is delivered to you. It jumps to life as soon as you touch it, displaying its message:|1903|0
units.english: Shortly after landing here, a data-sphere is delivered to you. It jumps to life as soon as you touch it, displaying its message:
units.italian: Poco dopo l'atterraggio, ti viene consegnata una sfera di dati. Si accende appena la tocchi, mostrando il messaggio:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	Honored alien who has earned audience at the gilded wedding 'tween Myurej and Chydiyi, we wish to inform thee that the date is set. Thy presence we shall cordially request at <planet> by <date>.|1904|0
units.english: Honored alien who has earned audience at the gilded wedding 'tween Myurej and Chydiyi, we wish to inform thee that the date is set. Thy presence we shall cordially request at <planet> by <date>.
units.italian: Onorato alieno che si è guadagnato un'udienza alle nozze dorate tra Myurej e Chydiyi, desideriamo informarti che la data è fissata. La tua presenza sarà cordialmente richiesta su <planet> entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	This is attested on behalf of Myurej M- Khiajsore, honored scion of House Myurej.|1905|0
units.english: This is attested on behalf of Myurej M- Khiajsore, honored scion of House Myurej.
units.italian: Questo è attestato per conto di Myurej M- Khiajsore, onorato erede di Casa Myurej.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|log|1908|0
units.english: Attended the wedding between scions of Houses Chydiyi and Myurej. Was presented with a license to purchase advanced Successor technology.
units.italian: Hai partecipato al matrimonio tra gli eredi delle Casate Chydiyi e Myurej. Ti è stata presentata una licenza per acquistare tecnologia avanzata dei Successori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|You are given directions to one of the shallow-water landing pads on a secondary <planet> spaceport, from which you once again take a long elevator deep into the ocean. Outside the window dance the "Ribbons of Iret," enormous plumes of color rising up from from the abyss, only growing more intense the farther down you travel.|1915|0
units.english: You are given directions to one of the shallow-water landing pads on a secondary <planet> spaceport, from which you once again take a long elevator deep into the ocean. Outside the window dance the "Ribbons of Iret," enormous plumes of color rising up from from the abyss, only growing more intense the farther down you travel.
units.italian: Ti vengono date indicazioni per una delle piazzole d'atterraggio in acque basse di uno spazioporto secondario di <planet>, da cui prendi di nuovo un lungo ascensore giù nel profondo dell'oceano. Fuori dalla finestra danzano i "Nastri di Iret", enormi pennacchi di colore che salgono dall'abisso, e diventano solo più intensi più scendi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|Traffic control gives you coordinates to the deepwater complex where the wedding is to take place, and you plunge the <ship> into the planet's ocean, its hull wrapped around by one of the "Ribbons of Iret," enormous and colorful. The farther down you travel, the more intense the bioluminescent plume grows, until it feels almost as if you are traveling through a nebula in space rather than an underwater bloom.|1919|0
units.english: Traffic control gives you coordinates to the deepwater complex where the wedding is to take place, and you plunge the <ship> into the planet's ocean, its hull wrapped around by one of the "Ribbons of Iret," enormous and colorful. The farther down you travel, the more intense the bioluminescent plume grows, until it feels almost as if you are traveling through a nebula in space rather than an underwater bloom.
units.italian: Il controllo del traffico ti dà le coordinate del complesso in acque profonde dove si terrà il matrimonio, e tuffi la <ship> nell'oceano del pianeta, lo scafo avvolto da uno dei "Nastri di Iret", enormi e colorati. Più scendi, più intenso diventa il pennacchio bioluminescente, finché non sembra quasi che tu stia viaggiando attraverso una nebulosa nello spazio invece che in una fioritura subacquea.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	You reach the complex and dock at it, disembarking through an airlock and taking an elevator for the final short distance.|1920|0
units.english: You reach the complex and dock at it, disembarking through an airlock and taking an elevator for the final short distance.
units.italian: Raggiungi il complesso e vi ti agganci, sbarcando da una camera di equilibrio e prendendo un ascensore per l'ultimo breve tratto.
