units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	You soon enter a similar room to the one you visited the last time you were here, though this one is even larger and more richly decorated, the walls a riot of color and form that is as ostentatious as it is impressive. A gentle mist issues from apertures on the vaulted ceiling and long golden threads trail downwards, writhing around particular Successors and eventually, you.|1923|0
units.english: You soon enter a similar room to the one you visited the last time you were here, though this one is even larger and more richly decorated, the walls a riot of color and form that is as ostentatious as it is impressive. A gentle mist issues from apertures on the vaulted ceiling and long golden threads trail downwards, writhing around particular Successors and eventually, you.
units.italian: Entri presto in una stanza simile a quella che avevi visitato l'ultima volta che sei stato qui, anche se questa è ancora più grande e più riccamente decorata, le pareti un tripudio di colore e forma tanto ostentato quanto impressionante. Una nebbia leggera esce da aperture sul soffitto a volta e lunghi fili dorati scendono verso il basso, attorcigliandosi intorno a certi Successori e infine anche a te.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	The thread inspects your face and clothing for a short time before it speaks in a soft, synthesized voice. "Greetings, Captain <first> <last>! Thou'rt authorized to attend the ceremony this afternoon and, following, a special meeting of the locally-gathered Houses." The voice continues for a while, providing you with information on which rooms to visit and how you are to find your way there.|1924|0
units.english: The thread inspects your face and clothing for a short time before it speaks in a soft, synthesized voice. "Greetings, Captain <first> <last>! Thou'rt authorized to attend the ceremony this afternoon and, following, a special meeting of the locally-gathered Houses." The voice continues for a while, providing you with information on which rooms to visit and how you are to find your way there.
units.italian: Il filo esamina il tuo viso e i tuoi vestiti per un breve tratto prima di parlare con una voce morbida e sintetizzata. "Salve, capitano <first> <last>! Sei autorizzato ad assistere alla cerimonia di questo pomeriggio e, a seguire, a un incontro speciale delle Casate qui riunite." La voce continua per un po', fornendoti informazioni su quali stanze visitare e su come trovarti la strada.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	Soon after, you catch sight of Khiajsore, the Myurej scion you spoke with before. They catch sight of you as well and slither towards you, batting away one of the threads with a bejeweled arm. "Captain, captain, delightful Captain," they say. "How pleasant of thee to accept our invitation."|1925|0
units.english: Soon after, you catch sight of Khiajsore, the Myurej scion you spoke with before. They catch sight of you as well and slither towards you, batting away one of the threads with a bejeweled arm. "Captain, captain, delightful Captain," they say. "How pleasant of thee to accept our invitation."
units.italian: Poco dopo scorci Khiajsore, l'erede di Myurej con cui hai parlato prima. Anche loro ti notano e strisciano verso di te, allontanando uno dei fili con un braccio ingioiellato. "Capitano, capitano, delizioso capitano," dicono. "Che piacere che tu abbia accettato il nostro invito."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"I appreciated your extending it."|1927|0
units.english: "I appreciated your extending it."
units.italian: "Ho apprezzato che me l'abbiate esteso."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"It's a very impressive facility you have here."|1929|0
units.english: "It's a very impressive facility you have here."
units.italian: "È una struttura davvero impressionante, la vostra."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	They hum. "Such beauty earns the envy of many; the natural and artificial intertwined."|1930|0
units.english: They hum. "Such beauty earns the envy of many; the natural and artificial intertwined."
units.italian: Canticchiano. "Una bellezza simile guadagna l'invidia di molti; il naturale e l'artificiale intrecciati."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"For such a unique and industrious figure, 'twould've been an unbearable snub not to!"|1934|0
units.english: "For such a unique and industrious figure, 'twould've been an unbearable snub not to!"
units.italian: "Per una figura così unica e industriosa, sarebbe stato uno sgarbo insopportabile non farlo!"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	They rattle one of their arms a little, red gold and sparkling stones swinging through the air. "I just spoke of thee, in fact, with a delegate of House Seineq here, who confirmed what I've heard that thou wert of use to them as well! I think," they say, "thou didst set a good example for future aliens - benevolent, equitable, humble. Though I hear now Kaatrij has obtained thy vassalage? A boon to them, no doubt." Their face sparkles with color, eyes alight with furtive interest. "Though I hope for our efforts, Myurej has earned some measure of thy favor."|1937|0
units.english: They rattle one of their arms a little, red gold and sparkling stones swinging through the air. "I just spoke of thee, in fact, with a delegate of House Seineq here, who confirmed what I've heard that thou wert of use to them as well! I think," they say, "thou didst set a good example for future aliens - benevolent, equitable, humble. Though I hear now Kaatrij has obtained thy vassalage? A boon to them, no doubt." Their face sparkles with color, eyes alight with furtive interest. "Though I hope for our efforts, Myurej has earned some measure of thy favor."
units.italian: Fanno tintinnare un po' uno dei loro bracci, oro rosso e pietre scintillanti che oscillano nell'aria. "Stavo appunto parlando di te, in verità, con un delegato di Casa Seineq qui presente, che ha confermato ciò che avevo sentito, cioè che sei stato utile anche a loro! Penso," dicono, "che tu abbia dato un buon esempio per gli alieni futuri: benevolo, equo, umile. Anche se sento che ora Kaatrij ha ottenuto il tuo vassallaggio? Un dono per loro, senza dubbio." Il loro viso scintilla di colore, gli occhi accesi di un interesse furtivo. "Anche se spero nei nostri sforzi, Myurej si è guadagnata una qualche misura del tuo favore."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"I'm happy to help, so long as it doesn't conflict with my other responsibilities."|1939|0
units.english: "I'm happy to help, so long as it doesn't conflict with my other responsibilities."
units.italian: "Sono felice di aiutare, purché non confligga con le mie altre responsabilità."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"I'm not sure I like where this is going."|1940|0
units.english: "I'm not sure I like where this is going."
units.italian: "Non sono sicuro che mi piaccia dove sta andando questo discorso."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	Khiajsore laughs. "Of course, of course," they say. "Thou hast already helped us greatly. Now please excuse me."|1941|0
units.english: Khiajsore laughs. "Of course, of course," they say. "Thou hast already helped us greatly. Now please excuse me."
units.italian: Khiajsore ride. "Certo, certo," dicono. "Ci hai già aiutato molto. Ora scusami."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	They leave and two members of the crowd break off to follow them, which you notice carry small weapons strapped to their outfits. One of the golden threads makes its way back to you, informing you that the wedding ceremony will be beginning soon.|1942|0
units.english: They leave and two members of the crowd break off to follow them, which you notice carry small weapons strapped to their outfits. One of the golden threads makes its way back to you, informing you that the wedding ceremony will be beginning soon.
units.italian: Se ne vanno e due membri della folla si staccano per seguirli, e noti che portano piccole armi legate ai loro abiti. Uno dei fili dorati torna da te, informandoti che la cerimonia nuziale comincerà presto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	(Attend the wedding.)|1944|0
units.english: (Attend the wedding.)
units.italian: (Partecipa al matrimonio.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	(Wait around until the later meeting.)|1945|0
units.english: (Wait around until the later meeting.)
units.italian: (Aspetta fino all'incontro successivo.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	While most Successors are waiting outside the entrance to what must be a massive room, you are instead guided to an inconspicuous and out-of-the-way door, guarded by a pair of Successor soldiers. Neither one reacts to your attempt to pass, and as you step behind the door, it becomes clear why you aren't lining up with the general public: that massive room is entirely filled with water, a gigantic sphere with lights, platforms, and countless seats all built within it. A few small rooms like the one you now stand in are built into the walls like little transparent air bubbles at the shore of a great sea.|1947|0
units.english: While most Successors are waiting outside the entrance to what must be a massive room, you are instead guided to an inconspicuous and out-of-the-way door, guarded by a pair of Successor soldiers. Neither one reacts to your attempt to pass, and as you step behind the door, it becomes clear why you aren't lining up with the general public: that massive room is entirely filled with water, a gigantic sphere with lights, platforms, and countless seats all built within it. A few small rooms like the one you now stand in are built into the walls like little transparent air bubbles at the shore of a great sea.
units.italian: Mentre la maggior parte dei Successori attende fuori dall'ingresso di quella che deve essere una stanza enorme, tu vieni invece guidato a una porta defilata e appartata, sorvegliata da due soldati Successori. Nessuno dei due reagisce al tuo tentativo di passare, e mentre varchi la porta diventa chiaro perché non sei in fila con il pubblico generale: quella stanza enorme è interamente piena d'acqua, una sfera gigantesca con luci, piattaforme e innumerevoli posti a sedere costruiti al suo interno. Alcune piccole stanze come quella in cui ti trovi ora sono incassate nelle pareti come minuscole bolle d'aria trasparenti sulla riva di un grande mare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	You are joined by three other Successors after a few minutes, each of whom takes their place in the little room. The ceremony begins shortly after. From apertures in the bottom of the sphere, legions of soldiers emerge, half wearing the colors of House Chydiyi and the other half of House Myurej. The two small armies swim around each other, interleaving their lines of bodies like the Ribbons themselves that you saw outside.|1948|0
units.english: You are joined by three other Successors after a few minutes, each of whom takes their place in the little room. The ceremony begins shortly after. From apertures in the bottom of the sphere, legions of soldiers emerge, half wearing the colors of House Chydiyi and the other half of House Myurej. The two small armies swim around each other, interleaving their lines of bodies like the Ribbons themselves that you saw outside.
units.italian: Ti si uniscono altri tre Successori dopo qualche minuto, ognuno dei quali prende posto nella piccola stanza. La cerimonia comincia poco dopo. Da aperture sul fondo della sfera emergono legioni di soldati, metà con i colori di Casa Chydiyi e l'altra metà di Casa Myurej. I due piccoli eserciti nuotano gli uni intorno agli altri, intrecciando le loro linee di corpi come i Nastri stessi che hai visto fuori.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	Only after a half hour of these acrobatics does the couple finally appear, rising up from the same apertures and joined by a flanking group of what must be the scions of their respective houses. You spy Khiajsore among them. There is a further intertwining, a display of finery and a ripple of many colors over the skin of those assembled, and then a collective hum rises from the crowd.|1949|0
units.english: Only after a half hour of these acrobatics does the couple finally appear, rising up from the same apertures and joined by a flanking group of what must be the scions of their respective houses. You spy Khiajsore among them. There is a further intertwining, a display of finery and a ripple of many colors over the skin of those assembled, and then a collective hum rises from the crowd.
units.italian: Solo dopo mezz'ora di queste acrobazie la coppia appare finalmente, salendo dalle stesse aperture e affiancata da un gruppo di quelli che devono essere gli eredi delle rispettive casate. Tra loro scorgi Khiajsore. Segue un ulteriore intreccio, una mostra di raffinatezza e un'onda di molti colori sulla pelle dei presenti, e poi un brusio collettivo sale dalla folla.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	(Hum also.)|1951|0
units.english: (Hum also.)
units.italian: (Brusisci anche tu.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	(Remain silent.)|1952|0
units.english: (Remain silent.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	With the moment apparently passed, speeches follow, each of the scions offering some short dialog about the history of their house and their hopes for its future. The translation device struggles to make sense of many of the words, as if they're being said in a dialect it's unfamiliar with. Eventually the ceremony seems to come to a close, the enormous audience trickling out of their seats and returning to mill about the facility.|1953|0
units.english: With the moment apparently passed, speeches follow, each of the scions offering some short dialog about the history of their house and their hopes for its future. The translation device struggles to make sense of many of the words, as if they're being said in a dialect it's unfamiliar with. Eventually the ceremony seems to come to a close, the enormous audience trickling out of their seats and returning to mill about the facility.
units.italian: Passato apparentemente il momento, seguono i discorsi, ognuno degli eredi che offre qualche breve dialogo sulla storia della propria casata e sulle speranze per il suo futuro. Il dispositivo di traduzione fatica a dare un senso a molte delle parole, come se fossero dette in un dialetto che non conosce. Alla fine la cerimonia sembra volgere al termine, l'enorme pubblico che defluisce dai posti e torna a girare per la struttura.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	You wait around for a little while until one of the threads comes to find you, giving you directions to an out-of-the-way room. Inside are representatives of all six High Houses; among them Khiajsore of House Myurej, Riijaaora of House Sioeora, and Kampa of House Kaatrij.|1956|0
units.english: You wait around for a little while until one of the threads comes to find you, giving you directions to an out-of-the-way room. Inside are representatives of all six High Houses; among them Khiajsore of House Myurej, Riijaaora of House Sioeora, and Kampa of House Kaatrij.
units.italian: Aspetti un po' finché uno dei fili non viene a cercarti, dandoti indicazioni per una stanza appartata. Dentro ci sono rappresentanti di tutte e sei le Casate Alte; tra loro Khiajsore di Casa Myurej, Riijaaora di Casa Sioeora e Kampa di Casa Kaatrij.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	Kampa takes to the pool in the center of the room, addressing the group: "Honored representatives of the Houses assembled. House Kaatrij calls this union to make public our declaration of suzerainty to the alien captain <first> <last>. In keeping with the inter-Houses Treaty on Alien Agents, we herefore shall provide our vassal the violent fruits of our House, so that they might adequately and securely perform their duties.|1957|0
units.english: Kampa takes to the pool in the center of the room, addressing the group: "Honored representatives of the Houses assembled. House Kaatrij calls this union to make public our declaration of suzerainty to the alien captain <first> <last>. In keeping with the inter-Houses Treaty on Alien Agents, we herefore shall provide our vassal the violent fruits of our House, so that they might adequately and securely perform their duties.
units.italian: Kampa scende nella pozza al centro della stanza e si rivolge al gruppo: "Onorevoli rappresentanti delle Casate riunite. Casa Kaatrij convoca questa unione per rendere pubblica la nostra dichiarazione di sovranità sul capitano alieno <first> <last>. In conformità con il Trattato inter-Casate sugli Agenti Alieni, forniremo pertanto al nostro vassallo i violenti frutti della nostra Casa, affinché possa svolgere i propri doveri in modo adeguato e sicuro.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	In keeping with the Treaty, this offer may be extended by the other Houses in courtesy and deference to sovereign Kaatrij."|1958|0
units.english: In keeping with the Treaty, this offer may be extended by the other Houses in courtesy and deference to sovereign Kaatrij."
units.italian: In conformità con il Trattato, questa offerta potrà essere estesa dalle altre Casate in cortesia e deferenza alla sovrana Kaatrij."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	They step back to the rim of the pool and three others take to the pool's center: Myurej, Aqrabe, and Seineq. Each one speaks in turn, variations on a phrase: "In appreciation with the captain's service to our House, we provide our assent to and recognition of this offer."|1959|0
units.english: They step back to the rim of the pool and three others take to the pool's center: Myurej, Aqrabe, and Seineq. Each one speaks in turn, variations on a phrase: "In appreciation with the captain's service to our House, we provide our assent to and recognition of this offer."
units.italian: Tornano al bordo della pozza e altri tre prendono il centro: Myurej, Aqrabe e Seineq. Ognuno parla a turno, variazioni di una frase: "In apprezzamento del servizio del capitano alla nostra Casa, diamo il nostro assenso e riconoscimento a questa offerta."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	Chydiyi's representative stays on the edge of the pool, abstaining from the discussion, but Sioeora's takes the center, glaring at you.|1960|0
units.english: Chydiyi's representative stays on the edge of the pool, abstaining from the discussion, but Sioeora's takes the center, glaring at you.
units.italian: Il rappresentante di Chydiyi resta sul bordo della pozza, astenendosi dalla discussione, ma quella di Sioeora prende il centro, fissandoti con durezza.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"Despite Sioeora's generosity and patronage to the captain," Riijaaora says, "this alien sees fit to vassalize another House. We shall not recognize this relationship, nor open our outfitters to them."|1964|0
units.english: "Despite Sioeora's generosity and patronage to the captain," Riijaaora says, "this alien sees fit to vassalize another House. We shall not recognize this relationship, nor open our outfitters to them."
units.italian: "Nonostante la generosità e il patrocinio di Sioeora verso il capitano," dice Riijaaora, "questo alieno ritiene opportuno diventare vassallo di un'altra Casa. Non riconosceremo questa relazione, né apriremo i nostri fornitori a loro."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|label|1967|0
units.english: kaatrij patron
units.italian: kaatrij patron

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"Despite Sioeora's generosity to the captain," Riijaaora says, "this alien sees fit to vassalize another House. We shall not recognize this relationship, nor open our outfitters to them."|1968|0
units.english: "Despite Sioeora's generosity to the captain," Riijaaora says, "this alien sees fit to vassalize another House. We shall not recognize this relationship, nor open our outfitters to them."
units.italian: "Nonostante la generosità di Sioeora verso il capitano," dice Riijaaora, "questo alieno ritiene opportuno diventare vassallo di un'altra Casa. Non riconosceremo questa relazione, né apriremo i nostri fornitori a loro."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	When they return to the edge, no more is said. Kampa returns to the pool and produces a small wooden box from their outfit, which they give to you.|1971|0
units.english: When they return to the edge, no more is said. Kampa returns to the pool and produces a small wooden box from their outfit, which they give to you.
units.italian: Quando tornano al bordo, non si dice altro. Kampa torna nella pozza e produce dal proprio abito una piccola scatola di legno, che ti consegna.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	(Take it.)|1973|0
units.english: (Take it.)
units.italian: (Prendila.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	You open the box to find an elaborate gold brooch nestled among soft folds of velvet.|1974|0
units.english: You open the box to find an elaborate gold brooch nestled among soft folds of velvet.
units.italian: Apri la scatola e trovi una spilla d'oro elaborata, adagiata tra soffici pieghe di velluto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"Let this gift make clear to all thy responsibilities and privileges, and may thou have free access to all our House and allies offer..." Kampa says, "<first> <last>, Honored Knight-Vassal of the High House Kaatrij." A colorful display rushes over Kampa's skin and they pick up the brooch with one arm and pin it on your jacket right next to your translation device and the civilian license. The metal must be very dense; it is noticeably heavier than the others.|1976|0
units.english: "Let this gift make clear to all thy responsibilities and privileges, and may thou have free access to all our House and allies offer..." Kampa says, "<first> <last>, Honored Knight-Vassal of the High House Kaatrij." A colorful display rushes over Kampa's skin and they pick up the brooch with one arm and pin it on your jacket right next to your translation device and the civilian license. The metal must be very dense; it is noticeably heavier than the others.
units.italian: "Che questo dono renda chiari a tutti i tuoi doveri e privilegi, e che tu possa avere libero accesso a tutto ciò che la nostra Casa e i suoi alleati offrono..." dice Kampa, "<first> <last>, Onorato Cavaliere-Vassallo della Casa Alta Kaatrij." Una vivace esibizione di colori scorre sulla pelle di Kampa, che raccoglie la spilla con un braccio e la appunta sulla tua giacca, proprio accanto al dispositivo di traduzione e alla licenza civile. Il metallo deve essere molto denso; è notevolmente più pesante degli altri.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	With this, the meeting concludes, the various members exiting in turn - the ones you've met before offering some short words of congratulations. You eventually exit as well, finding your way back through the facility. By a floral display you spy Saajret, apparently deep in conversation with Tiliia, the House Seineq engineer.|1977|0
units.english: With this, the meeting concludes, the various members exiting in turn - the ones you've met before offering some short words of congratulations. You eventually exit as well, finding your way back through the facility. By a floral display you spy Saajret, apparently deep in conversation with Tiliia, the House Seineq engineer.
units.italian: Con questo, l'incontro si conclude e i vari membri escono a turno, quelli che hai già incontrato che offrono qualche breve parola di congratulazioni. Alla fine esci anche tu, ritrovando la strada attraverso la struttura. Presso un allestimento floreale scorci Saajret, apparentemente immerso in una conversazione con Tiliia, l'ingegnera di Casa Seineq.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	(Go speak with them.)|1979|0
units.english: (Go speak with them.)
units.italian: (Vai a parlare con loro.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	(Leave.)|1980|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	Tiliia spots you first, their skin breaking out in colors of excitement. "Saajret tells me of thine ascent to Kaatrij's ranks," they say. "Excellent that thou might be a concerted ally to mine own House as well."|1983|0
units.english: Tiliia spots you first, their skin breaking out in colors of excitement. "Saajret tells me of thine ascent to Kaatrij's ranks," they say. "Excellent that thou might be a concerted ally to mine own House as well."
units.italian: Tiliia ti nota per prima, la pelle che si accende di colori di eccitazione. "Saajret mi racconta della tua ascesa nei ranghi di Kaatrij," dicono. "Eccellente che tu possa essere un alleato concertato anche per la mia Casa."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	Saajret hums and nods. "The captain is a canny sort," they say. "Capable of surviving our wiles, I believe." Tiliia laughs at that, Saajret continuing. "And Tiliia tells me thou wert of help to them as well, the reason by which our craft now gain an advantage through the wormhole."|1984|0
units.english: Saajret hums and nods. "The captain is a canny sort," they say. "Capable of surviving our wiles, I believe." Tiliia laughs at that, Saajret continuing. "And Tiliia tells me thou wert of help to them as well, the reason by which our craft now gain an advantage through the wormhole."
units.italian: Saajret canticchia e annuisce. "Il capitano è del tipo astuto," dice. "Capace di sopravvivere alle nostre astuzie, credo." Tiliia ride a questo, e Saajret continua. "E Tiliia mi dice che sei stato d'aiuto anche a loro, la ragione per cui le nostre navi ora guadagnano un vantaggio attraverso il cunicolo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|label|1985|0
units.english: saajret and tiliia
units.italian: saajret and tiliia

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"It's good to see you two getting along."|1987|0
units.english: "It's good to see you two getting along."
units.italian: "È bello vedervi andare d'accordo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"Do you think Aqrabe and Kaatrij will be collaborating much?"|1991|0
units.english: "Do you think Aqrabe and Kaatrij will be collaborating much?"
units.italian: "Pensi che Aqrabe e Kaatrij collaboreranno molto?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"I'm still uncertain joining Kaatrij was the right choice."|1995|0
units.english: "I'm still uncertain joining Kaatrij was the right choice."
units.italian: "Sono ancora incerto che unirmi a Kaatrij sia stata la scelta giusta."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"I should get going."|1999|0
units.english: "I should get going."
units.italian: "Dovrei andare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|label|2002|0
units.english: getting along
units.italian: getting along

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	Saajret nods. "Tiliia's work on the keystones that thou provided intrigues me greatly. It bears some resemblance to technologies I've studied in our archives - though the stellar metal shells are a wholly inventive solution, I believe."|2006|0
units.english: Saajret nods. "Tiliia's work on the keystones that thou provided intrigues me greatly. It bears some resemblance to technologies I've studied in our archives - though the stellar metal shells are a wholly inventive solution, I believe."
units.italian: Saajret annuisce. "Il lavoro di Tiliia sulle chiavi di volta che hai fornito mi incuriosisce molto. Ha una qualche somiglianza con tecnologie che ho studiato nei nostri archivi, anche se i gusci di metallo stellare sono una soluzione del tutto inventiva, credo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	Tiliia interjects at this, a hint of embarrassment on their skin. "T'was a matter of managing with what could be done," they say.|2007|0
units.english: Tiliia interjects at this, a hint of embarrassment on their skin. "T'was a matter of managing with what could be done," they say.
units.italian: Tiliia interviene, un accenno di imbarazzo sulla pelle. "È stato questione di arrangiarsi con quel che si poteva fare," dicono.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"Nonetheless," says Saajret, now to Tiliia, "A worthy achievement. I am glad for this little lull if only for the sake of collaboration."|2008|0
units.english: "Nonetheless," says Saajret, now to Tiliia, "A worthy achievement. I am glad for this little lull if only for the sake of collaboration."
units.italian: "Ciò nonostante," dice Saajret, ora rivolto a Tiliia, "un risultato degno. Sono felice di questa piccola pausa, se non altro per la collaborazione."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|label|2011|0
units.english: collaboration
units.italian: collaboration

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"'T'would be fruitful, doubtless," Tiliia says. "And now that Kaatrij opens up a little for the first time since their wound, perhaps 'tis not beyond the realm of possibility."|2015|0
units.english: "'T'would be fruitful, doubtless," Tiliia says. "And now that Kaatrij opens up a little for the first time since their wound, perhaps 'tis not beyond the realm of possibility."
units.italian: "Sarebbe fruttuoso, senza dubbio," dice Tiliia. "E ora che Kaatrij si apre un poco per la prima volta dalla sua ferita, forse non è al di là del regno del possibile."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"I, too, would welcome it," Saajret adds. Their skin betrays a genuine satisfaction.|2019|0
units.english: "I, too, would welcome it," Saajret adds. Their skin betrays a genuine satisfaction.
units.italian: "Anche io lo accoglierei," aggiunge Saajret. La loro pelle tradisce una soddisfazione sincera.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|label|2022|0
units.english: low openness
units.italian: low openness

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	"I shall welcome it while it lasts," Saajret adds. "Though I fear Kaatrij's openness may be but a fleeting thing."|2023|0
units.english: "I shall welcome it while it lasts," Saajret adds. "Though I fear Kaatrij's openness may be but a fleeting thing."
units.italian: "Lo accoglierò finché durerà," aggiunge Saajret. "Anche se temo che l'apertura di Kaatrij possa essere solo una cosa fugace."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|label|2026|0
units.english: uncertain
units.italian: uncertain

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	Saajret hums deeply. "For us," they say, "our Houses are our families, and family is always a complicated thing. Perhaps I understand thee, captain, better than thou might imagine."|2032|0
units.english: Saajret hums deeply. "For us," they say, "our Houses are our families, and family is always a complicated thing. Perhaps I understand thee, captain, better than thou might imagine."
units.italian: Saajret canticchia profondamente. "Per noi," dice, "le nostre Casate sono le nostre famiglie, e la famiglia è sempre una cosa complicata. Forse capisco te, capitano, meglio di quanto tu possa immaginare."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|label|2035|0
units.english: high forgiveness
units.italian: high forgiveness

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	Saajret hums, a shade of curiosity coming over them. "Perhaps 'tis more uncertain for thee," they say. "For us, our Houses are our families - we must endeavor to live with them, eccentricities and all."|2036|0
units.english: Saajret hums, a shade of curiosity coming over them. "Perhaps 'tis more uncertain for thee," they say. "For us, our Houses are our families - we must endeavor to live with them, eccentricities and all."
units.italian: Saajret canticchia, un'ombra di curiosità che lo coglie. "Forse per te è più incerto," dice. "Per noi, le nostre Casate sono le nostre famiglie: dobbiamo sforzarci di conviverci, eccentricità comprese."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	You take the elevator back to your ship, catching one last brief glimpse of the Ribbons of Iret. As you leave, you receive a message from Kampa:|2044|0
units.english: You take the elevator back to your ship, catching one last brief glimpse of the Ribbons of Iret. As you leave, you receive a message from Kampa:
units.italian: Prendi l'ascensore per tornare alla nave, cogliendo un ultimo breve scorcio dei Nastri di Iret. Mentre parti, ricevi un messaggio da Kampa:

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	My congratulations once again. Thy service so far has been exemplary. Our House's efforts now focus on finding the identity of our attacker, a task, I fear, there is little thou can do t'accelerate. For now, thou might'st explore and prepare thyself for what may come in the future.|2045|0
units.english: My congratulations once again. Thy service so far has been exemplary. Our House's efforts now focus on finding the identity of our attacker, a task, I fear, there is little thou can do t'accelerate. For now, thou might'st explore and prepare thyself for what may come in the future.
units.italian: Ancora le mie congratulazioni. Il tuo servizio finora è stato esemplare. Gli sforzi della nostra Casa si concentrano ora sul trovare l'identità del nostro aggressore, un compito che, temo, hai poco modo di accelerare. Per ora, potresti esplorare e prepararti a ciò che potrà venire in futuro.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 20|	This I myself attest as J- S- Kampa, Fleet Captain to the High House Kaatrij.|2046|0
units.english: This I myself attest as J- S- Kampa, Fleet Captain to the High House Kaatrij.
units.italian: Questo io stesso attesto come J- S- Kampa, Capitano di Flotta della Casa Alta Kaatrij.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Reincarnation|	Though it's a few minutes before your data-sphere missive is answered, Saajret soon invites you to join them in a nearby town, which proves to be only a half-hour away by spaceport shuttle. It is built into an amphitheatre-shaped cutout of a seaside cliff, terraced homes and shops emerging from the rock with their curious flowing Kaatrij architecture. Many share the sail-like projections of the main spaceport, some decorated with iridescent patterns that shimmer as the wind tosses them.|2160|0
units.english: Though it's a few minutes before your data-sphere missive is answered, Saajret soon invites you to join them in a nearby town, which proves to be only a half-hour away by spaceport shuttle. It is built into an amphitheatre-shaped cutout of a seaside cliff, terraced homes and shops emerging from the rock with their curious flowing Kaatrij architecture. Many share the sail-like projections of the main spaceport, some decorated with iridescent patterns that shimmer as the wind tosses them.
units.italian: Anche se passano alcuni minuti prima che la tua missiva-sfera di dati riceva risposta, Saajret ti invita presto a raggiungerli in una città vicina, che si rivela distante solo mezz'ora di navetta dallo spazioporto. È costruita in un incavo a forma di anfiteatro in una scogliera sul mare, case e botteghe a terrazze che emergono dalla roccia con la loro curiosa architettura fluente di Kaatrij. Molte condividono le sporgenze simili a vele dello spazioporto principale, alcune decorate con motivi iridescenti che ondeggiano quando il vento le scuote.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Reincarnation|	Saajret meets you at the regional spaceport, explaining that you caught them on a day off. They lead you through the town to one of the more elegant homes. It's shaped like a series of concentric semicircles, and they invite you into the outermost one, what you might call a receiving area with benches and indoor gardens. Small robots slither over the floors, attending to dust and water.|2161|0
units.english: Saajret meets you at the regional spaceport, explaining that you caught them on a day off. They lead you through the town to one of the more elegant homes. It's shaped like a series of concentric semicircles, and they invite you into the outermost one, what you might call a receiving area with benches and indoor gardens. Small robots slither over the floors, attending to dust and water.
units.italian: Saajret ti incontra allo spazioporto regionale, spiegando che li hai colti in un giorno libero. Ti guidano attraverso la città fino a una delle case più eleganti. Ha la forma di una serie di semicerchi concentrici, e ti invitano nel più esterno, quello che potresti chiamare un'area di ricevimento con panche e giardini interni. Piccoli robot strisciano sui pavimenti, occupandosi della polvere e dell'acqua.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Reincarnation|	After a while, they turn to matters at hand. "Thou said that thou discover'd something about me in a transmission from the drone craft?" they ask. Though their tone is curious, something like a shade of fear lurks on their skin.|2162|0
units.english: After a while, they turn to matters at hand. "Thou said that thou discover'd something about me in a transmission from the drone craft?" they ask. Though their tone is curious, something like a shade of fear lurks on their skin.
units.italian: Dopo un po', passano alle questioni in sospeso. "Hai detto di aver scoperto qualcosa su di me in una trasmissione dal vascello drone?" chiedono. Anche se il tono è curioso, qualcosa come un'ombra di paura si aggira sulla loro pelle.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Reincarnation|	"It's probably just someone who shared your name, but I thought I'd tell you anyway. The transmissions included what seem like journals, and one of them mentions a 'Saajret.'"|2164|0
units.english: "It's probably just someone who shared your name, but I thought I'd tell you anyway. The transmissions included what seem like journals, and one of them mentions a 'Saajret.'"
units.italian: "Probabilmente è solo qualcuno che condivideva il tuo nome, ma ho pensato di dirtelo comunque. Le trasmissioni includevano quelli che sembrano diari, e uno di essi menziona un 'Saajret'."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Reincarnation|	"The transmissions included journals, and one of them mentions a 'Saajret.' Do you think they could have been an ancestor of yours?"|2165|0
units.english: "The transmissions included journals, and one of them mentions a 'Saajret.' Do you think they could have been an ancestor of yours?"
units.italian: "Le trasmissioni includevano dei diari, e uno di essi menziona un 'Saajret'. Pensi che potesse essere un tuo antenato?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Reincarnation|	Something about hearing their name in this context seems to strike a discordant chord within Saajret. All at once confusion and anger and sorrow flit over them before they tense and their skin becomes a steely gray. They say nothing more on the matter, instead striking up a conversation about your recent experiences and never slowing. After an hour or so of catching up, they've finally had enough and let the conversation die.|2166|0
units.english: Something about hearing their name in this context seems to strike a discordant chord within Saajret. All at once confusion and anger and sorrow flit over them before they tense and their skin becomes a steely gray. They say nothing more on the matter, instead striking up a conversation about your recent experiences and never slowing. After an hour or so of catching up, they've finally had enough and let the conversation die.
units.italian: Qualcosa nel sentire il proprio nome in questo contesto sembra toccare una corda stonata dentro Saajret. Confusione, rabbia e dolore si alternano su di loro in un istante, prima che si tendano e la loro pelle diventi di un grigio d'acciaio. Non dicono altro sull'argomento e invece avviano una conversazione sulle tue esperienze recenti, senza mai rallentare. Dopo circa un'ora di aggiornamenti, alla fine ne hanno abbastanza e lasciano morire la conversazione.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Reincarnation|	As you leave, Saajret turns to you a final time. A strange expression is sitting on their face, and their skin seems incapable of resolving into a single color display. "Thou hast my deepest thanks, my friend," they say, sounding a little haunted, and close the door.|2167|0
units.english: As you leave, Saajret turns to you a final time. A strange expression is sitting on their face, and their skin seems incapable of resolving into a single color display. "Thou hast my deepest thanks, my friend," they say, sounding a little haunted, and close the door.
units.italian: Mentre te ne vai, Saajret si volta verso di te un'ultima volta. Un'espressione strana si posa sul loro viso, e la loro pelle sembra incapace di risolversi in un unico afflato di colore. "Hai la mia più profonda gratitudine, amico mio," dicono, con un suono un po' inquieto, e chiudono la porta.
